narrative: An employee was working on a swing scaffold, preparing to install terracotta tile on the exterior of a building. Terracotta tiles that had been previously installed on the building detached and fell striking the employee in the head. The employee suffered lacerations to the head, a head injury, bleeding around the brain, and neck and back injuries.

An employee was at the second-floor level of a home under construction moving a sheet of plywood. A rope became caught in a stair hole, causing the employee to lose balance and fall through the opening to the concrete floor. The employee suffered a spine fracture (at the lower back) and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was unloading concrete stumps for light poles off a forklift. One of the stumps slipped off the forks and the employee attempted to grab it when it crushed his left index fingertip, resulting in surgical amputation.
An employee fell while carrying a jackhammer down a hillside. The employee suffered fractures to three lower-back vertebrae and was hospitalized.
An employee was walking through the nineteenth floor of a jobsite conducting quality inspections when they slipped on the wet floor due to rain and fell. The employee suffered a right ankle fracture.

An employee was working on installing a rental boiler when the storage tank got extremely hot. The pressure rose and the line broke, causing pressurized hot water to spray onto the employee causing second-degree burns to approximately 63% of his body.

An employee was using a grinder to grind the hitch of a truck. The grinding disc got caught and exploded. Pieces of the disc struck the employee above their left eyelid causing a laceration to left eye, nose, and eye lid that required surgery.
An employee was on a 10-foot ladder, pulling data cable through ceiling trusses. He fell from the ladder to the concrete floor, suffering multiple fractures.
An employee was installing an anchor point to tie off when he slipped on his lifeline and fell from a second-floor roof to a first-floor roof. He suffered fractures to a rib and his right leg.

An employee was helping a mechanic troubleshoot a jammed ATV winch hook. The winch switch was jogged inside the cab. As the employee was pulling on the hook, it rolled into the spool, and the employee's right index finger was caught in the spool resulting in amputation.

An employee was descending a 14-foot ladder. The ladder was wet and muddy, which caused the employee to lose grip and fall to the ground about 8 feet below. The employee suffered a broken lower back vertebra and a broken left knee.
An employee was removing a plug from a pipeline. The plug and the pipe caught the employee's fingertip just below the fingernail, causing a partial amputation without bone loss.

A drill operator was changing a drill rod when the rod fell out of its carousel and struck an employee in the head. The employee sustained a laceration to his head and injury to his neck. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was installing telecommunication lines using pre-fabs. During this task, the employee made contact with the power line directly above him and was shocked with 7200 volts. The electrical shock caused him fall to the base of the bucket he was in. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was working at a transfer roller in the roof department when their left middle and ring fingers were pinched between a chain and sprocket. The fingers were lacerated and the ring fingertip was amputated.
The injured employee fell from a 10-foot step ladder that was being shaken by another employee. The employee landed on the concrete floor and suffered shoulder and head injuries.
An employee fell off an 8-foot extension ladder on the outside of a house. The employee suffered two broken lower back vertebrae.

An employee was wearing battery-powered, rechargeable heated insoles inside his boots. Though the insoles were not turned on, one of the batteries exploded and caught fire. The employee suffered third-degree burns to the bottom of his right foot.
On January 9, 2024, an employee was pulling wire out of a meter can when the wire touched the meter, causing an arc flash. The employee was hospitalized with burns to their face, neck, and shoulder.
On January 9, 2024, an employee performing powerline restoration was climbing onto a truck when he fell to the ground. He was hospitalized with a fractured right leg.
An employee was using a table saw when they suffered amputations to several fingers.

The injured employee was installing the condenser section of an air conditioning unit using an overhead crane. The injured employee was on the back side of the unit trying to secure it as three other employees were trying to ensure the condenser section piping would fit in the pre-drilled holes on the roof. When the unit was lowered, the injured employee's left index finger was caught in a pinch point between the roof of the unit and the condenser section. They sustained a partial amputation to the distal phalanx of their left index finger.

An employee was working from a scissor lift, installing studs in a metal track in an elevator lobby area. His tool belt became caught and he fell backward, landing on the concrete floor 80 inches below and striking his head on lumber on the ground. He suffered a broken left hand, a head laceration, and inflammation around the spine.

On January 10, 2024, an employee was working on a tender boat to tie off a hopper barge when his right hand was caught between the float pipe and the push knee of the barge. The employee was hospitalized and the tip of his right thumb was amputated.

An employee was on a ladder cutting an overhead pipe in a mechanical room. The bracket holding the pipe broke and the pipe struck the employee's head, causing him to fall backward off the ladder and onto the floor. He was hospitalized with injuries to his head and back.
An employee was walking at a work site when he stepped on a nail, which punctured his left foot.

An employee was working on a 277-volt lighting circuit when he received an electrical shock. He then fell from an 8-foot step ladder onto the floor, striking his head. The employee sustained a concussion.
An employee was removing a ladder from an 18-foot-deep trench when he fell in, resulting in a broken neck.

An employee and a co-worker were removing a dead pine tree. The employee was standing outside the fall zone of the tree while removing slack from the rope tied around the tree and assisting in pulling the tree down. As the co-worker was cutting the tree, it snapped sideways and struck a living sweet gum tree, which subsequently fell and struck the employee. The employee suffered a broken ankle and leg.

While conducting an insurance claim survey, an employee was inspecting AC units on a terrace floor with silicone coating that was wet due to rain and included some algae. The employee completed the survey and was leaving the site when he slipped and fell on the floor, landing on the left side of his ribcage. The employee suffered pain that required hospitalization, potentially due to spleen hematoma.

An employee was loading material onto a truck when a 20-foot pipe slipped, causing the employee to fall. Another 20-foot pipe then fell on top of the employee, resulting in a contusion to their left leg. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was working on a ladder when they fell approximately 7 feet to the ground below, resulting in a broken nose and facial injuries.
An employee was walking back to a powerline to inspect the location of an upcoming job when they slipped on ice and fell to the ground, resulting in fractured ribs that required hospitalization.
An employee was using a saw on concrete when it kicked back and struck his left thumb, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was installing a catwalk when the catwalk gave way, causing the employee to fall 16 feet to the ground. The employee suffered fractures to an ankle, foot, and his right knee. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was removing guardrails on the second floor of a residential construction in preparation for additional framing. The employee fell approximately 20 feet from the second floor to the ground outside, resulting in a fractured hip and leg.

On January 17, 2024, an employee was dumping the debris tank of a hydrovac truck at a landfill. As the employee was removing ice that was stuck to the inside of the debris tank door, a frozen block of mud/water slid out of the tank and struck the employee's right leg, resulting in a fracture that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was shocked by a cable while terminating load breaks. The employee suffered burns to a hand and the stomach.

An employee was ascending an extension ladder when the bottom feet of the ladder slid out, causing the employee to fall to the floor. The employee suffered a compound fracture of his left foot and was hospitalized.

An employee was climbing up a ladder that was placed on an asphalt driveway and leaning against the edge of a roof. When the employee was approximately 5 feet high, the ladder slid out and they fell to the asphalt. The employee was hospitalized with multiple broken bones in their face.
An employee was working on a transformer when his foot was caught between two stair treads. He fell to the side, suffering a tibial plateau fracture and a broken right ankle.
An employee was holding a 2x4 at the end of the utility pipe when a frozen dirt clod rolled down the slope of a 10-foot excavation and struck the employee's leg, fracturing it.
An employee was installing gutters. The employee's work ladder touched low-hanging electrical wires that were covered by trees, and the employee was shocked.

An employee was climbing a ladder to get on the roof when the ladder slid out from underneath of them, causing the employee to fall to the grass below. The employee sustained fractures to the left heel, right foot, and right leg.
On January 18, 2024, an employee sustained head and neck injuries after falling down a staircase at a customer's home.
An employee was descending a ladder from a roof when his foot slipped, causing him to fall 10-12 feet to the blacktop below. The employee suffered skull and wrist fractures.
An employee was installing shingles on a two-story roof when he fell approximately 25 feet after unhooking from his harness. The employee was hospitalized with multiple injuries.

An employee was sorting and moving glass from one L-bucket skid to another when the skid tipped over and a piece of glass fell out and landed on the employee. They suffered a broken left leg and ankle.
An employee was climbing a mounted ladder inside a store to access the roof when they slipped and fell approximately 10 feet to the floor below. The employee sustained heel fractures to both feet.
An employee was carrying metal sheeting on a roof when they fell about 20 feet to the gravel ground. The employee's right arm was fractured at the elbow and he was hospitalized.

An employee was performing a cable installation at a residence. The cable was hanging over the road between two poles when a car drove along the road, hitting the cable and pulling the employee off the ladder. The employee suffered fractures to the hand, hip, and leg.
An employee was walking toward a trailer to speak with a driver when they slipped on snow and ice in the parking lot and fell. The employee suffered a right elbow fracture.

An employee was transferring oil into a storage tank by hose from a 55-gallon drum. A reaction occurred inside the tank causing steam to be released through the tank's open cap. The employee sustained second-degree burns to the face.

An employee was ascending a straight ladder to exit the bottom of an elevator shaft when he lost balance and fell approximately 4-5 feet onto wood wire reels. He suffered rib fractures resulting in partial pneumothorax and sustained compression fractures to 2 or 3 thoracic vertebrae. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was setting up a ladder to access a roof. While tying off the ladder, the employee fell approximately 18 feet. The employee sustained injuries to his pelvis and right shoulder and required surgery.
An employee was getting off a vertical mast scissor lift when they tripped on the toe board and fell. The employee suffered a broken right wrist.

An employee was assisting with disassembling a 500-ton crane. The injured employee was pushing an outrigger while another employee pulled from the other side to stow the base of the outrigger. The injured employee's left ring finger became caught in the rail system, requiring surgical amputation at the first knuckle.
An employee was walking into a building on a construction site when he slipped on a wet surface, fracturing his left lower leg. The employee was hospitalized.

Employees were at a mobile park servicing post-hurricane damaged homes and grounds by testing cables, re-energizing cables, and getting services ready for new mobile homes to be placed back on the lots. The injured employee was making secondary electrical connections to pre-existing cables that were on the ground where previous mobile homes were when an arc flash occurred. The employee suffered partial thickness facial burns.
An employee was installing a ladder joist when they fell 9.5 feet from a balcony and struck their head on the ground. The employee suffered a head injury and was hospitalized.

An employee was on a roof performing HVAC work. As they were transitioning from the roof to the ladder, the employee slipped on moisture/ice on the ladder rung and fell to the ground level. The employee suffered a fractured foot an injured spine.

The injured employee was walking to a tower that was being maintained when another employee lost his balance and collided with him. The other employee slipped on the ice and fell on the injured employee's left lower leg, fracturing it.
An employee was loading a backhoe onto a trailer. The trailer fell and crushed the employee's hand and wrist, resulting in a compound fracture to the lower forearm.

An employee was dismantling a scaffold when an arc from a nearby transformer contacted the pole the employee was removing. The employee suffered second-degree burns to his chest and arms and was hospitalized.

An employee was on a roof laying out the locations for installation of roof drains when they slipped on snow and ice and fell on the roof surface. The employee suffered a leg fracture just above the ankle.
An employee was cleaning snow off the bed of a dump truck. As he was getting out, he fell to the pavement and suffered a right hip fracture.

An employee was on a rafter in an attic installing attic rulers when they slipped and fell approximately 9 feet through the sheetrock to the floor below. The employee suffered a crush injury to the L6 and L7 vertebrae.

Employees were in a mobile crane when it collapsed. They fell approximately100 feet to the ground and two employees were hospitalized. One employee sustained a hip injury and the other employee sustained a lung injury.

An employee was staging materials when another employee who was working on an elevated surface above them slipped and fell, landing on the injured employee. The injured employee suffered six rib fractures and bruising to the torso and face. The other employee was not injured.
An employee was descending a ladder at a single-family home. The employee fell from the fourth rung to the ground, suffering a broken tibia and fibula.

An employee was walking in the onsite parking garage when they slipped on ice and fell on their back, hip, and head. The employee sustained a headache and internal bleeding that caused a seizure. The employee was hospitalized.

The injured employee drove a dump truck to a worksite to unload a portion of rock. A mini excavator was parked and waiting on the shoulder of the road. When the injured employee exited the dump truck, the mini excavator rotated and the injured employee's middle finger was caught between the cab door of the excavator and the open door of the dump truck, resulting in a distal amputation of the third digit.

An employee was installing shelving. As they were sliding a metal pipe into the wooden shelving unit, the employee's hand was caught between the shelf support and the end of the pipe, resulting in a right index and middle finger fracture.
An employee was climbing up a ladder when they fell to the floor below, suffering a left distal radius fracture.
An employee was operating a saw when their thumb was partially amputated by the blade.
An employee was servicing an air-handling unit. After he turned off the power, the belt and pulley caught his left hand, causing the amputation of his index fingertip.

An employee was working on a live meter base, removing an old wire and preparing to install a new wire. The employee's tools made an electrical connection, and the resulting arc flash burned both the employee's hands. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a hydraulic siding folding machine. His hand was clamped in the machine and bones in the hand were broken.

An employee was wrapping a chain around a concrete manhole tube. An excavator, being used as a crane, started to lift the tube and cinched the chain. The employee's left middle finger was caught by the chain, which amputated the fingertip.
An employee was helping two other employees move a glass panel. The panel slipped and fell on one of his legs, fracturing the tibia and femur.
Concrete tables were being moved from one floor to another. A table had been secured with a table jack so that a screw jack could be removed. The table fell and crushed an employee's right hand.
An employee was climbing a ladder into a customer's attic hatch. The customer's area rug slipped, causing the employee to fall to the floor. He was hospitalized with a broken left arm and wrist.

At about 8:00 a.m., on January 29, 2024, an employee was climbing up an extension ladder to inspect a residential roof. The base of the ladder slipped out and he fell 7-10 feet, landing on the blacktop below. He suffered a dislocated left elbow and was hospitalized.
An employee was unplugging the quick-connect plug of a welder when an arc flash occurred, resulting in electric shock and burns to the right thumb and left side of the face.
An employee was cleaning the tracks of a skid steer from outside the vehicle. The skid steer's boom moved vertically and pinched the employee against the tracks. His foot was broken.

An employee was loading a cart with 2 1/2-inch pipe. The ground was uneven; the cart shifted and began to roll toward the employee as he was putting straps on it. The cart struck his finger resulting in amputation near the nail.

An employee was walking on a steel beam when the self-retracting lifeline attached to his safety harness locked up. This caused him to fall and strike his face on the beam; his safety glasses were also pushed into his eyelid. He sustained lacerations to his eyelid and eye.

On January 30, 2024, a maintenance employee was cleaning and wiping down the inside of an elevator with their left hand when their cleaning cloth got snagged on moving equipment, causing their hand to become caught in the equipment as well. The employee fractured her left middle finger and sustained a cut requiring stitches and was hospitalized.

An employee was on a ladder, installing trusses on a balcony using a drill and screws. As he put one of the screws in, he fell from the second step of the ladder (about 2 feet above the ground), landed on the ground, and suffered a broken left arm.

Employees dug a trench near a water pump that was previously installed to move water from an above-ground water tank to a future development (the tank was empty as it was still under construction). The employees were to cut into a 20-foot long PVC waterpipe and reroute it to the water pump station. The employees believed that water was inside the pipe when they began to cut. The pipe exploded as soon as the saw breached the piping surface. The pipe had pressurized air inside, resulting in the explosion due to release of pressure. Two employees were hospitalized.

An employee was leaning against guardrails while pulling up an insulation hose to the third floor. The guardrails snapped and the employee fell approximately 26 feet onto the concrete below. The employee suffered fractures to facial bones, vertebrae, wrists, their hip, and both femurs.

An employee was retrieving rigging straps to begin rigging a stack of wooden and concrete forms to be lifted via an excavator boom off a bridge deck. While retrieving the straps, he stepped between the stack of forms and the excavator boom. At this time, the excavator shifted, causing the boom to shift and strike him in the head and neck area. The employee suffered a nondisplaced fracture to the jaw, a fracture on the right facial orbital area, and a neck laceration on his left side.

An employee was using a chipping hammer to remove asphalt from around a manhole cover. The hammer got stuck and an excavator operator attempted to remove the hammer using an excavator bucket. The employee reached down to help when the hammer engaged, causing the bucket to jump and pin the employee's left ring finger between the bucket tooth and the hammer. The employee suffered a fingertip amputation.

Employees were repairing a metal truss. As they lowered it to the ground, its weight shifted toward one of the employees. The employee's left index finger was caught between the edge of the truss and a steel-toe boot and was amputated between the first knuckle and the lower part of the nailbed. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was performing road construction in a closed lane of an overpass. As he was assisting a co-worker in saw-cutting a joint in the overpass, he was struck by an automobile, resulting in a broken right shoulder, right leg, and left middle finger, as well as multiple scrapes and lacerations.
An employee cut his finger with a circular saw he was using to rip trim for a building under construction. He was hospitalized.
An employee was on a step ladder putting sub-fascia on the gable end of a pavilion. The ladder tipped over and the employee fell, hitting their head on a concrete slab. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was moving a 480-volt temporary power pack. An arc flash occurred and the employee's right arm was burned.
An employee was on a roof, finishing trim. The employee fell from the roof to the ground and suffered a broken wrist.

An employee was cleaning an area about 15 feet away from a service road. A tire came off an SUV, struck the curb, bounced up, and struck the employee's back. The employee suffered injuries to the back as well as the left leg.
An employee was removing a rock from a truck's tailgate. When the rock came out, the tailgate closed on the employee's fingertip, causing a soft-tissue amputation.
An employee was stepping off a ladder and onto a roof when they fell 12 feet to the ground, resulting in fractures to their right wrist, multiple ribs, and their pelvis.

An employee was removing straps from a load on a flatbed trailer. The employee slipped and fell to the ground about 4 feet below, resulting in a head laceration, right wrist fracture, and sternum fracture.

An employee was standing 4-feet 8-inches high on rebar and tried to reset the safety hook on his harness. The employee fell to the mud below and landed on the side of his hip where he was wearing a wire reinforcing reel to tie rebar and sustained a broken pelvis.
An employee fell while exiting the cab of a truck mounted attenuator, landing on the ground about 4 feet below and suffering a hip fracture.

An employer was stripping plywood forms from cured concrete. The employee was using a hammer and prybar while standing on a temporary wood deck The employee slipped on the wood deck because it was damp from rain and fell. The employee sustained a fracture left leg.

An employee was setting a steel structural platform using a sleever bar and spud wrench. As he was aligning the beams, they shifted and his left index finger was caught in their holes. The finger was partially amputated.
An employee was running electrical wire and terminating conductors in switch gear. A wire contacted an energized bus bar and an electrical arc flash occurred. The employee sustained burns.
An employee was putting a board under the wheel of a boom lift to help get it out of the mud. The wheel ran over the employee's foot; they were hospitalized with crushed toes.
An employee was on a deck, helping a crane operator adjust a bundle of steel decking. The employee fell to the ground about 18 feet below and suffered a broken shoulder, neck pain, and contusions.

An employee was removing a wire from a panel. Something inside the panel made contact with an energized busway, causing an arc flash. An employee suffered burns to the neck and stomach, as well as burns to the right hand. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was outside a vehicle, speaking to its operator, when that vehicle was struck by another vehicle. The employee was knocked over and suffered a broken humerus and a dislocated shoulder.
An employee was operating a core drill machine. The machine's shaft caught his left little finger, amputating it past the second knuckle.

An employee was tied off with a retractable yoyo and lost his balance. The employee fell, causing the yoyo to lock. The cable then snapped and he fell 15-20 feet to the ground. The employee suffered fractures to the pelvis, leg, and right arm.

An employee was in a man basket, cleaning off beams and removing overhang jacks. The basket was moved while his left hand was on its guardrail, and his middle and ring fingers were crushed between the guardrail and a highway beam. He suffered amputations to the two fingers.

An employee was on a 10-foot step ladder, using a reciprocating saw to cut a piece of ductwork. The employee fell from the ladder to the floor and was hospitalized, having suffered a broken collarbone and two broken ribs.

Two employees were lifting and stacking steel panels (for concrete forms) onto a trailer. The panels measured 2 feet by 8 feet. While stacking one panel on top of another, the injured employee's left index finger got caught between the two panels. The employee suffered crush injuries that required an amputation of the finger above the knuckle.

An employee was removing bolts from the bottom cover on a conveyor system when the remaining bolts pulled through allowing the plate to strike his right foot, resulting in multiple fractures and swelling that required hospitalization and surgery. The employee was wearing steel-toe boots at the time of the incident.

An employee was guiding a push-cart down a ramp into a lower mechanical room. The cart had 12 bags of cement weighting 80 pounds each. The cart pushed the employee down the ramp and pinned his leg was against a housekeeping pad containing a switch gear at the bottom of the ramp. The employee suffered a broken tibia and fibula that required hospitalization.
An employee was looking for a suspected leak in a paint hose when paint from a pinhole leak was injected into his left index finger.
An employee was walking back to his work area when he tripped over a step stool and fell to the floor, resulting in a back injury.
An employee was performing a pressure test on a boiler when a piece of 3/4-inch pipe at floor level came off of a bend, striking the employee's arm and and resulting in an arm fracture.

An employee was setting up their equipment and tools for the day and was going to raise their tools via buckets from a stairwell roof access on the ninth floor. The employee attempted to open the roof access hatch from a ship ladder after the hatch failed to open automatically. Once the employee pushed open the access door, they stepped back on their left foot to get off the ladder. Their left foot slipped and they fell backward off the fifth rung of the ladder, landing on both feet and suffering a fractured left tibia and fibula.

Employees were pouring a concrete thrust block on a 48-inch pipe. The concrete bucket was equipped with a side chute and was lifted by a crane. The injured employee was holding onto the bucket when other employees opened the bucket to place the concrete. As the concrete began dumping out of the side chute, it caused the bucket to shift toward the injured employee and caught his right hand and wrist between the bottom rail of the bucket and the 48-inch pipe. He suffered a broken ulna that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was walking through a construction site to their vehicle when they slipped on ice and fell to the ground, resulting in a broken leg.
An employee was loading the work truck at the end of the day when the roll up door struck their head. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was pulling electrical wire into the attic. While attempting to climb down a portable ladder out of the attic, they fell to the ground below, resulting in two fractured vertebrae in their cervical spine that required hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was caulking ceiling grids inside a store while on an 8-foot ladder. The employee missed the last step while descending the ladder and fell to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured left hip.

On February 12, 2024, at 2:00 p.m., an employee and a co-worker were working from a swing stage scaffold. The employee was talking to the co-worker, who was above him, while standing on the pick board. He was holding a jackhammer. The jack hammer fell, causing both employees to fall. The co-worker was tied off, but the employee fell approximately 30 feet to the ground, resulting in an injury to his lower vertebrae.

An employee was climbing up the side of a wall at a construction site when his right hand fingers were hit by an excavator boom, resulting in a laceration to the ring finger and fractures to the middle and little fingers.
An employee was working in the outbound shipping dock area and climbed on a step stool to close a trailer door. He lost his balance and fell to the floor, resulting in a right leg fracture.
An employee was on a 6-foot ladder. Their foot was caught on the second rung causing the employee to fall approximately 22 inches and sustain a hip fracture.
An employee was on an 10-foot A-frame ladder installing a light fixture. He was shocked and fell off the ladder. The employee sustained fractured vertebrae.
An employee was standing in a doorway. When she shifted her weight, she fell to the vinyl-covered wood floor and suffered a broken right ankle. She was hospitalized.
An employee was moving a cyclone-style conduit bender when the casters hit a gap in the concrete floor causing the conduit bender to fall and fracture their left foot. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was struck by a scissor lift resulting in a fractured right big toe.
The injured employee collided with another person in a hallway. The employee fell backward, landing on the floor and suffering a broken left humerus.

An employee was working from a ladder while putting siding above the garage door of a residential structure when they fell 10 feet to the paved ground below, resulting in lower arm fractures to both arms. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was using a ladder to access a roof to install conduit pipes when the ladder slipped on patio tile and came out from under him, causing him to fall approximately 8 feet to the ground. The employee suffered a spinal fracture and brain bruising.
An employee was removing teeth from a trackhoe bucket with a hammer. A piece of a tooth sheared off and punctured his stomach. He was hospitalized and underwent surgery to remove the piece.
An employee was painting while in an aerial boom lift. The employee sustained facial fractures while operating the lift over rough terrain.

An employee was using a gas-powered saw to cut a wire strap from a bundle of rebar in the back of a truck. When the saw was above his shoulder level, gasoline leaked from it onto his hand and body. The sparks created by the saw then ignited the gasoline, and he suffered a third-degree burn to his left hand and second-degree burns to his left leg. He was hospitalized.

An employee was cutting a service line from a transformer pole to a residence's pole. He was working from a ladder secured to the pole. When the wire was cut, the release of tension caused the pole to split at ground level. The employee was strapped to the pole and fell approximately 20-25 feet to the ground. The employee suffered a brain bleed, concussion, and fractures to an orbital bone and wrist.
An arc flash occurred while an employee was unblocking a 480-volt meter resulting in burns to the employee's face and arm.
An employee was cleaning block walls for waterproofing when he tripped and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured arm.

An employee was standing at the edge of a trench while handing shoring materials to two employees in the trench below. The concrete beneath where the employee was standing gave way causing the employee to fall approximately 8 feet into the trench. The employee was hospitalized with contusions and lacerations to the neck, back, and shoulder.

An employee was refilling the cab heater on a mobile crane. While beginning to pour diesel fuel into the upper cab heater tank, the employee fell 79 inches from the crane to the ground. The employee sustained a broken pelvis that required surgery.

An employee was traversing from one platform to another and fell approximately 60 feet to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured left arm and contusions to the left leg. Guardrails were in place.

An employee was working on an elevated work surface installing cable and fell approximately 20 feet to the ground below. The employee sustained intracranial bleeding. Fall protection was not utilized at the time of the incident.
An employee fell backward out of a scissor lift onto a concrete slab 6 feet below. He hit the back of his head and suffered a broken lower skull. He was hospitalized.

An employee stepped onto a piece of oriented strand board (OSB) that was covering a hole in the bottom of a furnace casing. He fell through the board, landing on the floor at the bottom of the structure, about 12 feet below. He suffered a broken left ankle, a broken right little toe, and a sprained left wrist.

On February 17, 2024, three employees were working on and near a switchgear. An arc flash occurred while one of them was gathering up tools. Two of the employees were hospitalized due to electrical burns and a hearing injury.

An employee was backing up a connected pressure washing trailer to fill it up with water. He slipped out of his truck, and its front driver-side wheel ran over his leg. His tibia and fibula were broken.

An employee was hauling material to the back of the yard using a truck and end dump trailer. After dumping the material, the protective tarp caught on the tailgate and prevented it from fully closing. As the employee removed the tarp from the tailgate, his left hand was caught in a pinch point between the tailgate and the trailer frame when the tailgate dropped. His left hand was crushed resulting in injury to several bones and ligaments. His left wrist was also lacerated and fractured.

An asphalt roller was moving from a staging area to the back of a paver when it slid on the tacked surface. It came to rest against the paver, pinning an employee who had been spotting dump trucks and collecting asphalt load-out tickets from the drivers. The employee suffered a broken pelvis, six broken ribs, and a bruised bladder and was hospitalized.
An employee was walking to the third floor while reviewing a schedule with the subcontractor lead. A set of stairs collapsed and the employee fell to the ground, resulting in broken legs.

An employee was in a scissor lift, that was elevated approximately 15 feet, to run conduit for an AC unit. The employee fell from the lift and sustained fractured ribs. Fall protection was not used at the time.

An employee was participating in a team lift of an HVAC air dryer. The employee's hand slipped and as they tried to reposition and their hand got caught between the air dryer and a threaded bolt, resulting in a severe injury to their hand.

An employee was torching/welding (washing) a spudwell into the base of a barge that was in for repair. While torching (washing) the spudwell, a slag ember dropped inside the employee's protective leather leg sheathing. The employee suffered severe burns from the slag resulting in amputation of the right leg below the knee and multiple surgeries.

The injured employee was spotting for the operator of an mini-excavator. The mini-excavator was about to begin digging when the bucket came down and landed on the injured employee's foot. The employee was hospitalized with a broken foot.

A mechanic was using a hammer to seat a bucket tooth onto an excavator bucket on the jobsite. A chunk of metal flew off the bucket tooth and went under the mechanic's safety glasses and impaled his eye.
An employee was using a pneumatic nail gun, the nail ricocheted and struck the employee next to him in the throat. The employee sustained a puncture wound to the throat.
Employees were unloading rebar from a forklift. One of them was guiding the rebar into position when it slipped off a fork, fell about 4 feet, and broke that employee's left ankle.

An employee was hooking up chains to blocks on the crane arm. The employee slipped and tried to catch themself when their right hand was caught in the crane wires that then began to spin around the pulley. The employee sustained amputation of the right middle finger and lacerations to the ring and little fingers.

On February 22, 2024, an employee was conducting infrared scanning on a switch gear when he unlatched a panel and the metal latch fell into the switch gear box, causing an arc blast explosion. The employee sustained second-degree burns to his right arm.

Two employees were spreading a metal deck when a gust of wind blew a piece of metal that knocked down both employees. One employee suffered bruising and the other employee suffered a fractured toe and was hospitalized.
An employee was crawling in a small attic space when they felt a pop in their back resulting in a lower back injury.
An employee was walking near an excavator when the excavator struck them. They were hospitalized with broken bones in their foot.

An employee was checking poling equipment. He placed his right hand on an energized H1 bushing transformer that was operating at 69 kV. The shock knocked him back, and he received electrical shock burns to his right hand and right foot.

An employee was at the top of a ladder installing fascia. The fascia broke, causing the employee to fall 20 feet to the concrete and dirt ground. The employee suffered two broken lower-back vertebrae and a broken left wrist.
On February 23, 2024, an employee sustained a fractured lower left leg after rebar rolled off a forklift onto his leg.
An employee was on a scaffold performing masonry activities and fell from the scaffold. The employee suffered a broken pelvis.

An employee was picking up scrap wood on the 27th floor and picked up a piece that was covering a hole. When the employee walked forward, he fell through the hole approximately 12 feet landing on the 26th floor. The employee sustained fractured vertebrae and was hospitalized.

Two employees were working in a parked and elevated scissor lift to work on festoon wiring that energized a traversing conveyor system. The conveyor moved and the festoon wiring pushed on the side of the scissor lift. The employees were not able to lower the scissor lift at that point, and when the conveyor moved again, the wiring pushed the scissor lift over. One employee suffered a broken arm and hip and that required surgery and hospitalization. The second employee broke his finger and suffered contusions.

An employee was trying to set a fence post in the ground. The employee retrieved a post driver and was setting the post with it when his finger was caught on the downward motion of the post driver, resulting in an amputation to the fingertip.
An employee was cutting a 2-by-4 with a handheld, battery-powered circular saw. The saw became bound and jerked, then cut his fingertip. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was using a forklift to move pallets near a dumpster. While backing up, the forklift slid on ice and the employee's right hand was pinched between the dumpster and the roll cage, resulting in a partial degloving and broken bones. The injuries required surgery.
An employee was assembling a scaffold. He fell from the ladder he was standing on and suffered an injury to a back vertebra.
An employee was attempting to move a portable heater and strained her back. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was bent over using a battery-operated circular saw to cut plexiglass. The employee lost balance and lacerated the tip of her middle finger resulting in a partial amputation.
A temporary employee was putting a piece of wood under the tire of an insulation vacuum when her hair was pulled into the engine portion of the unit, causing contusions to the head and eyelid.
An employee was cutting wood using a table saw and amputated the tip of his index finger.

An employee was throwing down debris during demolition of a section of the roof on a school building. The employee fell 10 feet to the ground floor, sustained fractures to both ankles, and was hospitalized.

An employee was cutting metal studs on the exterior framing. He used a chop saw blade on a grinder and the blade exploded, resulting in amputation of his left index finger. The grinder was unguarded at the time of the incident.

An employee was leaving a work site on a barge due to adverse weather conditions. While on their way back to shore in a small boat, the boat went up a large swell and when it came back down, it went bow first into another swell and was immediately swamped. All the boat passengers fell into the river water, which was approximately 49.8 Fahrenheit. One employee was hospitalized with hypothermia.
An employee fell through the ceiling while replacing a heater in the attic. The employee sustained cuts, abrasions, and a back injury.

An employee was descending a front-end loader using the steps on the loader and fell to the ground 3-4 feet below. The employee sustained a right hip fracture as well as a fracture of the lower pelvis.
An employee was getting onto a ladder to leave a roof when they lost their footing and fell 20 feet to the ground, causing a left leg fracture.
An employee fell to the ground while erecting a frame scaffold and sustained broken ribs.

On February 29, 2024, an employee was performing a roofing inspection and taking measurements on a 12/12 pitch roof when he lost his footing and fell approximately 11.4 feet to the driveway below. The employee sustained a concussion and fractures to both wrists and their left leg.

An employee was installing metal decking on the leading edge of a second floor and fell approximately 17.5 feet to the ground. He sustained a fractured and dislocated shoulder, a fractured right femoral head, a right hip dislocation, a pelvic fracture, three broken ribs on the right side, and a fractured left wrist.

An employee was dumping trash from a hopper. The latch became stuck, and the employee attempted to free the latch with his left hand. When the hopper released, it clamped back on his hand, resulting in amputation of the left middle fingertip.

Two employees were moving sheetrock down a ramp (garage access ramp) using a drywall cart. The injured employee went to stop the cart as it rolled down the ramp, but the cart hit a steel plate on the ramp and tipped over. The cart and drywall fell on the employee, breaking both legs.

An employee was removing a steel post shore that was supporting a piece of plywood. While he was using a spud wrench to twist the post shore out of place, the post shore's upper section lowered and caught his fingertip, resulting a fingertip amputation.
An employee was struck in the foot by the tire of a skid steer equipped with forks in the front, knocking him down and fracturing his tibia, fibula, and hip. He was hospitalized requiring surgery.
An employee was climbing an extension ladder to access the attic inside a home. The employee fell to the ground, suffering a broken leg and a broken foot.

An employee was climbing down from a top structure, which was sitting on structural steel horses. As the employee climbed down onto one of the horses, he slipped and fell, landing right-hand-first on the ground 36 inches below. His right wrist was broken.

At about 4:00 p.m. on March 2, 2024, employees were preparing a 6-inch carbon steel pipe to be installed on a 21-foot-long, 8-foot-wide pipe rack. An employee's right little finger was pinched between the pipe and the rack, causing a laceration and fracture. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

A crew of three employees was pulling electric cable through 1,200 feet of HDPE conduit. The rope pulling the cable was attached to the bucket of an excavator. The excavator was pulling it back in stages, between which the rope would be untied so the truck could move forward and the rope could be re-tied. When one of the employees untied the rope, the tension in it caused it to catch his right hand and lacerate his middle finger. He was hospitalized.

Four employees were moving a steel panel out of a doorway on a forklift. The panel hit a bollard, spun, fell from the forklift, and pinned an employee's foot against the forklift's headache rack. The employee suffered a compound fracture to the left ankle.
An employee was installing spray foam insulation from the fourth rung of a step ladder. He lost his balance and fell off the ladder, landing on the ground below and suffering seven broken ribs.

An employee started a piece of equipment that was in a container with a propane leak. When the equipment started, it ignited the propane in the container and caused an explosion, burning the employee.
An employee was cleaning the floor when they were struck in the head by a 2x4 board and rendered unconscious.

An employee was unloading a trash hopper into a dumpster using a skid steer with fork attachments when his fingers became crushed between the fork attachment and the trash hopper. This resulted in partial amputation of the index and middle fingers on the left hand.
An employee was walking on a scaffold from one side of an upper roof to the other. He tripped and fell 20 feet to a lower roofline, suffering trauma and multiple fractures.
An employee was on an elevated platform, changing a filter on an HVAC system. He fell to the ground and suffered a punctured lung and a broken clavicle.
An employee was terminating a cable inside an electrical panel. As the employee used a utility knife to strip insulation from the cable, the knife slipped and severely lacerated their right forearm.
An employee was on a ladder running electrical wires. The employee fell from the ladder to the ground and suffered a broken femur.

On March 3, 2024, at approximately 11:00 AM, an employee was moving planks from the seventh tier of a scaffold to the eighth tier, when they lost their footing and fell approximately 10 feet to the outrigger below resulting in a concussion and spine fracture requiring surgery.
An employee was cutting barrel tile for a roof using a circular saw when the saw contacted his arm and lacerated it.
An employee was removing an old window shutter from a residence when it unrolled and struck his hand, lacerating his index finger and fracturing his thumb.

An employee was two steps down from the top of a 12-foot step ladder, repositioning a junction box when the box suddenly slipped, causing him to lose balance and fall to the floor. This resulted in a left arm fracture.
An electrician was working on a motor control center on a bucket when it shorted and caused an arc flash. This resulted in burns to their hands and face.
An employee was fixing a shifting load that was being hoisted on a cable elevator when his gloved hand got caught in the wire rope, amputating his right little fingertip.
An employee was stacking building materials on the ground. The ground was unstable, and the materials fell and broke the employee's right leg.
An employee was climbing down an extension ladder from a roof to the ground. The employee fell to the ground and suffered hip injuries, a punctured lung, and internal bleeding.
An employee was stripping forms when he jumped off a residential foundation at the garage area and landed on his feet on the ground, fracturing his leg.
An employee was cutting a waterline pipe when their saw kicked back and struck them in the jaw, fracturing it.

An employee was washing out the back of a hydro excavation truck when their left middle finger was caught between the hydraulic ram and the back of the debris tank., resulting in a fingertip amputation.
Two employees were performing a walkthrough of a construction site. A stair collapse caused them to fall; both suffered fractures and were hospitalized.

An employee was descending an aluminum extension ladder with tools when he tripped and fell approximately eight feet to the ground, landing on rocks and a garden bed. He fractured two ribs and one vertebra.
An employee was working on a roof when he fell to the ground and sustained fractures to his elbows, ribs, and pelvis.

An employee was standing on an 8-foot ladder about halfway up the rungs (approximately 5 feet off the floor) to reach the ductwork to make the cut with a reciprocating saw. The unit snapped off and swung down, striking the large HVAC unit mounted to the concrete slab and bouncing back into the employee s ladder. The employee jumped off the ladder and landed on both feet on the concrete floor, causing a fracture to the employee s lower left leg.
An employee was using a miter saw attached to a stand to cut a piece of base trim. The base trim kicked and pulled his right hand toward the saw blade, resulting in amputation of the index finger.
A bracket was being removed from a light pole. The bracket slipped, fell, and struck the right hand of an employee who was standing below. The injured employee's right index fingertip was amputated.
An employee was making up an electrical box when he made contact with one of the wires and received a 277 voltage electrical shock.

An employee was working from an 8-foot ladder to install a de-energized conduit wire. The employee was pulling wire above a grid ceiling when they experienced an electrical shock and fell from the ladder to floor, resulting in a head laceration in addition to shock injuries.
An employee was moving a pot of boiling potatoes to the strainer sink and sustained burns to their upper legs from the water.

A crew was tearing off a section of roof over a concrete deck. An employee fell 25-30 feet off the roof edge that had a permanent railing for safety provided by the hospital. The employee suffered fractures and multiple injuries. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was using a saw to cut a handrail post. The wood caught on the saw and the employee's left hand struck the saw blade, resulting in an amputated (medically reattached) middle finger above the middle knuckle and an amputated ring finger between the middle and first knuckle.
An employee was installing stone while on an A-frame. They fell approximately 4 feet to the ground and broke their elbow.

An employee was lifting 4-by-4-foot bundles of insulation on a sling. As they were preparing to rig the next load onto the sling, wind caused some of the bundles to separate and fall to the ground. One bundle struck the employee, resulting in multiple fractures and lacerations.

An employee was helping to install metal trimming on top of a building. The employee was walking backward while pulling the trim when he fell off the roof of the building approximately 11 feet onto the packed gravel below, resulting in a broken right femur.

On March 11, 2024, two employees were inside a tunnel cleaning trash and placing it in an electric cart. Trash fell on the accelerator of the electric cart, causing it to start moving forward while the injured employee was directly in front of it. The cart struck the employee, resulting in three fractured ribs that required hospitalization.
An employee dropped a knife and sustained a stab wound to the stomach as he went to catch it.

An employee was carrying a trash pump toward an excavation site and had to twist his body to step over a downed fence, causing him to fracture his right tibia and fibula. The injury required hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was driving steel H-beams into the ground using a diesel-powered driving hammer when a piston broke in half and came down on their right hand, resulting in a compound fracture to their hand and wrist.

Employees were laying sheathing on the flat roof of an apartment that was being framed when the injured employee fell into a small utility shaft approximately three stories to a temporary platform across the shaft, resulting in cuts, bruises, abrasions, and internal bleeding. The employee was hospitalized.

On March 12, 2024, at 2:00 p.m., an employee was pulling wires through a ceiling-mounted conduit while standing on top of a conveyor system. The employee fell into a trash chute approximately 20 feet to another conveyor with a belt, resulting in an L2 spinal fracture requiring surgery. The employee was wearing a harness but was not tied off at the time of the incident.

An employee was clearing electrical cords away from a forklift during the demolition of a floor. The employee walked to the front of the forklift and stepped on flooring that gave way causing him to fall to a lower level. The employee sustained a broken femur.
An employee was moving from the engine compartment of a crane to the cab when they slipped and fell off the crane, hitting the ground and fracturing their back.
An employee was moving a steel plate when it fell on his toe, injuring it.

An employee and a crew were unloading cap beams from a delivery truck and into a staging area. Some of the beams needed to be flipped in order to access the lifting knives. The beams were flipped using shake-out hooks. The crew was repositioning a flipped beam to line up with previously unloaded beams when the load shifted. The employee's left ring finger got caught between the rigging and flange of the beam, resulting in a partial fingertip amputation.
An employee was troubleshooting an HVAC system at a customer location when his right hand contacted the fan belt and pulley, amputating his thumb to the first knuckle.
An employee was carrying a metal forklift extension when he tripped and fell to the concrete floor. The metal piece fell on his left hand, resulting in an index fingertip amputation.

At a construction site, an employee was reaching up to grab a welding lead from the steel that was one level above her when she fell 12 feet onto the surface below. The employee sustained a concussion, two fractured ribs, and a cut to their left cheek.

An employee was walking on the roof of a metal warehouse building to get an estimate for a job when they stepped on a skylight and fell 14 feet to the floor of the warehouse. The employee sustained broken ribs and lacerations.
An employee was felling a tree when a loose tree limb fell from overhead and struck him, causing him to fall. The employee sustained a fractured right fibula and was hospitalized.

On March 13, 2024, an employee was using a manual hand brake to bend a piece of metal for ductwork. When he closed the jaw of the hand brake on the side he was using, the jaw on the other side closed on his finger. He sustained a fingertip amputation.
An employee was felling a tree when the chainsaw kicked back and contacted their left upper thigh, resulting in a laceration and hospitalization.

An employee was working from a raised bucket truck making up a ground, when their elbow contacted an energized circuit resulting in a 7,700-volt arc flash that caused second degree burns to their torso.

An employee was performing the final alignment of an MSE panel installation while an excavator was parked perpendicular to the MSE wall. During the pushing operation a 4x4x4 wood block that was placed against the panel splintered and broke. When it broke, the force of the excavator bucket pushed the employee through the safety barrier causing him to fall to the ground. This resulted in facial injuries and a fractured arm.

On March 14, 2024, at 1:04 p.m., an employee was conducting a class for students showing how power moved through a city using an electrified model city. The employee was presenting from behind the display holding the activation switch in his left hand and a hot stick in his right hand. The employee reached over the top of the display with the hot stick to reposition a piece on the display and received an electric shock.
An employee was seated in a skid steer when they released the safety, causing a crush injury to their foot. They sustained a laceration under their big toe and two broken bones in their right foot.

An employee was fueling an excavator from the fuel tank in the bed of the truck while standing on the bumper of the truck. The plastic on the bumper broke, causing the employee to fall to the ground and resulting in a fractured right femur just below the joint.

An employee was locating a cable pulling device in a junction box while in a wire mesh basket on a forklift, when the basket became unstable and he lost his balance and fell approximately five feet to the pavement below, fracturing his left elbow.

An employee was pouring grout using a grout delivery system when the back end tilted up and came down on their left arm, lacerating the upper arm and breaking it in three places. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.

An employee was laying down on the ground to grab a hose that was underneath the catwalk area of a mobile belt sludge press trailer, and when standing up, the catwalk unfolded to its normal stationary position impacting the employee in the upper torso, head, and neck. This resulted in a contusion to the neck and back. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was taking a step back when their left foot became lodged between two PVC plumbing conduit stub ups that were protruding through the concrete slab and he fell to the floor, resulting in a lower leg fracture.

An employee went up on the roof using a ladder on the front side of the home and walked over the peak to observe the status of the roof being completed. The back side of the home was in the shade and had a thin patch of ice or frost that caused the employee to slide down the backside of the home and fall approximately 15 feet 9 Inches, resulting in injury that required hospitalization.

An employee was lowering themselves in the basket hoist to assist with adjusting a shim. The corbel came loose and fell onto the basket hoist catching the employee's left middle finger and amputating it at the first joint.

An employee was walking down a slope of 3/4 inch stone when he slipped on a patch of loose crushed stone, rolled his ankle, and fell to the ground. This resulted in a fractured right ankle and fibula.
An employee was working to get a boom lift unstuck when its tires fell into ruts in the yard. This catapulted the employee from the lift, who struck the ground and suffered leg fractures.
An employee was working on a roof when they fell to the pavement, resulting in injuries to the face, arm, and leg. Fall protection was not utilized at the time of the incident.
An employee was transferring energized wires while replacing a power pole when they made contact with a wire. This resulted in an electric shock and second-degree burns.

An employee working on a highway bridge went to have a discussion with a nearby landowner, when he was chased by a dog and slipped or tripped down a slope. He was found on the ground with broken ribs.
An employee was walking down a ramp when he tripped and fell 4 feet off the ramp onto a concrete slab, fracturing his hip and elbow.
An employee was feeding hay into a mulch grinder when his left hand became entangled in the bailing twine resulting in a fracture and amputation to the tip of his middle finger.
An employee was drilling a hole through a form and fell approximately 9 feet to the ground. The employee fractured vertebrae and bruised kidneys and was hospitalized.
An employee was installing the anchor point of a rope grab system when they fell 30 feet off a roof onto the ground, resulting in back injuries and fractures of the arm and foot.

An employee was removing pins and wedge to facilitate the removal of the wall forms. The employee was stationed on the ground and pulled the form off the wall. While the employee was carrying the form a gust of wind caught another form which fell into the form the employee was carrying, causing the employee to lose balance and hit the ground, fracturing his left hip.

An employee was on a trailer next to a jersey barrier to deliver bridge beams. The employee stepped from the trailer to the top of a jersey barrier, missed the barrier and fell over the bridge 15 feet to the ground. The employee sustained a head laceration, a fractured finger, and C2-C3 vertebrae fractures.
An employee was rigging an I-beam to a crane when the beam rolled and crushed his ankle, fracturing it. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was walking on trusses to install insulation around waterpipes in the garage of a residential home under construction, when they fell 8-10 feet onto the floor of the garage. The employee was hospitalized with head injuries.

On March 20, 2024, at approximately 6:15 AM, the injured employee was assisting four other employees in drilling holes for guardrail installation with a pneumatic drill attached to a trailer-mounted air compressor. While moving the air hose, it was pulled taught by the moving trailer and it tripped the injured employee, causing them to strike their head on the pavement and sustain a blood clot to their temple area.
An employee was working on a 20-foot tall scaffold when they stepped on unsupported boards and fell to the ground, resulting in fractures to their back and left ankle.
On March 21, 2024, an employee was constructing walls to raise on the upper level of a structure when a gust of wind knocked the braced wall over. The wall struck the employee, causing a leg injury.

An employee was walking toward a drill rig after turning on the pump when a build-up of pressure forced the pump hose to disconnect from the tremie pipe and the hose struck him in the mouth and jaw. He was hospitalized.

An employee was loading material/equipment onto a track loader bucket. While securing a strap to the equipment, his hand was caught between the track loader bucket teeth and the equipment, resulting in a left finger amputation.
An employee was cutting a pipe that was overhanging a curb when a six-inch piece flew backward and struck the employee, resulting in a fracture to their right tibia.

An employee was hooking down a power trowel to the attachment on a forklift when the soft ground under the forklift shifted and caused it to move. This made the power trowel lunge back and catch the employee's right arm between the power trowel and the forklift, resulting in a laceration on his forearm.
On March 22, 2024, an employee was cutting a 3/4-inch conduit using a battery-powered, handheld portable band saw. The saw lacerated his left index finger.
An employee was spraying fireproofing material from a scaffold and slipped, falling head-first approximately 6 feet to the concrete floor below, resulting in head trauma.

On March 22, 2024, an employee was working in the bucket of a bucket truck, about 20 feet above the ground, trying to remove a temporary power pole. The pole snapped and the employee was thrown, traveling 10 feet into the air before falling to the ground (for a total fall height of about 30 feet). The employee suffered broken ribs and a broken pelvis, as well as a punctured lung. Fall protection was being worn at the time of the incident, but the employee's lanyard was not tied off to an anchor point.

An employee was using a battery-powered scissor lift to load a trailer. The scissor lift shut off halfway up the ramp leading into the back of the trailer, drifted backward, and fell off the side of the ramp. The employee rolled with the scissor lift, jumped off, and was crushed. The employee suffered an open fracture to the left elbow and was hospitalized.
An employee was framing for the installation of roof planks approximately 12 feet high when he fell between the trusses to the ground, resulting in a head injury.
An employee was picking up materials and wood from the work floor when he fell through an uncovered sewer manhole and fell 8 feet to the concrete ground below resulting in fractured ribs.
An employee was decking a roof on a 3-story building when they fell from the roof to the ground, fracturing their chest and spine.
An employee was working on an electrical panel when they received an electrical shock to the left arm.

An employee was operating a boom lift and was ejected when the boom lift struck uneven ground. The employee was wearing a harness and did not fall to the ground, however, when ejected from the basket he hit the side of the basket and sustained a broken arm.

An employee was using a forklift to remove the bollards around a fire hydrant when one of the metal pipes attached to a bollard popped loose, striking the employee's left foot and causing a laceration and fractures.

An employee was pouring concrete forms into a trench when another employee threw a board to him, causing him to fall approximately three feet to the dirt floor of the trench. The employee sustained a fractured shoulder and four or five broken ribs.
An employee climbed off a ladder onto an aluminum roof when they slipped on wet leaves and fell 10 feet to a wooden deck. They sustained a fractured L1 vertebra.

An employee was assisting with moving a tower appurtenance (a bracket used to hold radios on a tower) weighing 250 lbs. when the load shifted as the skid steer exited the driveway. The skid steer tilted forward and the employee's leg was broken.
An employee was doing grading work when they were struck by a front end loader, crushing their leg.
An employee was caulking a wall near an expansion joint while standing on a ladder when the ladder gave way and the employee fell to the concrete floor, resulting in a fractured tibia.

An employee was installing fiber-optic cables in an aerial lift when they made contact with electrified wires, resulting in second- and third-degree burns to their back and right arm, hand, and wrist.

An employee was working from a scissor lift during demolition of an internal wall on the second floor. He removed part of the drywall and intended to pull out a metal stud. A metallic electric conduit ran vertically in proximity of the stud. The conduit was not continuous, and a conduit section in the top part had been removed. A live unprotected cable lost insulation from contact with the stud, causing an electric discharge. The employee was electrocuted and hospitalized.

An employee was climbing an extension ladder to a sloped roof and fell approximately 17 feet to the concrete surface while transitioning from the ladder to the roof. This resulted in a laceration to the head and fractures to the right arm and right ankle.
Employees were accessing the roof of a building to install safety equipment when an employee fell through the skylight to the floor and was hospitalized for fractures to her face, arm and hip.
An employee was on a residential roof performing framing work. The employee fell off the roof, landing on the ground 9 feet 4 inches below and fracturing their arm. The employee was hospitalized.
On March 29, 2024, an employee was cutting a 2x12 on a table saw and amputated his right middle and ring fingers.
An employee was climbing down from a step ladder. The employee missed the bottom step, fell to the floor, and suffered a concussion.
An employee was using a conveyor to convey shingles to a roof. The conveyor's chain and sprocket caught the tip of the employee's left middle finger, amputating it through the finger bone.
An employee was removing a light fixture when the A-frame ladder they were standing on slipped and they fell, fracturing facial bones.
An employee was installing pipe insulation when his foot slipped coming down the step ladder and he fell six feet to the floor, fracturing his left ankle requiring surgery.

An employee was on the 54" drum roller compacting lime rock. When the employee got off the machine he tripped and fell from the top of the roller. He landed on the lime rock and struck his forehead. He was hospitalized.
An employee was replacing a valve on a cooling system when refrigerant gas was released, burning their left hand and lungs.

An employee was unhooking a trailer from a vehicle when the trailer rolled backward over their left leg. They sustained a laceration to the inner thigh and an ankle fracture, resulting in hospitalization.
An employee was pulling wire into a piece of electrical gear when an arc flash occurred, burning their right palm, left arm, face, and chest.

An employee had been operating an excavator from the safety platform and was putting tree limbs onto the belt of a horizontal grinding machine. A limb got stuck in the grinder. Employees raised the anvil and the limb was removed. When the anvil was being lowered back down, the employee's right foot got crushed between the top of the anvil guard and the grinder frame. They sustained two toe fractures and a partial amputation to one toe.
An employee was climbing a roof access ladder when he lost his grip and fell backward over a half-wall approximately 20 feet to the lower landing, resulting in a broken femur.

An employee was removing screws from a piece of plywood that was acting as a temporary door when the plywood fell and their finger became caught between an attached 2x4 and a piece of sheet metal, resulting in amputation of the finger.

An employee was working on a construction site when a tornado hit a nearby residential home and caused the roof to blow off and it struck them in the left leg. This resulted in an injury to the leg and hospitalization.

An employee was standing on the fourth rung of a 6-foot ladder while pushing fish tape when the fish tape got stuck. As the employee shifted their weight, the ladder shifted and fell out from under them, causing them to fall head-first to the concrete ground. This resulted in head trauma.

An employee was descending a 15-foot extension ladder from a roof after disconnecting an old unit. The ladder slipped on wet asphalt and the employee fell to the ground. They sustained fractures to both ankles and a lower back disc protrusion.

A contracted employee was working from a scissor lift to route electrical piping for an LED light installation when the lift was struck by a gantry crane and fell over. The employee landed on the ground and sustained a fractured nose and orbital bone.
An employee was walking when they tripped over a box and fell to the concrete floor, resulting in a leg fracture.

An employee was resuming re-roofing operations and walking on the lower roof. His anchor plate detached from the roof causing him to lose balance and fall approximately 10 feet to the surface below. The employee suffered fractures to their tibia, calcaneus, fibula, and L1 vertebra as well as renal insufficiency.

An employee was expanding the core of a precast concrete form with an air hose when their left hand fingers became caught in a pinch point between the bottom and inner portions of the form, resulting in multiple fingertip amputations.
An employee was welding a motor that was on a pallet lifted 3 feet by a forklift. The motor slid off the forklift and struck the employee, fracturing their pelvis.
An employee was performing maintenance on a 6-inch valve and herniated their back as they reached for a flange valve tool.
An employee was ascending a ladder on an active construction site when he fell 9-14 feet to the ground. The employee sustained two broken arms and a laceration to his face.

An employee was walking on a third-floor roof with a bucket of hot roofing asphalt in each hand when he tripped and fell, landing on the asphalt. This resulted in burns to his face, buttocks, left foot, and right arm between the wrist and shoulder.

An employee was working from an aerial lift when they slipped and their safety harness ripped, causing them to fall 37 feet to the dirt surface below. They sustained fractures to ribs, both collar bones, vertebrae, and also sustained contusions to the lungs.

An employee was installing an armored joint when it became caught in a machine used to place concrete. He kicked it with his foot to dislocate it from the equipment and when it came free it struck his right foot, lacerating his foot through the work boot and fracturing it.
A work crew was removing a wire reel from a digger derrick. A reel fell and struck an employee's left leg, fracturing it.
An employee was spraying foam insulation in a new residential construction when they fell from a scissor lift to the concrete ground. The employee was hospitalized with broken arms.
On April 4, 2024, a temporary employee tripped over a pipe vise, fell, and sustained a broken leg. He was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was moving an electrical cable reel when they fell approximately 4 feet 7 inches from the back of a dump truck to the ground. They fractured their right leg and were hospitalized.
An employee was working as a flagger on a highway construction site when they were struck by a vehicle. The employee sustained a fractured left hip and a laceration above the right eye.
An employee was standing on a 2-by-4, installing a soffit vent. The 2-by-4 broke and the employee fell to the ground, suffering a partially collapsed lung and a bleeding kidney.

An employee was troubleshooting an open circuit at the solar panel power generating area. When he disconnected the connectors from the power generating panel an arc flash occurred., causing third-degree burns to the tops and palms of each of his hands.
An employee was moving power lines at a transmission substation that tested as deenergized. When he picked up the ground line, he was shocked. When energized, the electrical line carries 3,400 volts.
An employee was using a chipping hammer for selective demolition when the chipping hammer struck an electrical line, resulting in electrocution and burns.

An employee was ascending a scaffold ladder when his foot missed a rung and he lost balance and jumped from the ladder, landing on his feet on the ground. He fractured both of his ankles and two vertebrae.

An employee was cleaning the bed of a dump truck and had the bed lifted and the tailgate propped open on a block of wood. When finished, they manually closed the tailgate and when the wood block was removed the tailgate fell on their left hand, resulting in surgical amputation of the index fingertip to the first knuckle.
An employee was setting up an extension ladder to access the roof of a house when the ladder contacted a power line, resulting in an electric shock and hospitalization.
An employee was attempting to secure the top of their ladder when they slipped and fell to the ground, resulting in a back injury.

On April 5, 2024, at around 8:45 PM, a 100-ton crane was being towed when the crane's brakes overheated and caught fire. While putting out the fire, a tire caught fire and exploded. Shrapnel and debris struck an employee's right leg resulting in lacerations and avulsions to the leg. They also sustained contusions to their left foot.
An employee was tied off to a column that fell over, causing them to fall 5 feet to the concrete. They sustained a head injury and internal bleeding in the chest.

An employee was handling metal sheet piles during installation. The piles were suspended by an excavator and guided into position by hand. The employee's left hand was caught between the suspended sheet and the installed sheet adjacent to it while a pile was lowered into position. The employee sustained a laceration to the tip of the ring finger and two broken bones and a laceration to their left pinky.

An employee jumped off a wire pulling machine and struck their lower leg and abdomen on a steel grounding rod. The employee suffered a laceration/puncture to the lower abdominal area and was hospitalized.

An employee was driving a scissor lift (in the down position) up a wooden site-built ramp. He had to turn the lift to the right as he started climbing the ramp. The left front wheel of the lift dropped off the edge of the ramp, causing the lift to tilt slightly to the left. The employee jumped out and landed on his right elbow on the concrete floor. His humerus was broken just above the elbow.

A three-person crew was setting up a pipe stand for a 40-foot-long pipe. With one person handling each side of the pipe stand, the raised roller part of the stand was lowered into the socket of the stand. The injured employee's right ring finger was caught between the stand and the adjustment nut, resulting in an injury that led to the amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was moving a 5-gallon bucket of a masonry cleaning product. The bucket lid came off and the product spilled onto the employee, who sustained a chemical burn on the right leg.

An employee was climbing a ladder to access a roof. The ladder was on an unstable surface, and when the employee reached the top, the ladder slipped and he fell. He landed on the ground about 20 feet below and suffered a broken back and hip and had no feeling in his leg.

An employee was on a ladder taking measurements for a gutter replacement project. The ladder slipped and the employee fell 8 or 9 feet striking his face. The employee suffered a fractured bone in his face and was hospitalized.
An employee fell off a sidewalk shed that was being repaired. The employee landed on the ground about 12 feet below and suffered a broken elbow.
An employee was moving doors using a pallet jack. The employee slipped on cardboard on the floor, fell, and sustained a sprained wrist.

An employee was cutting metal channeling on a portable bandsaw when the blade moved across the metal and contacted their left index finger, resulting in a laceration that required hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was taking pieces of the old roof from the side of the house and walking across the roof to toss them in a dumpster, lengthening the safety rope as she went. When she returned to the side of the roof she leaned over to grab pieces of old roof and fell to the ground due to the length of her safety rope. She sustained fractures to her hip, elbow, and wrist, bruising to her kidney, and the loss of two teeth. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was disassembling an arrow board sign for traffic control when the top section fell on part of the employee's right hand. This resulted in a broken index finger and a laceration to the hand. The employee was hospitalized.
