On April 11, 2024, an employee was working on a steel platform when he stepped on a loose metal plate and fell 19 feet to the ground. He sustained broken ribs and a left shoulder dislocation.

An employee was in a bucket truck trimming the upper limbs on a dead tree. They returned to the ground when a large limb at the top of the tree came loose and struck them in the head and shoulder. The employee was hospitalized with a facial laceration and head and spine injuries.

An employee was hooking a roll-off container truck tow cable to a roll-off storage tank from between the truck's elevated guide rails and the metal tank. Their right leg became pinched between the guide rails and the metal tank when the truck backed up to get closer to the tank. This resulted in a fractured tibia and a laceration to the calf.
An employee was bending sheet metal when their right hand went under the clamp, resulting in a fractured thumb and injury to his right hand.
An employee was using a circular saw to cut a round board for pole lights. The board bent causing the saw to kick back and resulting in amputation to the employee's left thumb.
An employee was placing an 8-inch pipe fitting into a toolbox. The fitting slipped and caught the employee's finger against other items in the box. The employee sustained a fingertip amputation.
An employee was paving a road when an excavator backed over his right foot. He suffered a broken toe.
An employee was erecting walls when they fell 40 feet from the fourth floor to the concrete ground level below, resulting in a back injury and fractures to their hips, legs, and ankles.
An employee was working on a ladder at a residential site with a 6-foot eave. The employee fell from the ladder to the concrete below, suffering back and head injuries. The employee was hospitalized.

Three employees were tasked with unclogging dust from a baghouse. The dust was a byproduct of asphalt that had accumulated and clogged the piping in the baghouse. This dust can range in temperature from 220-265 degrees Fahrenheit. While the three employees were unclogging the baghouse using wands, the dust shot out, causing the injured employee to fall backward and land on his back. The dust then fell on top of him, resulting in second-degree burns to his torso and arms.
An employee was climbing a scaffold while carrying a hammer drill in his hand when he fell approximately 10-15 feet to the ground, resulting in a broken left ankle that required hospitalization.

At about 9:30 a.m. on April 15, 2024, an employee was clearing dirt from around a manhole that was being replaced. While moving a guide wire out of the way, he was shocked and lost consciousness. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was on the third rung of a 6-foot step ladder while torquing bolts with a 24-inch torque wrench. The socket slipped off the bolt and the employee lost his balance and fell from the ladder to the dirt field below. The employee landed on his left leg, resulting in a fracture to his left leg between the knee and ankle. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was working on the third floor of a construction site attaching trusses when a hoisted truss caught his safety lanyard, causing him to fall to the ground below. The employee suffered multiple fractures in his legs.
An employee was installing insulation in an attic and sustained heat stroke.
An employee was utilizing a battery-operated circular saw to cut a 6-inch back-form board when the saw blade struck their left hand, resulting in lacerations to the middle and ring fingers.
An employee was breaking down an old window for scrap metal. The window glass broke and lacerated the employee's lower left leg.

An employee was working along the edge of a six-foot-deep excavation when he slipped and fell in the opening. The employee's leg was caught between an existing pipe and the wall of the excavation causing fractures that required hospitalization.

An employee was laying out for truss hangers. He lost balance while reaching to measure and fell off an A-frame ladder. The employee was hospitalized for lacerations to the left hand, wrist, and forearm.

On April 17, 2024, an employee was installing cross arms while in an aerial bucket truck when a 14,400-volt line became pinched between the bucket and a pole. The line was severed, causing an arc flash. The employee sustained second-degree burns to the left side of their body, arms, and face.
An employee was blowing insulation in an attic when they tripped over wiring and fell through the drywall to the ground below, sustaining three lumbar vertebrae fractures.

An employee was standing approximately 7 feet up an 8-foot ladder while taping a covering on a window prior to painting. The employee fell off the ladder onto the pavement below, resulting in right arm and lumbar fractures.
While dismantling a mold, an employee's left hand fingers were in a hole and one of the metal panels moved, crushing and amputating their left middle fingertip.
An employee was installing cameras when they slipped off their ladder and fell about 8 feet to the ground below. The employee suffered a concussion and was hospitalized.

On April 18, 2024, at approximately 7:30 a.m., in the interstitial space in the attic at a customer location, an electrical apprentice was investigating a potentially damaged electrical conduit/fitting when an arc flash occurred. The employee was hospitalized and treated for first- and second-degree burns to the face and neck, and second- and third-degree burns on the right arm.
A crew was relocating a stack of cable trays (10 feet x 24 inches) on a push cart when a bundle shifted, causing the injured employee's fingertip to get pinched and amputated in the trays.

An employee was operating a skid steer in a work zone to unload gravel from a dump truck. The dump truck's brakes failed and the truck struck the skid steer. The skid steer operator sustained broken ribs, a broken collar bone, and a concussion.
An employee was installing a garage door opener when the door activated and knocked them off the ladder, resulting in a fractured arm.

Two employees were loading the directional drill bit into the bucket on a backhoe when the drill bit slipped and the injured employee's right ring finger was crushed between the drill bit and the bucket, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was standing on a road, flagging traffic to slow it down inside a work zone. A passenger vehicle struck another vehicle that was parked off the roadway. While avoiding that vehicle, the employee fell and struck their head on the pavement. The employee suffered head and shoulder injuries (including a wound to the back of the head that required staples) and lost consciousness. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was putting dishes away and picked up a plate that was hot. Both of the employee's hands were burned.

An employee was installing steel decking. As the employee lifted the decking to adjust it, the decking slipped and pinched their left hand, lacerating the left index finger and cutting a tendon in the finger.
An employee was dismantling tube scaffolding. He fell from the scaffolding to the ground about 6 feet below, suffering an injury to a vertebra.

On April 19, 2024, an employee was drilling a hole in a metal plate. He grabbed a rag and brush to remove metal shavings from the surface area around the drill when the rag got caught inside the drill bit, pulling his right hand toward the machine. The employee suffered a fingertip amputation of his right index finger that required hospitalization.
An employee was walking near a trackhoe when the trackhoe veered left and struck the employee's lower left leg and fractured it.

An employee was preparing to install a ground on a de-energized line. The employee was clipping in the top phase and the static wire after a wire pull on a 115kV aerial electrical transmission line. The employee leaned over the basket and reached out, grabbing the phase/dolly. The induced voltage that had collected in the de-energized line caused electrical burns to their right little finger and lower right leg and they were hospitalized.
An employee was putting a lid onto a manhole. The employee's right index finger was caught between the lid and the edge of the manhole, resulting in amputation.
On April 22, 2024, a highway construction employee was working on pavement markings on an interstate when a passing vehicle struck them, resulting in a fractured leg and hospitalization.

On April 22, 2024, at 2:10 PM, an employee used a hammer to strike a pre-cut mitered end off a concrete pipe that was supported on the forks of a frontend loader. A piece of the concrete pipe broke off and fell onto their right foot, fracturing their big toe. The employee was hospitalized.

One employee was sawing a wall while the injured employee was vacuuming water behind the section that was being cut. The wall fell down when the saw was removed from the wall and struck the injured employee, resulting in a broken arm and jaw.
An employee plugged in panel strings from the big lead assembly (BLA) and received a shock, resulting in burns to their hands.

An employee was acting as a spotter while a forklift traveled through congested areas at a worksite. The forklift load (a box of solar panels) tipped over and struck the employee, who suffered a broken pelvis and ribs. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was troubleshooting an electrical circuit in a junction box from an 8-foot step ladder when an electrical shock from the junction box caused them to lose their balance and fall from the ladder. They struck their head on a wall. They sustained a bump and laceration to the forehead and bruised ribs.

On April 23, 2024, at approximately 4:45 p.m., an employee was working from a ladder, lost balance, and fell backward about 3 feet to the ground. The employee was hospitalized for fractures of their T7 and T8 vertebrae.
On April 23, 2024, an employee was working on a rolling frame scaffold when they fell and fractured their left leg. They were hospitalized.
An employee was cutting fencing material using a table saw when the material caught on the saw and their left hand contacted the blade. This resulted in a laceration to the palm of their hand.
An employee was descending a ladder into the basement of a new home when the ladder slipped and he fell about nine feet onto the concrete floor, fracturing his right arm and hip.

The injured employee was holding a wood stake with their right hand while another employee used a double jack hammer to hit the stake. The jack crushed his left middle finger against the stake. He was hospitalized and his left middle finger was partially amputated.

An employee had been working subgrade material with a motor grader. While parked, he opened the door to get out and talk with a co-worker. He was holding the door as a gust of wind swung the door open and threw him out. He landed on his feet and fell over, sustaining a fractured left tibia. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was placing a securing pin into a trench box. The pin slipped, pinching his right gloved hand in the cylinder. His thumb was broken and he was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a coil bending machine when his finger became pinched in the mandrels of the machine, resulting in amputation.
An employee was standing near the end of a pipe when a pipe-cleaning pig exited the pipe and struck them in the arm, fracturing their humerus and radius.

At about 3:00 p.m. on April 24, 2024, an employee was working on the roof of a new construction single-family residence with a roofing crew. The employee fell while crossing from one side of the roof to the other, landed on the ground, and was injured. The employee was hospitalized. Fall protection was not being worn at the time of the incident.

An employee was using a cordless drill to drill a hole when their glove became caught and their left little finger was pulled into the bit extension. The employee sustained an amputation to their fingertip.

An employee was in a bucket truck 28 feet in the air, using a lasher to bond wire to the span wire of a traffic light. An arc flash shocked the employee, who suffered third-degree burns to the upper body, neck, head, and arms.

Two employees were removing debris from the floor of a basement during a demolition when the basement wall collapsed. One employee had bruising while the other was hospitalized for internal bleeding in the abdomen.

Two employees were lifting a hydraulic tank when the tank slipped and crushed the injured employee's right index finger against a trailer, resulting in an amputation of the finger and hospitalization.
An employee was drilling a pilot hole for a new primary in a pad-mount transformer and sustained electrical burns to their right middle and little fingers, wrist, and right and left big toes.
Employees were performing roadway painting activities when three employees were struck by a motor vehicle. One employee was hospitalized with a concussion, scratches, and bruising.
An employee was using a table saw to cut wood when a kick back occurred, resulting in internal abdominal injuries.

On April 25, 2024, an employee was guiding a skid steer that was carrying a 400-pound wire puller. The wire puller tipped over and fell off the skid steer onto the employee resulting in a fractured lower left leg and hospitalization.

An employee was adjusting a commercial grill at a restaurant and using a hydraulic platform lifter. They were placing the stovetop back onto its platform when the lift equipment started to roll. The grill then slid, and the employee's right little finger was crushed underneath the stovetop. The employee sustained partial amputation of the finger.
An employee was troubleshooting an electrical outage when the building's electrical transformer arced and the employee sustained severe burns to their face, neck, arm, and hands.
An employee was walking on a construction floor when he tripped over a protruding piece of rebar and landed on his right hip on the concrete floor, fracturing it.

An employee was standing on the fourth or fifth rung of a double-sided, 8-foot ladder and handing a duct up to another employee when the leg of the ladder broke and he fell to the concrete floor, landing on his side and head. The employee was hospitalized with five cracked ribs, a contusion and laceration to the skull, and a bruised lung.
An employee was descending a ladder and missed a rung. They fell to the ground and fractured a hip.

Two employees removed a portable generator from the back of a truck and carried the generator to a cargo container. When they set the generator down the injured employee's right little finger was pinched between the cargo container and the frame of the generator, resulting in a partial amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was installing low-voltage computer conduit in a 9-foot ceiling while working from an 8-foot A-frame ladder. The employee fell to the floor and sustained facial fractures and head injuries including subdermal hematomas.

An employee was setting up a hose to be used for dust control. They were standing approximately 15 feet from the inside of the perimeter fence and were approximately 30 feet outside of the demolition area when they were struck by debris (wood, drywall, and insulation) and sustained a fractured neck vertebra that required surgery.
Wooden stairs were being relocated and became entangled in adjacent netting. An employee climbed the stairs to untangle it and fell 3-4 feet to the ground. He was hospitalized with a fracture.

An employee was repairing a power line that was damaged during a storm. A line from another pole came off a damaged cross-arm and contacted the power line the employee was repairing. The employee sustained electrical shock and burns.
An employee exited a dump truck and was standing in front of it when it started to roll forward. The dump truck struck the employee causing fractures and contusions to their lower extremities.

An employee was standing on an six-foot A-frame ladder cutting a metal pipe using a battery operated saw. The saw blade got stuck in the pipe, causing the employee to fall about four feet to the floor, resulting in injuries to the employee's right hand, ankle and hip.

Employees were in the process of moving an electrical switch gear with a forklift. The injured employee was helping to set the equipment correctly on the forks of the forklift when the equipment fell and broke the employees legs.
An employee was climbing a partition wall form when the form support leg kicked out and the form tipped over. They were caught between the form and the concrete floor, resulting in a fracture.
An employee was moving drywall when it fell and pinned him against the wall. He sustained a fractured left tibia and fibula.

An employee was installing insulation on the ceiling above the elevator shaft when he lost his balance and fell 15 feet from the scaffold down the elevator shaft. He sustained an injury to his spine and head trauma including a concussion, laceration, bruising, and abrasions.
An employee was transporting a bucket of hot tar when it tipped over and the hot tar burned their hand.

An employee was repositioning a crane to a different location when the crane tipped over onto its side. The employee jumped off the crane 10-12 feet to the ground below, resulting in multiple fractured back vertebrae.
An employee was retrieving scaffolding boards. When he removed a support strap on the stack of planking the boards collapsed on him. He sustained deep tissue bruising and was hospitalized.

An employee was inside of an excavation assisting in drilling operations when their left foot was pinched between the drill rig's jaw table and a retention wall. They sustained a fracture to their heel bone that required surgery.
An employee was cleaning a clogged paint spray gun when the line detached from the ball valve fitting, lacerating his right thumb.

An employee was moving a pallet on a roof when they fell through an opening in the roof approximately 14 feet and 9 inches to the room below. They sustained bruising/abrasions to the head, legs, back, and hips.
As an employee was moving on the top of a retaining wall when he fell 16-20 feet due to loose soil. He sustained fractures to lower back vertebrae.

An employee was operating a high-pressure water hose used in hydro-excavation to dig around a concrete base. The hose had a small rupture toward the coupling at the working end and it pierced their skin through their glove. High-pressure water was injected into their left thumb.
An employee reached for a band saw hanging on the wall when the weight of the tool caused the trigger to be pressed. When it activated, it cut through his gloves to the bone.
An employee was working from a scaffold when it collapsed and they fell 12 feet, resulting in fractured vertebrae in their back.
An employee was using an overhead crane to lift a steel beam (880 pounds, 16 feet) from his workstation. The beam swung toward him and fell about 4.5 feet onto the top of his foot, crushing it.
An employee was walking when they tripped into a door and fell to the ground, fracturing their tibia and fibula.

On May 2, 2024, an employee was installing a staircase in the stairwell while standing on two wooden boards when a board broke and he fell backward 9 feet to the concrete floor. He sustained a fracture to his right tibia.
An employee was operating a chop saw when they sustained lacerations to four fingers on their left hand, resulting in amputation of their index finger.
An employee was running wires for new construction when the power wires grounded out and caused a flash, resulting in flash burns.

An employee was horizontally pulling air pre-heater baskets with a come-along connected to a pad eye on the basket. The pad eye broke off the basket and flew toward the employee, hitting him on the forehead. He sustained a laceration, fractured skull, and hemorrhage.
An employee was operating a power buggy loaded with spoil pile when it rolled over onto its side and they fell from the buggy to the ground, fracturing their right ankle.
An employee was removing masonry wall bracing when a 16-foot plank fell and struck them on the head. They were paralyzed from the waist down and hospitalized.

An employee was installing electrical wiring at the third floor when they fell through an uncompleted stair case to the ground of the first floor, resulting in a concussion and fractures to their arm and pelvis.

An employee was working on the roof of a one-story residence when he fell approximately 10 feet to the ground. He lost consciousness and sustained a concussion and fracture near the tailbone. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was performing electrical work when they fell from a ladder to the ground, sustaining cracked ribs. The employee was hospitalized.

On May 6, 2024, an employee was installing water pipelines and cleaning the area when they were struck in the right leg by the front loader bucket of a backhoe. They sustained a fractured lower leg and were hospitalized.
An employee was climbing up a ladder and missed a step when he was approximately 5 feet high. He fell to the ground and sustained fractures to his lower back.
An employee was using a battery-powered saw when their left index fingertip contacted the saw and was amputated.

An employee was cutting wood on a floor web saw when a piece of wood got stuck. While unjamming it, his right hand became caught in the saw and half of his right little finger was amputated. The machine was not adequately guarded at the time.

Two employees were working below a roof rack while a porch roof was being set. A gust of wind moved the roof rack of the first floor walls, causing the support straps to move out of balance. The rack became unstable and fell from the wall onto the two employees. One employee sustained fractures to his jaw and both eye sockets, requiring hospitalization. The other employee was hit on the chest but did not require hospitalization.

An employee was retrieving trimmed tree branches from the ground when a branch came down and struck them in the head and the left side of their face. They sustained a head injury, laceration, and swelling.
An employee was hanging steel in the heat all day and began experiencing heat-related symptoms when they arrived at home. They were hospitalized for heat exhaustion and dehydration.

An employee was adjusting the tip of the spray nozzle of a silicone pressure washer when pressurized silicone was released and injected into his left index finger. He was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was changing out attachments to an excavator boom and connecting hydraulic lines when the thumb piece on the boom engaged, resulting in a fracture to their left foot.
An employee was laying on a steel beam when a rough-terrain boom lift struck the beam with a rear tire and ran over his left thigh. He sustained a compound fracture to his femur.
An employee was using a circular saw to cut a piece of wood when the blade jumped and landed on his left thumb, resulting in the amputation of the thumb.
On May 7, 2024, an employee fell from a 20-foot extension ladder to the ground and sustained a fractured L3 vertebra.

A warehouse shipping and receiving employee was walking to receive a delivery and began to feel dizzy, displayed confusion and slurred speech, had full body convulsions, and was feeling hot. The employee was hospitalized for heat stroke.

On May 8, 2024, an employee was guiding a piece of lattice tower into position with a tower crane being operated by another employee. Their foot became caught between the existing concrete pipe and the pipe attached to the lattice, resulting in a laceration to their left foot.
An employee was walking beside an excavator as it was moving forward when they were struck by the excavator, resulting in a fractured right leg.
An employee was loading waste materials into a dumpster when he twisted and felt a pop in his back. He sustained a pinched nerve.

An employee was assisting a crew from another company in relocating a motor control center (MCC) panel with a boom truck. The boom truck flipped on its side and came to rest at approximately a 45-degree angle. The boom contacted a large tank which stopped the truck from turning completely on its side. The employees then placed the MCC panel that was being hoisted on the ground. After resting it on the ground, it shifted and fell toward the employees. The injured employee attempted to run but there was clay slurry in the area which hindered the exit path. The injured employee was struck in the left heel by the MCC panel, which resulted in a broken heel bone and a detached Achilles tendon.
An employee was bent over laying down temporary tape to reopen the zone and was struck by a flatbed truck making a left turn. The injured employee sustained a broken leg.
An employee was relocating a light fixture when he fell from the ladder to the ground, resulting in a fractured leg. He was hospitalized.

The injured employee was performing maintenance work on a crane using mobile stairs. Another employee was retracting the extensions when the fork assembly caught the stairs and caused them to tip over. The injured employee jumped from the stairs and landed on his feet on the floor, fracturing his right foot.
An employee was descending a fiberglass step ladder when he fell 3-4 feet to the concrete floor, resulting in numbness in his left hand, a bruised head, cracked vertebrae, and a collapsed lung.
While an employee was crossing over the span to get materials, he fell approximately 12 feet to a lower level and fractured his right wrist.
An employee was on a ladder installing a light fixture in a 12-foot ceiling. He lost his balance and fell to the floor, sustaining head and back injuries.

An employee was making a repair to a fan that was secured to a shipping pallet with bolts. He removed the shipping bolts and stood the fan vertically on the pallet when he lost his grip and his right index fingertip was caught between the fan flange and the shipping pallet. He sustained a fingertip amputation.

An employee was using an electrical power unit in a two-foot hole dug close to the home, when the power unit surged with electricity. The employee received an electrical shock, then hit his head as he lost consciousness and sustained a cut on the forehead.
An employee was putting concrete rip rap in a wheelbarrow when they tripped and the 12-inch x 14-inch concrete rip rap fell on their hands, crushing their fingers. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee fell through a floor opening more than 6 feet to the basement floor, resulting in head and neck injuries.

An employee was mixing mortar mix in a mixer and was trying to scrape dry mortar off the drum. While doing so, the employee's fingers got pinched between the paddle and the drum, causing a partial amputation to the left middle finger.
On May 9, 2024, at 2:45 PM, an employee was on a ladder hanging a light fixture and fell. The employee sustained a laceration to their hand from the glass globe and was hospitalized.

On May 10, 2024, an employee was loading a paving roller onto a low-boy trailer. While driving up the ramp, the machine and the employee fell off the side of the ramp causing the employee's foot to be caught under the paving roller. He sustained fractures in his left foot.
An employee was descending the ladder of a tower crane during severe weather when they were blown and fell from the crane to the ground, injuring their shoulder.

An employee was lifting the lid to a control panel on an underground wiring pulling machine when the lid fell and caught their right ring fingertip, crushing it. They sustained an open displaced fracture of the distal phalanx of the finger, and a partial amputation through the phalanx.
An employee was sanding a piece of concrete in a manhole with a gas-powered saw when they lost consciousness from a lack of oxygen and were hospitalized.
An employee was carrying a grill while working at a job site when they tripped and fell to the ground, resulting in a compression fracture to the T9 vertebra. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was replacing an air condition system while on a roof when they stepped back out of the way of the moving crane and onto a skylight. They fell 19 feet and 7 inches through the skylight to the ground floor below. The employee sustained a concussion, sore upper back and neck, bruises, and lacerations. They were hospitalized.

Two employees were cutting two feet off the bottom of an 8-inch vertical pipe inside a wet well when the block on top of the pipe shifted and the pipe fell. The injured employee's left wrist was crushed between the existing flange and the bottom of the pipe. The employee sustained three fractures.

An employee was operating a demolition saw to cut into a 6-inch ductile water main pipe for a new water connection in a trench. The pipe shifted, causing the saw to kick back and strike the employee, resulting in a 6-inch laceration to their right arm bicep/shoulder.
An employee was standing on a foundation wall while finishing concrete in a garage when he fell backward to the concrete floor of the basement, resulting in a back injury and loss of consciousness.
An employee was climbing a ladder to access a roof. He fell from the ladder to the pavement below, suffering a head injury and losing consciousness. He was hospitalized.
An employee was securing an excavator to a trailer for transport when they tripped and fell off the trailer. The employee sustained a broken heel and was hospitalized.

An employee was installing a guardrail near a power pounding unit when the drive shaft to the unit broke and his hand became caught between the boom on the pounder and the guardrail. This resulted in hospitalization and the surgical amputation of a finger.

A welder was working from the basket of an articulating boom lift to cut (weld) a bridge girder. The girder fell into the lift basket and pulled down the lift with the employee in the basket. The employee sustained a spinal injury and broken ribs and was hospitalized.
An employee was dismounting a step ladder when their foot missed the first rung and they fell to the ground, fracturing their right hip and required surgery.

On May 15, 2024, an employee was installing piles in a solar field using a pile driver to push metal C-channels into the ground. The hammer crushed their left hand, resulting in lacerations on their hand and fingers that required surgical repair.

An employee was installing horizontal bracing. They were approximately 32 feet high in an extended scissor lift when one of the wheels broke off. The scissor lift tipped over and the employee struck the ground, sustaining a concussion and two broken ribs.

An employee was drilling into concrete using a battery-operated rotary hammer drill when his glove became stuck in the drill bit and it pulled his left little finger in. He sustained an amputation to the fingertip.
An employee was descending an A-frame ladder when he fell 9 feet to the freshly graded dirt. He sustained a fractured wrist and a ruptured spleen that required surgery.

Employees were developing a plan to inspect/reinstall a perforated plate (precipitator transition piece) that dropped out from underneath the east inlet nozzle. The injured employee's left hand became caught in the plate when it slid, amputating their middle fingertip.

An employee was using a corded portable grinder to cut off the top of bolts around the trim of a tempered glass window frame/pressure plate in order to reseal a sloped tempered glass system. He was on a piece of foam on the glass panel. The grinder nicked the glass causing it to shatter. The employee fell through the glass to the floor 10 feet below sustaining cuts and punctures from the glass, and a brain bleed/concussion. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was performing flagging duties when a vehicle turned and the front right fender struck their lower left leg, resulting in a fractured tibia.

An employee moved from a trench box to a man hole box to clean around a sump pipe with a shovel. An excavator was moving a steel plate used for shoring in the man hole box. The steel plate fell onto the bridge of the employee's foot, dislocating their ankle and fracturing several bones on top of the foot.
A severe storm caused the collapse of a crane boom on a construction site. The crane boom landed on top of an employee, resulting in back fractures.
An employee was installing a toilet. While seating the complete toilet, the tank broke and lacerated the employee's wrist.
An employee was standing on a six-foot A-frame ladder with a bucket to set up a worksite when they slipped and fell to the concrete surface below, resulting in a fractured arm and orbital socket.
An employee was installing a brick fa ade when they fell approximately 6 feet from a scaffold, landing on the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a fracture to their leg, above the ankle.

An employee lowered the boom on the pump truck and was positioning the tip where it was needed. A weld on the boom broke causing a lower section to become unpinned and strike the employee's ankle resulting in a fractured ankle. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was using a utility knife and lacerated their left wrist.

Two contractor employees were working with customer personnel to install 6" blind skillets between a natural gas valve and flange couplings. While attempting to spread flange couplings apart to install the blind skillet, gas began leaking from the flange separation. A contractor employee attempted to seal the leak by pumping grease into the 6" valve fitting using a battery-operated grease gun. While doing so, the escaping gas ignited and the fire engulfed the workers. One employee was hospitalized for burns to the arms, face, and the back of their neck.
An employee was climbing down a ladder when he fell to the ground. He was hospitalized with a fractured heel.
An employee's left ring and little finger were pinched in an overhead hoist as the employee tried to reposition a rack of material. The employee's ring fingertip was amputated.
An employee was exiting the roof using a ladder and fell to the ground, fracturing an ankle.

After completing an HVAC service, an employee was descending a roof access ladder when he slipped and his arm was caught between the rungs of the ladder. The employee sustained a compound fracture of the left forearm and required surgery.
An employee was cutting a roll of house wrap with a pair of cutters and cut his finger. The employee was hospitalized.

A crew was clearing a new residential lot using a skid steer. The skid steer pushed over a tree and it struck the injured employee, who was cutting tree limbs with a chainsaw, in the head. The employee was hospitalized for blunt force trauma to the head.

An employee was checking for hail damage on a roof. He was ascending a ladder to the second-story roof when the ladder gave way and he fell, contacting the first-story roof and then falling to the ground. He sustained eight cracked ribs, a collapsed lung, a neck laceration, and a shoulder injury. He was hospitalized.
While climbing up a fixed ladder, an employee fell backward and landed on a concrete floor. The employee was hospitalized for a fractured skull, broken facial bones, and a broken arm.
On May 21, 2024, an employee was taping drywall when they fell 10.5 feet off a scaffold. The employee was hospitalized for broken ankles.

On May 21, 2024, an employee climbed a 28-foot extension ladder and unhooked the drop. This released tension that caused the ladder to shake and throw him off. He fell to the ground, suffering broken ribs and a ruptured spleen.

A crew was removing a valve cap from an 8-inch ductile water line to make a T-line connection. The crew used the shut off valve at the curb box to shut the water off at approximately 7:30 AM. The injured employee was removing the bolts that connect to the joint restraint when the valve cap came off due to pressure build up in the pipe line and it struck the employee's lower right leg and fractured it.
An employee fell from a ladder to the concrete floor approximately 8 feet below while pulling low voltage wire. The employee struck his head and sustained a brain bleed.
An employee was cleaning chunks of concrete from the pulleys on a conveyor belt and was caught between the pulley and the belt, resulting in a fractured right arm.

An employee was setting up access on the ridge of a metal roof. The employee slid down to the porch roof below, fell over the edge, and landed on the ground feet first. The employee sustained a knee fracture.

An employee was driving a boom lift from the inside to the outside, when the boom lift drove off the dock and the employee was catapulted from the lift. He was suspended 8-10 feet from the ground from his fall protection and sustained a fractured left leg.

An elevator mechanic was adjusting the elevator brake clearance with a feeler gage used to monitor clearance between the brake shoe and operating shaft. The mechanic was holding the feeler gage in his left hand, and wrenches in his right hand. He instructed a helper inside the elevator to cab up. As the cab went up, his left middle finger got pinched in the elevator hoist cable and the fingertip was amputated.
On May 21, 2024, an employee was making up a guide wire on the ground and received an electric shock. The employee was hospitalized.

On May 21, 2024, temporary concrete barriers along a bridge edge were being moved two feet back using a front-end loader with forks. The forks became entangled in some rebar, so the barrier being lifted was set back down. The injured employee went to investigate, lost his footing, and fell backward off the edge of the bridge deck 24 feet to the lower boom of the mobile elevated work platform (MEWP). He then fell from the MEWP another 5 feet onto soft mud ground. He sustained a head laceration, punctured lungs, and fractures to his pelvis and leg.

An employee was utilizing an aerial bucket to repair the service drop at a residential home. The truck that the arial bucket is attached to was parked on a slope and began to move. The employee was ejected from the bucket and landed on the ground, sustaining two back fractures.
On May 22, 2024, an employee was operating a mini skid steer when the loaded skid steer tipped over, and fell four feet down an elevator pit. The employee's right tibia was crushed and fractured.
An employee was cleaning out a concrete curb machine when his leg became caught in the hopper, resulting in amputation of the leg.
An employee was assisting others in moving a large stainless steel sink when his right hand became pinched between the sink and the countertop. He sustained a partial amputation to a finger.
An employee was working from a scaffold when they fell and fractured their back. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee finished concrete pumping operations at a jobsite. The employee disconnected the buckle between hoses. Pressure caused the pump buckle to come off and strike the employee in the face. The employee was hospitalized with a skull fracture, multiple facial fractures, and a facial laceration.
An employee was clearing debris from a table saw when their hand became caught in the blade, resulting in cuts to the hand requiring hospitalization.
An employee was using fuel to light a brush pile when they sustained second-degree burns on their right arm.

An employee was pulling the joint off a southbound lane and checking the depth. The employee was walking on the right side of the paver when a vehicle swerved into the closed lane and struck the employee, launched him into the air, where he struck a spreader. The employee sustained a contusion to the body, a right arm laceration, a fractured right tibia, and a right leg laceration. The driver of the vehicle was arrested for driving under the influence (DUI).
An employee was setting trusses during residential construction when a gust of wind pushed the employee causing them to fall over 20 feet. The employee sustained broken legs.
An employee was loading a truck and picking up a tub when the strap on the tub broke, causing them to fall from standing. The employee sustained a fractured hip that required surgery.

An employee was framing columns while standing 3 feet high on a 6-foot step ladder. The employee lost his balance and fell to the ground landing on the hammer hook on his belt. The employee was hospitalized with a broken sacrum.

An employee was driving a roller packer up an incline when the roller packer turned over onto it's side. The employee was pinned under the rollover protection structure (ROPS) and sustained multiple broken ribs and a punctured lung. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was descending a roof hatch ladder after working on an HVAC unit when his foot slipped off the top rung and he fell to the concrete surface below. The employee sustained fractures to his right hand and right tibia. He was hospitalized.
An employee was walking down a hill when he tripped on a vine and fell down the hill and over a 6-foot retaining wall to the ground below. The employee sustained a fractured right hip.

On May 27, 2024, an employee was checking the depth of a trench when they slipped and fell into the trench. They sustained an avulsion injury to their lower left leg from a mini skid steer with a trencher attachment that was in operation.

The injured employee was retrieving a suitcase generator out of the bed of a pickup truck. While handing the generator to an employee on the ground, the injured employee slipped and fell off the bumper of the truck. He landed on the tongue of the trailer that the truck was coupled to. The employee sustained a bruised lung and three fractured ribs.
An employee struck their elbow on a steel railing and was hospitalized with a ruptured bursa.

On May 28, 2024, the injured employee climbed on a trailer to perform a repair on a horizontal directional drill. A second employee was offloading the drill and drove the drill so the ramp could be deployed. The injured employee's lower right leg became caught between the tracks of the drill and the trailer, resulting in fractures to the ankle and tibia.

An employee was installing a ceiling light and received an electric shock from a 110-volt live wire. The electricity entered their left hand and exited their left wrist. The employee suffered electrical burns to both hands on the top and the palm area.
An employee was working on the roof cutting openings. He fell through one of the openings and sustained a pelvic injury.

Two employees were connecting braces to joists. They were in a scissor lift with the platform approximately 40 feet high. They started moving the scissor lift forward. The left front tire fell into a floor hole causing the scissor lift to turn over. The employees fell to the concrete floor and both employees sustained fractures.

An employee was working on an A-frame aluminum ladder on top of scaffolding inside of the garage of a residential building. The employee fell and struck the scaffold before landing on the concrete floor approximately 24 feet below. The employee sustained blunt force trauma to the head and neck.
An employee was drilling a quarter-inch hole into a 277-volt bus bar and sustained electrical burns to their face and arms from an arc flash.
An employee tripped over a footing and landed on his side, where he was wearing a wire reel used to connect rebar together. The employee sustained a fractured hip.

Employees were changing a broken spring on the inside of a storage unit. The injured employee was taking a pipe wrench off the torsion tube when the pipe wrench slipped off the tube, causing the employee to fall backward from the second rung of a 6-foot ladder. They fell to the concrete floor and landed on their right foot, resulting in a dislocation and fracture to the right ankle.
Two employees were removing an asphalt pump basket strainer when hot asphalt released onto their hands. Both employees sustained second degree burns on their hands and were hospitalized.

An employee was on an extension ladder at a private residence when the ladder slipped out from underneath them and they fell to the ground-level deck. The employee sustained fractures in their leg and foot.
An employee was repairing a roof when they fell 10 feet to the ground. The employee sustained a back fracture.

An employee was walking under a crawler crane that was driving pilons into the ground. The wrecking ball broke away from the cable and fell 60 feet. The cable strings struck the employee's left side. He sustained an injury to the left side of his back and a broken left foot.
An employee was installing tiles on a roof and began to experience nausea and muscle cramps. The employee was hospitalized for dehydration.

On May 30, 2024, an employee was assembling pipe for a concrete structure. He was holding a 6-inch PVC pipe to align it with a hole in the concrete structure. As the pipe was pushed forward, the employee's right middle finger was caught between the end of the pipe and the edge of the hole resulting in amputation of the fingertip.

Employees were working on an overhead sign on an interstate when a car entered the closed lane and struck a bucket truck. At the time of the incident, an employee was getting tools from the back of the truck. The car pinned his leg against the bucket truck causing a compound fracture to the lower leg.
An employee was using a drill equipped with a hole saw bit. The drill kicked back and the employee's arm was cut by the rotating hole saw bit.
An employee was cutting plywood with a circular saw when two fingers on their left hand were amputated by the saw and two more were injured.
An employee was using a drill-powered tugger to pull wire when his finger got caught between the mule tape and the tugger. The employee's fingertip was amputated.
An employee was sitting on a form board of a house when the teeth of a mini-excavator struck their shin, causing a fractured leg.

An employee was operating a pile driver. While bending over to get a tape measure, a pin from the pile driver struck the employee's back between their shoulder blades. The employee sustained a bruised lung.
An employee was working on a 16-foot ladder when wind blew the ladder over and the employee fell, sustaining injury to their back and leg.

An employee was filling concrete forms. They were lowering the concrete pump hose into the forming when an air bubble caused the hose to kick back and strike the employee's back causing a fractured L5 vertebra. The employee then landed on formwork and lost two teeth. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was helping to move a welding machine. He stumbled and fell under the tongue of the trailer, which then fell on the employee. The employee sustained fractures to both bones in their right lower leg.

An employee had finished for the day. They were using an extension ladder to egress a three-story residential building when they slipped and fell 25 feet to the ground (concrete pavers). The employee was hospitalized with a concussion and fractures to their left shoulder, sternum, ribs, and right leg.
An employee was stocking merchandise when she fell off a step stool to the floor and fractured her wrist.

An employee was carrying a roll of plastic on his shoulder across a construction zone as a loader was reversing with bags of sand. The loader struck the employee, injuring their legs. They were hospitalized.

An employee was ascending an extension ladder with a small blower in his hand to access a roof when the ladder broke, causing the employee to fall about 10 feet to the grass below. The employee sustained a dislocation to their hip/pelvis.
An employee was assisting with rigging at the ground level when they became caught between a moving excavator and a piece of shoring. They sustained fractured ribs and a collapsed lung.

An employee was climbing a ladder at the upper level of an office building when he lost his balance and fell to a landing one level below. He then fell from the landing to the ground level, resulting in a fractured clavicle.
An employee was walking on the jobsite when they were struck by an off-road construction vehicle. The wheel of the truck broke bones in the employee's foot and dislocated toes.

An employee was repairing a handwheel on a gas cylinder when the cylinder valve attached to the handwheel broke, causing the cylinder to release and strike the employee. They sustained fractures to their right ulna and scapula.
An employee was sanding drywall from a scaffold when they fell and landed on both their feet on the ground, fracturing both ankles.

On June 3, 2024, an employee was performing framing operations when a 50 MPH gust of wind knocked a wall onto the employee and caused his nail gun to discharge. The employee sustained fractures to his left shoulder and a rib, as well as injuries to the side of his chest from the wall and the nail gun. He was hospitalized.
An employee was working from an extension ladder or a platform when he fell 14 feet to the ground. The employee sustained shoulder, chest, and abdominal injuries, as well as a collapsed lung.

An employee was descending a fixed ladder during wet conditions with a backpack that had tools in it. The employee slipped and fell 7 feet to the concrete ground, and sustained a fractured right wrist and forearm.
An employee was in the trench box in an excavation when an 8" ductile iron pipe was lowered into the trench and pinned the employee's left leg against the trench box, fracturing it.
An employee was putting equipment away when a concrete block fell on his foot and he sustained a broken bone.
On June 4, 2024, an employee was performing roofing work when they fell from the roof to the ground below, resulting in internal organ damage, a broken wrist, and contusions.

On June 4, 2024, an employee was cutting an 8-inch water line using a concrete saw/demo saw. The saw kicked back and into the employee's face resulting in broken bones, loss of teeth, and a laceration to the face.
An employee was climbing a 10-foot ladder when they fell approximately 5 feet and struck their head on the concrete ground. The employee sustained a skull fracture.
An employee was tensioning a fiber optic line on a pole when the primary phase line detached and fell on the employee, resulting in second-degree burns to his back, chest, and left palm.
An employee was ascending a ladder to gain access to a steel beam to tie off when he fell to the ground. The employee sustained a pelvic fracture.
An employee was installing insulation baffles when they slipped and fell approximately 20 feet to the ground. The employee sustained fractures to their hand and wrist.

An employee was using a keyhole saw to cut lightweight insulating concrete (LWIC) when they slipped on cement slurry and fell on the same level. The keyhole saw impaled them through their right hand between the thumb and index finger.
An employee was removing jacks on the second floor when they were hospitalized with heat exhaustion and dehydration.

An employee was installing a wall system in the interior of the building on a 4-foot ladder when his hand contacted hot wires (120 volts). The employee suffered an electric shock that affected his heart rate.
An employee was running new electrical wiring to a panel (480 volts) to install new electrical equipment when they contacted the equipment and sustained electrical burns to their hand.

An employee was lining up metal in a punch press when his left hand became caught in the point of operation. The employee sustained an amputation of the middle finger and an amputation to the first knuckle of the index finger.

An employee was standing on the temporary plywood cover of an engineered shoring system on a concrete parking deck. The plywood shifted and they fell through to the ground. The employee sustained fractured ribs and a head contusion.
An employee was conducting roofing and construction work when they fell to the ground and sustained a fractured arm and hand.

An employee was doing masonry work on the side of a dam when they stepped off a platform and onto a ladder. His foot slipped between the top and second rung, causing him to fall. His left leg became caught in the ladder, fracturing it.

An employee was installing a variable frequency device to an HVAC system when he was exposed to 480-volts and fell 10 feet off the mezzanine catwalk to the ground. The employee sustained an electric shock and a sore back.
An employee was testing breakers when an arc flash occurred. The employee sustained burns on his hands and one side of his face.

An employee was installing drive shafts on an overhead crane. The drive shaft was rigged about 17 feet up with a wire rope choker. The drive shaft began slipping through the rigging, when it slid down and struck the injured employee's hard hat. He was knocked to his knees and landed on his right knee. The employee sustained an amputation to the right leg below the knee.

An employee was preparing to cut a beam and was removing overhead piping and conduit near a column during demolition work. While removing the overhead busbar (480-volts) with a reciprocating saw, the saw cut into the busbar and an arc flash occurred. The employee was electrocuted and sustained burns to their upper body and face.
An employee was using a power shear to cut sheet metal when their fingertip was amputated.
An employee was adjusting a forklift tine when their finger was crushed between the tine and the wooden saddle. The employee sustained a fingertip amputation.
An employee was changing a tire on the side of the road. The employee's wrench slipped and pinned their finger against the tire rim, causing a partial amputation.

An employee was changing out old gaskets when hydrogen fluoride escaped from a line with residual pressure in the area and struck them in the face. The employee was hospitalized with chemical burns to their facial area.
An employee was walking in the showroom when they tripped over two jugs of refrigerant and fell to the floor. The employee sustained a fractured left shoulder.

An employee was laying decking and went to move a bundle of decking with a sleever bar. The employee's sleever bar slipped and came off the bundle causing the employee to lose balance. The employee took a step back and fell 13 feet and 5 inches to the lower level, resulting in fractures to their nose, right foot, and right ankle. They were wearing fall protection at the time.

An employee was in a scissor lift about 12 feet high to check 277-volt overhead lights. He was testing the wires when he was shocked and his heart stopped temporarily. The employee sustained electrocution and was hospitalized.

An employee was using a 30-inch saw cutter on a foundation wall when the wall shifted causing a bind on the blade. The blade jumped out of the vertical cut and struck the employee's right hand. The employee sustained lacerations to their hand and index and ring fingers. The employee was hospitalized and required 50-60 stitches and surgery for a tendon.
An employee twisted his leg while turning, fell, and suffered a broken left leg. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was helping to service/fuel a drill rig when they became pinched between the service/fuel truck and the counterweight of the drill. The employee sustained seven fractured ribs, a tear of an artery in his neck, bruising, and a head laceration.
An employee was bracing a valve when it failed and the actuator struck the employee in his back, fracturing his pelvis and vertebrae.
An employee was clearing a site and removing trees when a tree fell on their leg and fractured it.

An employee was preparing the mezzanine for painting and was laying plastic on the concrete floor. They noticed a piece of plywood lying on the mezzanine floor and lifted the plywood to lay plastic down. The employee then fell approximately 12 feet through the floor opening the plywood was covering and sustained a fractured femur.

Three employees were installing a door. The injured employee lost his balance and fell against a temporary guardrail, then fell two stories down to the floor. He was hospitalized with a broken ankle and back fracture.

An employee was descending on a transport platform. A 2-by-4, sticking out of a trash bin, caught his left hand and wedged it against a building slab. The employee's ring fingertip was medically amputated.
Twenty sheets of sheetrock were leaning against a wall. An employee walked by and the sheetrock fell onto their left leg and fractured it.

Employees were setting concrete beams for a bridge. The injured employee was guiding a beam when his fingers were caught between the beam and a bridge cap, crushing the tip of his finger and amputating the fingertip.

An employee was on a 5-foot ladder trying to remove a motor weighing about 200 lbs. from an auger. They had loosened it and were trying to manipulate it to set it up to be lifted. The motor wasn't giving and they lost their balance and fell 4-5 feet to the ground below. The employee sustained a broken tibia and fibula.
An employee was operating an asphalt paver when he began to feel dizzy and stopped sweating. The employee suffered dehydration with acute injury to the kidneys.
An employee was installing drywall when a drywall sheet fell on their head and knocked them to the ground, which fractured their collarbone. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee (driver) was operating a backhoe digging footing inside the building. The backhoe slipped into the shallow excavation and the employee sustained broken ribs.

An employee was working from the first level of a baker scaffold attaching finish trim. When he went to hammer a piece of trim, he missed the trim and the momentum propelled him forward, causing him to fall to the concrete slab ground. The employee sustained a fractured nose, eye socket, left wrist, and right elbow.

An employee was kneeling down taking measurements along the side of the road when a truck pulling a trailer went off the road and the trailer struck the employee. The employee was hospitalized for a fractured jaw and swelling on the brain.
An employee was walking down the stairs to exit the building, missed the last step, and fell to the floor. The employee sustained a fracture and dislocation of the right tibia and ankle.
An employee was on a portable ladder nailing down a board when they fell approximately seven feet to the ground and dislocated their shoulder.
An employee was bending two pieces of rebar in a machine when their left index finger was pinched between the rebar and the backup ram on the table resulting in amputation of the fingertip.

On June 12, 2024, an employee was hand grading behind an excavator with rubber tracks and tripped and fell while the machine was backing up. The excavator ran over the employee's right leg resulting in a broken ankle, cracked pelvis and a fractured left arm.
An employee was walking on wood matting and fell, resulting in a fractured and dislocated left foot.
An employee was standing on the third rung of an 8-foot ladder removing a glass panel when he fell off the ladder to the ground below and broke his lower left leg in two places.

An employee was working on the lights to perform a retrofit. The employee had performed lockout/tagout procedures and used a hot stick to check the voltage. They contacted a different live wire and were shocked. The employee was hospitalized for shock/a heart arrhythmia.

An employee was heating up a discharge refrigerant line on a compressor using a torch to replace the compressor. When he went to remove the line from the compressor, a fireball exited the compressor line burning his left forearm, wrist and hand. The employee was hospitalized for second-degree burns to the left forearm and hand.
An employee was hooking up a temporary battery (120 volts) when a short occurred, resulting in an arc flash. The employee sustained first- and second-degree burns to both hands and was hospitalized.

On June 12, 2024, an employee was performing demolition work at a construction site and was removing large stone debris. The employee was standing close to a skid steer that had an elevated load. As the employee cleared debris from below the elevated load, a concrete slab fell onto the employee's thumb resulting in amputation at the first knuckle.

An employee was working from the bucket of a truck, replacing a span of coax main line cable. He leaned against the bucket door which opened, and he fell approximately 20 feet onto the asphalt road below. The employee sustained a fractured skull, wrist, elbow, and ankle as well as other internal injuries and was hospitalized for surgery. He was wearing fall protection and a hard hat at the time of the fall.

An employee was operating the controls of a boom truck used to move concrete panels. As the employee was operating the outrigger lever to bring the legs in from the truck, he saw a hose that was going to get pinched by the legs. While grabbing the hose, his left thumb was pinched by the outrigger leg, resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was working on reinforcing steel rebar while wearing a full body harness with a retractable hook. The bar that the employee was hooked to bent and the fall protection slid off, causing the employee to fall 12-15 feet to the ground. The employee suffered a fractured skull, damaged ear canal, broken bones in the face, a broken collar bone, three brain bleeds, a collapsed lung, and broken ribs.
An employee was installing drain pipe and pushed the pipe away. When it came back he used his right arm to block it and fractured his arm.
An employee was using scaffolding to perform carpentry work in a house when he fell 3 feet to the ground, resulting in a fractured ankle.
An employee was climbing an extension ladder to perform staging activities on a flat roof. The employee fell 9 feet off the ladder, resulting in a broken back.
An employee was installing ceiling trim and received an electrical shock from electrical wiring within a ceiling stud.

An employee was walking across a metal grate while palletizing pipe as it was coming from the production line. A steel grate (walking surface) failed and the employee fell approximately 6.5 feet to a lower level and sustained a fractured right arm.
On June 13, 2024, an employee was heading toward the skid steer operator to give him water. The employee's left foot was run over by the skid steer resulting in a metatarsal fracture.

An employee was climbing an extension ladder to reach the roofline of an 18-foot roof. The employee's tool bit fell from their tool belt, causing the employee to fall 16-18 feet from the ladder to the ground. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was installing decking and fell 35 feet onto a concrete surface and sustained injuries to their head, nose, and left arm. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery. The employee was wearing a harness, but their lanyard was not attached to the anchor point at the time.

An employee was working from a scissor lift installing insulation and fell 10 feet to the ground below. The employee sustained a concussion, left wrist fracture, a dislocated shoulder that required surgery and a rib contusion.

A team of employees were trying to stand steel beams up using a sliding choking chain for rigging. The injured employee was behind the beam. Once the beam was pulled up into a standing position, the employee stepped in to unhook the beam when it rocked as the hook came off, causing the beam to fall on their left leg. The employee suffered a broken leg.

On June 14, 2024, two employees were moving a water trailer with a loader and an attachment. The attachment was stuck. The employees used a bar to free it and the loader fell on one employee's left foot, crushing a toe.

On June 14, 2024, three employee were unloading large slabs of marble tile at a residence when a slab fell from the truck and struck all three employees. One employee suffered a fractured ankle and required surgery. Another employee sustained fractures to their skull and neck, as well as laceration to their left hand. Both employees were hospitalized.

An employee was tying a new light fixture into a live junction box from a 10-foot ladder when he suffered an electrical shock and fell off the ladder. The employee sustained a head injury, received stitches, and was hospitalized.
Employees were installing waterproofing material on the second floor balcony of a building. An employee fell to the ground and sustained a broken femur.
An employee was on a one-story roof, removing a concrete roof tile for repair. The tile broke and the employee lost their balance and fell backward to the ground, sustaining a back injury.

An employee was removing a tire from a piece of construction equipment for maintenance. The tire fell over and the employee tripped over a pallet trying to get out of the way. The tire fell on their leg and fractured it.
A lineman was replacing a section of wire and while cutting the exterior wire cover with a razor blade and they sustained a deep laceration involving an artery.

Employees were installing a 50-foot-wide rubber door at a steel plant. When setting a steel idler barrel (weighing approximately 2,000 pounds) into position using a crane, the barrel got caught on a piece of metal. The injured employee pushed the barrel and it swung down, crushing his thumb in a pinch point. The employee's thumb was partially amputated.

An employee was moving sheet metal and fell 30 feet to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured spine and elbow, resulting in paralysis from the chest area and below. Fall protection was not worn at the time.

On June 17, 2024, at approximately 6:30 a.m., an employee was on a ladder installing the top rail of a fence for an apartment complex when he fell approximately 28 feet. The employee suffered fractures to the legs.
An employee was descending a scaffold when they fell approximately 6 feet to the ground. The employee sustained a right shoulder and hand fracture.

An employee was peering into an elevator pit to look at future work when the handrail they were leaning on gave out, causing them to fall 5.5 feet into the elevator shaft and onto its concrete floor. The employee suffered a head laceration and contusion, spinal compressed fracture, and transverse process fracture of the spine.

Three employees were working to grade a driveway at a residential location. One employee was operating a skid-steer while grading. As the operator backed up the skid-steer, it crushed the injured employee's foot, resulting in hospitalization and surgery due to a fracture.

An employee had set an anchor through the limbs of a cedar tree into the ground. After the anchor was set, he stowed the auger and drove up the right-of-way approximately 200 feet. The injured employee was gathering materials at the back of the truck when the digger operator started to unwind the auger and it dislodged from the stem. The auger fell approximately 15 feet and struck the employee in the midback and lower part of his body. The auger drove the employee to the ground, landed on him, and knocked him unconscious. The employee was hospitalized with a dislocated hip and fractures to his ribs and pelvis.

Two employees were in an aerial lift. After installing a window the employees were moving the lift to a new location when one employee contacted an overhead electrical line. The second employee grabbed the first employee and both employees suffered electrical shocks.

An employee was moving a cart containing a stone slab when the slab began to tip off the cart. The employee reached out to catch the material and it landed on his hand, resulting in a finger amputation.
An employee was operating a hydraulic screed while laying concrete when his left hand got pulled into a hydraulic cable winch, resulting in a partial amputation of the ring finger.
An employee fell down a flight of stairs and sustained facial fractures.
An employee was picking up trash when they experienced heat-related syncope. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was on the bed of a digger truck assisting the operator with moving a 30-foot pole from the rack on the digger truck to a dumpster for disposal. The employee placed a strap around the pole and attached it to the boom of the digger truck before guiding the pole to the dumpster. As the pole was being lowered, it shifted and caught his left ring fingertip against the side of the dumpster. The employee suffered a fingertip amputation.

On June 19, 2024, an employee was cleaning out a masonry delivery system that was attached to the raised forks of a powered industrial vehicle (PIV). The employee stepped back and fell backward to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a head injury that required three staples, three fractured ribs, and a fractured pelvis.
An employee was installing a new, non-energized conductor when they contacted the existing conductor and received an electrical shock and burns to their toes.

An employee was emptying sand from a catch pan on a paving machine. The employee pulled out a pin and the catch pan fell and landed on the employee's left middle finger. The finger was crushed and amputated.

An employee was mowing grass around the jobsite trailers. They reached down to inspect the push mower and their right hand was struck by the rotating blade. Their right index finger was amputated to the first knuckle.
An employee was installing an HVAC system in a customer's home and was hospitalized for heat illness.
An employee was finishing a roofing job on a two-story building when he fell off the roof and landed on a fence. The employee sustained broken ribs, a broken wrist, and head injuries.

An employee was assisting a transport vehicle that was leaving the jobsite by watching for oncoming traffic. After the transport vehicle (18-wheeler) departed, a pickup truck pulled onto the street. The employee then turned toward the rear of the pickup truck as it was moving away from him and started running after it. The employee went to jump onto the bumper and struck his left leg on the ball hitch. The employee's leg was fractured.

An employee was utilizing a chain fall to move a piece of pipe. The connection to the beam failed causing the pipe to fall and contact the employee's right leg just above the ankle. The employee sustained a fracture and dislocation to the tibia.
An employee was assisting in the setup of a core drill to drill into a concrete wall. The drill fell from the wall and landed on the employee's right foot breaking his big toe.
An employee (employee 1) was handing a cut piece of wood to another employee (employee 2) so it could be nailed to the wall. Employee 2's nail gun went off and a nail struck employee 1's left knee.

An employee was driving a forklift that was carrying an aluminum I-beam. The beam was swinging on the fork tines and it spun around, striking the employee's head. The employee sustained severe injuries to their head and neck.
An employee was unclogging the tip of the spray gun with a knife. When it was unclogged, silicone was injected into his right hand. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was in a bucket truck putting wires together. A jumper came loose from its insulation and touched a piece of metal on the backside of the bucket. As the employee was going to install another jumper, it contacted his tie-off point and energized it. A hydraulic hose was damaged and hydraulic oil misted out and caught on fire. The employee sustained first- and second-degree burns on parts of his upper back and torso.

An employee was operating a concrete buggy when a piece of concrete debris became lodged in the tracks, causing the buggy to come to a sudden stop. The employee was thrown from the buggy and landed on the ground on his left side resulting in a broken arm and two broken ribs.

An employee was operating a side-by-side while surveying the jobsite. The vehicle struck a rock and flipped onto its side pinning the employee's left wrist against the ground. The employee's wrist was fractured.

An employee was servicing an HVAC unit on the roof of a vacant building. As the employee manually pulled the belt and pulley system, his left middle finger was caught in the belt/pulley and a quarter inch of the finger was amputated.

An employee was working to position rigging from the back of a low-boy trailer. He was walking on the top bed of the trailer when he stepped on a free-spinning tire on a tag axle (raised rear axle). The employee lost balance and jumped approximately 3 feet to the ground. He was hospitalized with fractures to the right tibia and fibula and required surgery.
An employee was using a hand tool inside of a transformer when it struck an energized part, causing an arc flash. The employee sustained burns to their hair and eye pain.
An employee was walking down a sloped hill when they slipped on recently laid hay and fell on the ground. The employee sustained knee injuries.

On June 20, 2024, at approximately 9:00 PM, an employee was descending a ladder from a cooling tower to a corner pillar. Upon reaching the corner pillar, the employee attempted to step off the pillar onto an 18-inch pipe adjacent to the cooling tower, fell onto the large pipes to the left of the 18-inch pipe. The employee was hospitalized with a partially collapsed lung and fractured ribs on their left side.

An employee was running a concrete vibrator on top of a concrete wall next to a pump truck hose. When the pump truck blockage was cleared, the hose struck the employee and caused them to fall from a 4-foot scaffold to the uneven ground. The employee landed on their back and lost consciousness, sustained back fractures, and was hospitalized.

On June 21, 2024, an employee was aligning a wall on a chalk line and fell 24 feet through a guardrail. The employee sustained a broken wrist, three broken ribs and a collapsed lung. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee suffered heat stroke while clearing brush and debris from a roadside.
A flagger was struck by a motor vehicle in an active work zone and they sustained a broken leg, facial lacerations, and a possible pelvic fracture.
An employee was getting into a front-end loader when their hand became caught in the cabin door. The employee's right middle fingertip was partially amputated halfway through the nailbed.

An employee leaned against a temporary rail on the second level that gave way and caused them to fall approximately 10 feet to a lower level, resulting in fractures to their pelvis, femur, and hip joint.

An employee acting in the capacity of a pile driver was greasing a pile driving hammer that was on the ground while in a blind spot of the crane operator. The hammer was raised and pinched the injured pile driver's left hand between the sidewall of the hammer and the grease gun in the piling leads, resulting in amputation of the middle fingertip through the nailbed and a fractured ring finger.

An employee was on an A-frame ladder pulling a wire through a conduit. The pressure caused the head to break from the fish tape, which caused the employee to lose his balance and fall approximately 5 feet, striking his head on the concrete. The employee sustained a brain bleed and injuries to the back of his head that required stitches.
An employee was grabbing a ladder that was hanging on the wall in the shop area. They stepped back, tripped over a vehicle lift, and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a broken hip.

On June 24, 2024, an employee was using a demolition saw to cut a 30-inch steel pipe when the saw kicked back, struck the ground, and rebounded toward the employee. The employee was struck by the blade in the bicep, resulting in a laceration.

An employee was operating a plow to install fiber internet cable. While the vehicle was parked and the employee was on the ground, the vehicle began to move. The employee was climbing up to the cab when his legs became caught in the track, crushing them. Both legs were amputated.
An employee was operating an extended manlift when they fell to the lower level, resulting in wrist fractures.

Two employees were removing an existing cutout and insulator from the steel in a distribution low bay near a circuit of underground feeders connected to a 1-inch bus. Employee 1 contacted the bus with his back sustaining a shock, and employee 2 contacted it with his left hand and received second-degree burns to his three middle fingers and the back side of his knee where the electric current exited his body. Employee 2 was hospitalized.
A service technician was climbing a ladder when it gave way and he fell approximately 12 feet to the ground. The employee landed on the ladder and sustained back fractures.

An employee was clearing debris and preparing an area for the installation of railing. The hydraulics on the excavator failed, causing the guardrailing to fall. He was sitting on the ground when a piece of railing fell and struck his back, causing fractures to his vertebrae.
An employee was measuring a roof when they fell approximately 12 feet to the ground and sustained fractures to their ribs and skull.
An employee was stepping down off a trailer with material in their hands when they lost balance and fell to the ground. The employee sustained fractured ribs and lacerations.

An employee was in a building to perform maintenance work on a boiler, chiller, and HVAC system. Looking for roof access, the employee opened a set of double doors on the third floor that opened outward toward a maintenance shaft/elevator shaft. He then looked for a light switch to turn on and stepped forward through the doors. He fell approximately 15-20 feet down the shaft, landing on his lower back on the trap door . The employee sustained a laceration to the back of their left leg that required stitches.

On June 25, 2024, a cleaning nozzle was being piloted into a host pipe within a manhole. The water cleaning head (nozzle) is sent through the pipe by applying a high pressure burst from the truck to the line. The nozzle was not completely within the host pipe, so the high pressure and angle caused the nozzle to make an upward trajectory out of the manhole. The nozzle then struck the back of an employee s leg, causing a laceration.

An employee was taking measurements of the front entrance. He was doffing his toolbelt and harness when he slipped and fell approximately 6 inches off a sidewalk curb. When he planted his right leg to support himself, his leg gave way and he fell to the concrete, resulting in a fractured femur. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was inside a trench when he was struck by the bucket of an excavator. The employee sustained broken clavicles, broken ribs, and punctured lungs requiring surgery.

An employee was installing a light box while standing on a 2x6 board over a 15-foot tall opening when the board snapped, causing them to fall to the ground. The employee sustained ligament damage to their ankle.
An employee was walking up an incline when he lost his footing, fell onto a railing, and then hit the floor. The employee sustained a fractured left upper arm.
An employee was removing and reinstalling the electrical disconnect when he began feeling ill. The employee was hospitalized for the treatment of heat illness.
