An employee was installing rebar when they fainted due to heat and were hospitalized for dehydration.

An employee was changing a bolt on the beller (a drilling tool) that was attached to an auger drive motor on a track loader. The auger drive motor spun, causing the beller to spin and strike the employee's legs. The employee sustained a broken right leg and bruises on the left leg.
An employee was operating a machine to cut steel and amputated two fingers on their left hand.
An employee was working from a ladder to install a door latch at an approximate height of 10 feet. The employee fell from the ladder to the ground below and suffered a broken heel.
An employee was working outside and began feeling ill. The employee was hospitalized for dehydration.
An employee was installing elevator rails and fell from a ladder approximately 12 feet into the elevator pit. The employee sustained a skull fracture and a fractured left shoulder.
An employee was using a drain cleaning product to clear a clogged drain when the chemical blew back into his face. The employee sustained chemical burns.

An employee was on a scaffold sandblasting the outside of a water tank. The employee slipped and caught her right little finger in a bracket holding the scaffolding together resulting in an amputation to the finger.
An employee was climbing an A-frame ladder to install mud rings in the ceiling of a residence. He fell to the floor and sustained head and neck injuries.

An employee was driving a side-by-side ATV in the yard of the facility to facilitate locking up for the day. As they were returning from locking up the gate, the side-by-side ATV hit a pothole in the yard causing it to tip over onto the passenger side. The employee sustained a broken right forearm.

An employee lost balance and fell 20 feet from the roof edge to the ground below and landed on his feet before bouncing onto a pile of plywood and 2 x 6 lumber. He was hospitalized for two broken ribs on the left side of his chest, vertebral fractures, and a left ankle strain. He also reported pain from his left foot to his hip. Fall protection was not connected to an anchor point at the time.
An employee was operating a chop saw and amputated their right middle fingertip.

Employees were setting a pole along a county road to replace a storm-damaged pole. They were positioning the new pole in the hole and were canting the new pole using the pole chain. The pole shifted and dropped in the hole, causing the chain to roll over an employee's right index finger. The chain caught their finger against the pole and resulted in a fingertip amputation without bone loss.

On June 28, 2024, an employee was using a mini-excavator to dig a trench on a residential property. They got out of the mini-excavator and went into the trench to inspect the slopes. A large piece of dirt broke free from the trench and struck the employee. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to their right clavicle and ribs on the right side.
On June 28, 2024, an employee was helping to raise a wall for exterior framing when the wall fell on top of her, fracturing her femur and lower leg. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was accessing a roof and was getting off a ladder to unload shingles that had been placed on the roof with a boom. He slipped and fell from the second-story roof, landing on a wooden pallet on the ground. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to his mandible and elbow, facial abrasions, a concussion, and a collapsed lung.
An employee was sitting in his vehicle at the end of his shift. He experienced leg cramps from heat exposure and was hospitalized for heat illness.

An employee was out in the sun helping to install a storm chamber system by digging and positioning the parts of the system. The employee became unresponsive and was hospitalized due to heat exhaustion.

An employee was removing rigging from an I-beam. When the crane raised the cables, the beam clamp caught the I-beam, causing it to roll onto the employee's legs and ankles. The employee sustained fractures to both lower legs and ankles.
Employees were changing out a pole. They were moving the center phase conductor when an arc flash occurred and an employee sustained burns to their face.

An employee was cutting a pipe with a circular saw when the pipe pinched the blade and the blade shattered. A projectile from the blade struck the employee in the neck, lacerating him from the Adam's apple around to the ear.
An employee was unbending a hose to clean the coils on an HVAC unit when he fell 45 feet from the roof to the ground below. The employee sustained fractures to lumbar vertebrae and an ankle.

An employee was driving a side-by-side utility vehicle and making a right turn when the vehicle flipped on its side and fell on top of the employee. The employee's hand was caught between the driver's side window pillar and the ground and his leg was caught under the UTV. He sustained crushing injuries to his upper extremities and lower leg, four bones were fractured from the knuckles to the wrist, his elbow sustained severe lacerations, and his ankle was bruised.
An employee was laying out a tie beam when they fell approximately 5 feet from a scaffold to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured arm and rib and received staples in their head.

An employee was working on the outrigger platform of a mast climber when he fell approximately 30 feet from the fifth floor down to the second level of the courtyard. The employee sustained fractures to the right side of his ribs and his right arm and leg.

An employee was operating a floodlight boom when it collapsed downward due to a faulty interior boom cable. The employee was struck by the light assembly mast and sustained an avulsion to their nose and head trauma, resulting in hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was ascending a fixed ladder on a building when they missed a step and fell to the concrete. The employee sustained left foot and spinal injuries.

An employee was installing steel siding when a piece became stuck and the rigging was pulled from the siding. A panel of the siding (approximately 28" x 12' and 28 pounds) then fell and struck them in the right arm, resulting in a laceration to the right bicep and brachial artery.
An employee was working from a 4-foot ladder when the ladder kicked out and they fell to the ground. The employee sustained a back injury.

An employee was on the ground running the screed on a paver when the dump truck attached to the paver contacted 46-kV power lines and the employee suffered an electrical shock. The employee sustained second- and third-degree electrical burns on their right hand and both feet.

An employee was spotting a forklift lifting a skid when the skid shifted and the employee's left little finger became caught between the skid and the forks. The employee was hospitalized and sustained an amputation of the finger.
An employee was assembling a crawler crane when they fell off the back of the crane to the ground. The employee sustained a lower leg fracture and was hospitalized.

An employee was spotting for an excavator that was pulling an old pipe from the ground. The wall of an adjacent excavation caved in and caused the excavator to tip into it. The top knuckle of the excavator boom struck the injured employee on the lower back, resulting in a fractured pelvis and ribs.
An employee was cutting lumber using a circular saw when he sustained a left ring fingertip amputation.

An employee was installing concrete plank decking and using a 5-foot Johnson bar to pry a plank to close a gap between the planks. The Johnson bar slipped and the employee lost his balance and fell backward to the concrete decking. The employee sustained a fractured lower right leg.

An employee was on a ladder installing fluorescent lights in the ceiling. The employee reached for a junction box on the ceiling and fell approximately 8 feet to the ground, resulting in fractures to both arms.

An employee was conducting maintenance on an HVAC unit and unhooking pressure gauges when their right hand contacted rotating fan blades. The employee sustained fractures and lacerations to the hand and fingers that required stitches and surgery on the ring finger.

On July 3, 2024, an employee was cutting a piece of metal on a band saw when the metal came loose from the vise on the saw and contacted their right hand. The employee sustained a laceration to their index finger and a fingertip amputation to the middle finger.
An employee was welding a steel pipe when they were struck in the back by an excavator bucket, resulting in fractures to their pelvis and right tibia.

An employee was on a ladder guiding the installation of a wood truss on a residential structure when the truss moved and struck them. The employee fell approximately 8 feet to the floor, fracturing their leg.

An employee was tying off on a wet roof when they stepped onto a wet piece of plywood and slipped. The employee fell through trusses approximately 15 feet to the ground below, resulting in a lacerated liver, a fracture to their left wrist, and a severe sprain to the right wrist.
An employee was operating a stressing jack when the cable detached from the jack and struck him in the face. The employee sustained facial lacerations and a fractured nose.

An employee was exiting the roof and when they reached to close the hatch, slipped off the ladder. The employee fell to the ground and sustained a laceration to the forehead, a sprained ankle, and fractures to their eye, wrist, and a rib.
An employee was descending a 32-foot extension ladder when they slipped and fell approximately 18 feet to the ground. The employee sustained three fractured ribs and a punctured lung.

An employee was performing carpentry work to frame a boardwalk when they slipped and fell. They were about 5 to 8 inches above the ground and landed with their chest contacting a large tree stump. The employee sustained three fractured ribs and a collapsed right lung.

The injured employee was on a team that was dismantling a scaffold. He was descending a scaffold ladder when the ladder bent backward and he fell. The employee struck a structural beam and then continued to fall to catwalk grating 36 feet below. The employee was hospitalized with multiple fractures.
An employee was working on a ladder when they lost their balance and fell approximately 4 feet to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured shoulder, four fractured ribs, and a punctured lung.
On July 8, 2024, an employee was helping place rebar during a rigging process. His hand was caught in a rebar cage and he fell. His right hand was then trapped and injured, becoming swollen.
An employee was doing construction work and were hospitalized with a heat-related injury at the end of the day.
An employee was moving a material storage cage when a wheel broke off and the cage tipped over onto him. The employee sustained fractures to both hips.
An employee was utilizing a wheel loader and a sling to move rebar from one location to another. The rebar rolled over and struck his right leg, fracturing it. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was using a circular saw to cut wood when the wood got jammed and jumped and contacted their left hand. The employee sustained a laceration to their index finger and a partial amputation to the middle finger.
Two employees were putting up tin in a two-man basket when they both fell approximately 12 feet. One employee was hospitalized with a fractured C4 vertebra that required surgery.
An employee was pulling old wires from an electrical panel and removing conduit when they sustained electrical burns to face, arms, and chest from an arc flash.
An employee had been repairing an HVAC unit on a roof. The employee fell at least 10 feet from an extension ladder, sustaining a brain bleed and broken ribs.
An employee became dehydrated and began cramping while moving water meters. The employee was hospitalized, suffering from heat illness.

An employee was building scaffolding on the corner of a target wall outside on a hot and humid day. His right forearm began cramping at the end of the day and he went home to rest. The next morning he was still cramping and was hospitalized due to heat-related dehydration.
An employee was climbing the steps into an 18-wheeler tractor cab. The employee missed the second step, fell to the ground, and suffered injuries that caused internal bruising and body soreness.

An employee was preparing to make a repair to a transformer. As the employee laid a rubber blanket on a bushing for protection, a loose connection caused an electrical arc. The employee suffered burns to the shoulder, back, and torso and was hospitalized.
An employee was completed roofing work for the day and felt ill. The employee was hospitalized with kidney pain due to potential heat illness.

On July 9, 2024, an employee was troubleshooting a relay on the low voltage inside a water source heat pump when he contacted an electrical component and was shocked. The employee sustained a burn to his left index fingertip.

An employee was unjamming a hole saw using a screwdriver. When the saw was unjammed, it launched the screwdriver which struck the employee near their left eye. The employee sustained an orbital floor fracture, an outer eye abrasion, and stitches to their lower eyelid.
An employee was painting while on a scaffold. The employee fell approximately 6 feet to the ground and sustained broken ankles.

A forklift was being used to lift the ends of a bundle of concrete reinforcement rebar by the wire holding the bundle together. An employee was positioning wood dunnage under the bundle when the wire failed. The bundle fell on the employee's right hand, breaking the index and middle fingers and causing a 2-inch laceration at the base of the broken fingers. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was on a ladder, painting the outside wall of a home. He fell from the ladder to the ground about 4 feet below and suffered a broken ankle.
An employee was cutting a brick wall using a concrete saw. The saw kicked and lacerated the employee's left shoulder, cutting into two ligaments, muscle, and bone.
An employee fell from a fixed ladder while descending. The employee landed on the ground and suffered fractures to the right little finger and left wrist.
An employee had been installing a gutter downspout. The employee was descending a 20-foot extension ladder when they fell to the ground. They sustained fractures to their T12 and L1 vertebrae.

An employee was on the second floor of a new-construction apartment building. The employee fell approximately 30 feet through the shaft lumber framing to the level below, landing on a concrete floor and suffering abrasions and contusions. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was loading shingles onto a roof when he fell approximately 30 feet from the roof to the concrete ground below, resulting in several broken bones to his wrist, legs, ribs, skull, and possibly the back.
An employee was shaking out an iron bar. The load shifted and a hook slid on the iron, catching the employee's thumb and amputating the tip.

Two employees were looking for steel tubing in the yard. Employee 1 knelt down to read the size numbers on the tubing. Employee 2 pulled out a piece of tubing and then tripped over a white mesh bag of parts from a delivery. The tubing was dropped on employee 1's right middle finger, amputating the fingertip.

An employee was working on a 10" pipe that was pressurized for a pressure test. The employee removed a flat pipe cap and pressure caused the cap to strike the employee resulting in lacerations, fractures, broken teeth, debris in their face and finger, injuries to the neck and clavicle, and a lacerated finger.

On July 11, 2024, at 8:00 AM, an employee was installing floor decking (plywood). He was working from an elevated platform on the first floor of a commercial building when he fell approximately 6-9 feet to the floor. The employee sustained a fractured left wrist requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was on a ladder while installing a cable at a private residence when he fell 12 feet onto the concrete below, landing on the back of his head. The employee was hospitalized due to head trauma.

Employees were repositioning a generator. Each employee had a corner of the generator as they tried to lift it over a 10-inch-high parapet wall. The generator's handle caught one employee's left middle finger, causing an amputation to the finger.
An employee was utilizing an excavator to move piping material when it tipped over. The employee suffered a left wrist fracture, a laceration, and a contusion to back of head and was hospitalized.
An employee tripped over a hallway rug while leaving her office. She fell and suffered a broken hip.

An employee was moving three 6-inch-diameter pipes on a jack stand in a shop area for painting. A rear jack wheel got caught on a rough patch of the concrete flooring, causing one pipe to fall off the jack. The employee was preventing the other two pipes from falling off the jack when his finger was caught between either the two pipes or one pipe and the jack. He was hospitalized with multiple lacerations and fractures to the right thumb and underwent surgery.

An employee was filling a 150-gallon water tank on a drilling rig truck. The pressure of the hose at the water station threw the employee from the platform to the ground 4.5 feet below. The employee suffered broken ribs and a head injury and was hospitalized.

An employee was cutting drywall so that feeder pipes could be extended as part of the installation of a transformer (2,000 lbs.). When the pipes were extended, the transformer rolled forward onto them and pinned the employee's lower leg against the wall. The employee suffered fractures to the tibia and fibula.
At about 8:55 a.m. on July 12, 2024, an employee was cutting a 2.25-inch wooden baseboard with a miter saw when the saw partially amputated the employee's left index finger.
An employee was positioning a pipe for welding when his left middle finger got pinched between the pipe and a spacer, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was removing the top bolt from a VSV actuator. The actuator pivoted on its lower bolt and struck his left foot, breaking bones.

An employee was handling material that is fabricated and stacked by a purlin machine. The employee was passing in front of the machine before the next fabricated piece came out of it when the fabricated piece contacted his upper left arm, resulting in a laceration.

An employee was vacuum-cleaning a 480-volt HVAC unit. The employee came into contact with an electrically-charged coil heat strip and suffered burns to the left hand and the left side of their forehead, as well as scrapes to their legs. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was operating equipment and raking asphalt part of a paving crew. The employee became ill, due to heat illness.
An employee was trying to dislodge a bucket from a skid steer. Once the pin was dislodged, the bucket fell on the employee's right big toe and the toe was amputated.
Some employees were tilting concrete panels when a brace broke and it hit the left side of the injured employee's shin. The employee suffered a fractured left tibia and fibula.
An employee was installing a piece of bracing to be welded. The bracing slipped and struck the employee's left hand fracturing the ring finger. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was backing up a rough-terrain forklift with a dock section rigged to the forks. The forklift rolled over and the employee was bounced around inside the cab. The employee sustained fractures, a dislocated shoulder, contusions, and a laceration to the head area.
An employee was working in a trench in 93-95 degree weather. He became light-headed and was taken to the hospital with heat stroke.
An employee was walking away from his skid steer when he tripped and fell on a piece of metal that punctured his neck. He was hospitalized with a broken hyoid bone and a neck puncture.

An employee was acting as a spotter for trucks dumping material into a milling machine. A backhoe was moving into position when its bucket struck the employee. The employee sustained two fractured ribs and kidney damage and was hospitalized.

An employee fell from a third-story height when a guardrail failed. The employee landed on the ground and was hospitalized with fractures to their pelvis and ribs as well as lacerations to their spleen and pelvic vessels.

On July 15, 2024, a contract employee was installing laminate flooring when they fell over an edge approximately 15 feet to a lower level. He sustained multiple fractures to the left side of his body including his pelvis, ribs, back, and elbow.
An employee fell from a residential roof to the ground about 9 feet below, suffering broken ribs and broken bones in the neck and back.

An employee was constructing a wall frame on the second floor of a building. They were walking on an overhanging piece of plywood when it broke and they fell 12 feet to the ground, resulting in a broken leg and ankle.
An employee was transitioning from a ladder to gain access to the roof of a structure when he slipped. The employee fell approximately 12.5 feet onto plywood below, resulting in a strained back.
An employee was climbing a muddy ladder when it shifted to the side. The employee fell to the ground and sustained a fractured wrist.
An employee was cutting a piece of metal when a spark from the metal came in contact with gas in a nearby gasoline can and caused a fire. The employee sustained burns to their face.

An employee was standing in the bed of a utility truck and was loading a PVC pipe onto a rack in the back of the truck. The employee was pulling the PVC pipe when a strap came loose and he fell backward to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured vertebra.
An employee was setting up stage equipment when they were struck from behind by a mobile cart, resulting in a fracture to their lower right leg.

An employee was assisting a crane operator in lifting a 6-inch-diameter pipe over a 2-inch-diameter pipe when the load lowered, causing the employee's right ring finger to be pinched between the 6-inch pipe and a pipe rack. The employee suffered an amputation of the right ring finger from the nail bed to the tip.
An employee was riding a skid steer when he fell to the ground. The employee landed on his back, sustaining fractures to his back and ribs, and punctured lungs.

An employee was walking across a 2-foot sloped edge at a job site. He slipped down the slope, which had been softened by rain, and his foot landed on a hammer that was hanging from his tool belt. This caused his ankle to roll and break.

An employee was unloading steel power poles from a trailer when the poles became off-balanced. The employee attempted to grab a pole when it slipped and pinched their right ring finger against another section of poles, resulting in an amputation to the finger.

An employee dropped a marker behind a stack of drywall. While retrieving the marker, the stack of drywall fell and knocked him to the ground. The drywall landed on his right foot and ankle, resulting in an ankle fracture.

An employee was painting a temporary marking on a roof. The employee slipped in wet paint and fell off the roof to the ground about 18.5 feet below. The employee suffered two broken wrists and a broken rib and was hospitalized. Fall protection was not worn at the time.

An employee was doing carpentry work and became dizzy in the morning and then suffered cramping in the afternoon. The employee was hospitalized, suffering from heat exhaustion and heat-related muscle injury.

An employee was using a concrete boom pump to pour a slab of concrete at the jobsite. When the employee maneuvered the hose/handle, part of the truck-mounted arm broke off and struck the employee's head and shoulder. The employee was knocked down. The employee was hospitalized with blunt force trauma to the head and left shoulder, lacerations to the face, fractures to their ribs and right foot, and a sprained left foot.

An employee was working with a concrete boom pump. While they were maneuvering the hose/handle, the truck-mounted arm snapped off and the hose landed on top of the employee. The employee sustained a right leg fracture, broken ribs, and lacerations to the left shoulder, face, and the back of the head.

An employee was rotating a vibratory hammer to extract steel sheeting when his right ring and little fingers got pinched between the hammer and a stationary pipe that was coming up out of the ground next to the steel sheeting. The employee suffered a crush injury to his ring and little fingers as well as a partial amputation of the ring finger.
An employee was working on a roof when he began to feel ill, resulting in hospitalization due to heat exhaustion.

An employee was operating a laser cutting machine in the laser shop. He was removing a piece of scrap sheet metal and placing it into the scrap/recycling bin when it hit the side of the bin and fell over the side, outside of the bin. While retrieving it, his right hand got caught on the edge of the scrap bin. The sheet metal piece fell to the floor and the rest of the sheet metal from the machine fell on his arm. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured arm and required surgery.
An employee was standing on the rig floor installing casing. A cable snapped and a block struck the employee's right leg, fracturing the femur.
An employee was moving a 27-inch pull-box lid when the lid slipped and pinched their right index finger. The employee sustained a laceration to their right index finger and they were hospitalized.
A flagger was attempting to detour a car when an altercation occurred and a man pulled out a gun and fired at the employee multiple times. The employee sustained a gunshot wound to their right hand.
Employee 1 was lifting a bundle of rebar from a flatbed when the bundle fell onto employee 2's right ankle, resulting in a fracture.

An employee was on a canopy on top of a school walkway and working to remove wood and install metal. He had been cutting wood boards while standing on the awning that was approximately 9 feet high. The wood planks attached to the north side of the walkway broke loose while the employee was standing on them and he fell to the ground with the boards falling on top of him. The employee hit his head and sustained a concussion, lacerations, and fractures to their L3-L4 vertebrae and ribs, as well as a dislocated shoulder.
An employee was closing the tailgate of a dump truck and pinched two fingers, resulting in amputation of the left middle fingertip.
An employee was shoveling material (crusher fines) from a conveyor belt when they were caught in the conveyor belt and sustained lacerations and fractures to their face as well as broken ribs.
An employee was descending from the base of a mobile crane when his foot slipped into a void between the base and a stair. He suffered a broken leg.

A crane was setting down a rigged heat exchanger onto dunnage on the 18th floor of a building. The dunnage failed, causing the heat exchanger to fall and crush an employee's foot. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.

An employee was using a circular saw to cut 2-by-6 boards that were supported by sawhorses. The saw became wedged in the wood, kicked back, and cut the employee's left middle finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was walking down a wheelchair ramp when his foot became caught on the end of the ramp and his right ankle was fractured.

An employee was waiting in the cab of a service truck for machines to be serviced on a construction site. When the front-end loader arrived, the employee exited their vehicle and started unrolling fuel hoses from the rear of the service truck. A skid steer approached and the bucket of the skid steer pinned the employee against the service truck. The employee sustained a broken rib, lacerated liver, and an injured spleen. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking on a shoring structure (elevated platform) when he fell approximately 10 feet to the concrete floor. The employee sustained a back injury.
An employee was carrying materials when they fell through an open mechanical shaft hole. The employee landed on the floor 11 feet below and suffered multiple fractures.
An employee was using a jackhammer to bust concrete when the jackhammer slipped and injured his left foot. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting a 12-inch ductile iron stormwater pipe with a demolition saw. The saw kicked back and struck the employee's right cheek and jaw, resulting in a laceration.

On July 22, 2024, an employee was drilling out electrical panel covers and picked up three panel lids weighing approximately 15-20 pounds when he felt a pinch in his back. He was hospitalized with a pinched nerve in his back.

Employees were conducting site preparation. The injured employee was using a paint roller to apply primer to a concrete deck. There was welding work happening on the floor directly below the injured employee. A spark from the welding ignited fumes from the primer; there was a flash fire and the injured employee's legs and lower back were burned.

An employee was preparing to paint a tank when she noticed a blind flange in the manway that was positioned partially upright from an entrance. The employee attempted to move the blind flange, causing the 280-pound manway to fall over and land on her left foot. The employee was hospitalized and treated for a hematoma on the top of her left foot.
An employee suffered a strain and developed a hernia while moving storage totes. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was working in the man basket on a boom lift truck when a concrete wall panel that was being lifted by a crane struck the man basket, tipping it over. The employee fell to the ground and sustained fractures to their hip and face and injuries to their bladder and colon.

The injured employee was working on a spout when he asked another employee to hand him a ladder. Once the other employee had the ladder ready, the injured employee started walking toward the ladder, stepped into the open floor hatch gate, and fell about 3 feet and also contacted the ladder hatch. He was able to suspend himself with his elbows and hands. He then lifted himself up and was able to lean over, getting onto the platform. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured left tibia and required surgery.
An employee had been rigging a crane load. They became ill and were hospitalized with heat illness.
An employee was making construction wood forms when they lost consciousness. They were hospitalized for heat illness.

A crew of four employees were moving a large and heavy sectional floor panel from one room to another. They were utilizing two forklifts with a boom attachment as a lifting mechanism (tandem lifting). They moved the panel as much as they could through the doorway and then had to adjust it. They lowered the floor panel so that one side was resting on the floor. The employee went to make an adjustment when the floor panel slid and pinned his leg against a safety bollard that was outside the doorway. The employee suffered a fractured right tibia and fibula above the ankle.
An employee was hooking a trailer to his tractor when he stepped off the back of the truck and fell 3 feet to the ground. He landed on his back and sustained pinched nerves in his lower back.
An employee was cutting pipe when the pipe came loose and struck him in the face, resulting in a laceration to the right side of his face from nose to chin. The employee was hospitalized.

Employees were testing and repairing a sewer line while in a trench that was approximately 3.5 feet deep. Employee 1 was standing and employee 2 was squatting down to work on the line when the trench walls collapsed. Employee 2 was engulfed by the dirt. Both employees were transported to the hospital. Employee 1 was treated but not hospitalized. Employee 2 was hospitalized with a fractured pelvis and injury to the abdominal area.

An employee was coming down from a roof on a ladder. His foot slipped when he was approximately 6 rungs off the ground. He fell to the ground and landed on his ankle. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured ankle.
An employee was working in a warehouse and felt lightheaded. The employee fell and was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.

An employee was repairing cabinets in a residential new construction home. The employee was re-nailing two pieces of cabinet crown molding together when his hand holding the nail gun slipped and a nail discharged into the carpal bone that connects to his index finger. The employee was hospitalized for surgery to remove the nail.
An employee was cutting an 8-inch water pipe when the demolition saw blade became wedged. The employee was freeing the blade when they fell and sustained a severe laceration to their face.
An employee was holding a tag line for the crane when their foot was run over by an aerial lift that was in operation. The employee was hospitalized with fractured ankle bones and required surgery.
An employee was cutting an iron pipe mounted on a trailer when the pipe rolled over their leg, resulting in a right tibia fracture and compartment syndrome in their lower right leg.

Two employees were walking on either side of a street, making sure that lengths of 6-inch-wide sewer pipe did not slide off the forks of a skid steer that was carrying them down the road. The skid steer's rubber tracks ran over one of the two employees' feet. He suffered foot and ankle fractures.

An employee climbed a ladder to put the cover back on the motor of a high-speed overhead door. He needed to duck his head to get around the track to perform work on the motor. When third-party employees walked in front of the door on the opposite side, they triggered the motion sensor and the overhead door began to open. As the overhead door opened, it struck the injured employee in the left orbital socket and knocked him off the ladder. He fell six feet to the ground below and sustained a fracture to his forearm just below the elbow and a bruised left hip.

On July 24, 2024, at around 9:10 AM, an employee was putting a label on moving sheet metal inside of the coil line when their left arm got caught in the line and the sheet metal lacerated the employee's forearm requiring surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was closing a door when their finger became caught in the door. A fingertip on their left hand was amputated.

An employee was standing on a 12-foot extension ladder painting the exterior of a building when the ladder slipped on gravel. The employee fell approximately 9 feet and the ladder landed on his ankles. Both ankles and his right knee were fractured and the employee was hospitalized for surgery.
On July 24, 2024, an electrical lineman was in a bucket truck and came in contact with a live, electrical power line resulting in hospitalization for electrical burns.

An employee slipped while walking on steel girts loaded on flatbed trailer and fell striking the mast of a nearby, parked forklift. The employee sustained a laceration above his upper lip. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
Employees were erecting a staircase when the staircase fell and hit one employee on the leg causing a fracture.
An employee was installing windows when they experienced heat-related illnesses such as cramps, seizures, dehydration, and severe sweating.

On 7/25/2024 an employee was on an overhang platform under a bridge deck. He walked down the platform to help another employee that was on top of the bridge. He then fell off the platform and onto the ground about 11 feet below, sustaining spinal fractures and head lacerations.
An employee was installing handrails on a scaffold and fell 8 feet from the working deck of the scaffold to the ground. The employee fractured ribs.

An employee was in the bucket of a boom-truck that was elevated directly under powerlines. The employee was installing fiber optic lines when a powerline insulator failed/broke, which allowed a powerline to make contact with the employee who sustained electrical burns to the back and arm. The employee was hospitalized.

During a visual inspection of a pressure digger, the Kelly bar unexpectedly dropped onto the employee's left hand, resulting in open fractures of the middle and index fingers, The middle finger was amputated near the knuckle.
An employee fell from the second floor to the unfinished ground below and sustained a fractured tibia and contusions.

Two employees were on a scissor lift traveling to an adjacent room. As they went through a doorframe, an employee was pinned between the doorframe and the railing of the scissor lift. The employee sustained a spinal injury that affected their lower extremities.
An employee was offloading a plate compactor from the company truck and felt pain in the abdominal area. The employee sustained a hernia.
An employee was cutting a piece of wood with a circular saw when the saw lacerated the top of their left foot.

An employee was installing siding on a new residential home. The employee fell approximately 20-24 feet from a pump jack scaffold system to the ground below and struck a silt fence system during the fall. The employee sustained back injuries.

An employee was retrieving material from the open bin of a digger derrick when the digger derrick contacted 7,200-volt primary electric lines. The employee sustained an electrical shock that went through his arms and exited his right foot.
An employee was up 8 feet on a platform when he cut into a live electrical circuit. He sustained a shock and fell to the ground. The employee's back was fractured.
An employee was rigging/hanging steel to begin the steel erection process. A steel beam swung out and struck the employee breaking their tibia and ankle.

The injured employee was moving a sheet of 4 x 8 plywood with another employee when his foot slipped 3 feet down into a hole and got caught on exposed rebar, causing him to fall. He was hospitalized with two fractures to his left tibia.
An employee was installing power lines from a bucket truck. The employee became overheated and was later hospitalized for dehydration.

An employee using an overhead crane to move a main shaft of a wind turbine to stage the shaft for transportation. The variable speed crane began to move faster and the load began to swing. The employee went to halt the shaft s swinging and their hand got caught between the main shaft that was swinging and a stationary main shaft. The employee's right arm was fractured, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
During roof repair, an employee was moving on the roof to establish a new tie-off point when they stepped on a roof panel that gave way and fell to a lower level. The employee sustained broken ribs.

An employee was unhooking a clevis hook from the bottom side of a telehandler when the telehandler backed up and the employee was pinched between the telehandler and a man lift. The employee sustained fractures to their clavicle and a rib.
An employee had finished his work day and started heading home when he became ill due to heat stress and was hospitalized.

An employee was installing a concrete pier to lay rebar down. The strap broke off the auger and the cradle of the drilling rig broke and struck the employee on the top of his hard hat, knocking him to the ground and knocking off the hard hat. The employee sustained a fractured C-3 vertebra and an injured C-4 vertebra.
An employee was using a drywall knife to cut plastic piping for a septic tank when the knife cut his left wrist and radial artery.

An employee was removing tiles from a lift truck and placing them on a roof. The employee stepped on a soft spot in the roof, then took a step backward and fell off the roof, landing on a concrete patio approximately 15 feet below. The employee sustained a laceration to the head and fractures to their left wrist and two ribs.
On July 30, 2024, an employee was setting up aluminum forms for a concrete foundation wall when they became ill due to the heat at the job site. The employee was hospitalized with heat exhaustion.
An employee was carrying wood poles into a truck, when he felt pain in his stomach. The employee sustained a hernia and required surgery.

An employee was cutting wood flooring materials in the driveway of a residential construction worksite. The employee used a table saw to rip the tongue off a fresh cut of wood approximately 12" in length. The saw kicked back, which sent the board forcefully backward into the employee's right knee. The board then ricocheted into their left arm. The impact from the wooden board ruptured the bursa sac in the employee's knee, requiring hospitalization for surgery. The employee also sustained a fractured femur.

An employee was crouched down while checking wires in a receptacle box. He tried to turn to his right and his left knee struck the first sheet of tile in a stack of 15-20 sheets of 4' x 8' stone tile that was leaned against the wall. Most of the stack then fell onto the employee's legs. The employee's right fibula and tibia were fractured and required surgery.

An employee was installing HVAC vents in the ceiling above him while on an 8-foot ladder when he lost his balance and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured collarbone and rib, as well as a punctured lung.

Two employees were climbing out of the box of a lift and fell onto concrete. One employee sustained fractures to the right arm and another employee sustained injuries to the orbital area. Both employees were hospitalized.

An employee was pulling wire into a switch gear when he was shocked by 240V that caused him to jerk back and hit his head. The employee sustained an electrical shock and a concussion and was hospitalized.
An employee was hydro blasting. As he was repositioning himself, his right calf was lacerated by the pressurized water blast.
An employee was using an automated floor scraper for demolition when the hydraulic platform fell on his left foot. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured foot.

Employees were pushing culverts into place with an excavator. A pin slipped, catching the injured employee's left hand in a pinch point. The left middle and ring fingers were medically amputated at the hospital.
An employee was installing door hardware while on a 4-foot step ladder. They were getting off the ladder when they fell from the bottom rung and landed on the floor sustaining a broken left hip.

An employee was descending a road milling machine via the ladder on the left side. The ring on their left ring finger caught somewhere on the ladder while moving down the ladder and the employee fell 1-2 feet. Their left ring finger sustained a circular laceration that caused damage to an artery. The finger was partially amputated.
An employee was walking from one building to another when they tripped and fell to the ground, breaking their hip.
An employee was taping drywall from stilts when they fell on their utility belt knife and fractured their hip.
An employee jumped off a 4-foot retaining wall and sustained a fractured right femur.
An employee was overheated and showing signs of heat exhaustion while working outside. The employee was hospitalized with dehydration.

An employee was cleaning up after a job and placing an electric post insulator (approximately 35 pounds) into the dumpster when it slipped and pinched their fingers between the glass insulator and the dumpster. The employee sustained a laceration to their left middle finger and a crush injury to the index finger that resulted in a partial amputation at the hospital.

An employee was on a ladder troubleshooting an emergency light that was out in the ceiling. He removed a wire nut and a live wire sprung back, hitting his finger and shocking him. The employee jumped and fell off the ladder onto his back on the floor. He lost consciousness and sustained a head laceration and fractured vertebrae. He was wearing insulated boots and using insulated equipment.

An employee was climbing a 15-foot concrete form located on the fourth floor of a newly constructed commercial building. The employee was approximately 10-12 feet high and reaching for the next rung when they lost their balance and fell backward, striking a ladder rung (metal angle) and resulting in injury to their right arm.

An employee was changing an air filter on heavy construction equipment when a truck of fill dirt backed into the door of the equipment, pinning the employee between the door and the mechanical parts of the equipment. The employee sustained fractured and dislocated ribs and fractures to their clavicle and sternum.
An employee was re-piping in an attic. When he left the attic he began convulsing due to heat exhaustion. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was ascending a job-made ladder from the ground level when they lost their grip/balance and fell to the ground level. The employee sustained fractures to their left ankle and right heel.
An employee was working outside on a bridge construction project on a hot day when they began feeling ill. The employee was hospitalized with heat exhaustion.
An employee was taking measurements on a roof after it rained when he slipped and fell off the roof. The employee sustained a fractured hip and was hospitalized.
On August 2, 2024, an employee was clearing brush along a fence line when they came in contact with poison ivy and were hospitalized with an allergic reaction.

An employee was spotting the delivery of a generator when the trailer jack collapsed and the generator trailer dropped to the ground, pinching his right little finger between the hitch and the ground. The employee sustained a severe laceration.

An employee was on an A-frame ladder against the exterior wall of a building and was utilizing a corded reciprocating saw to cut the caulking between two sections of precast concrete wall. The blade hit the joint behind the caulking causing the employee to lose their balance and fall to the ground. The employee's right knee was fractured in three places.

An employee was removing a duct as part of a demolition project when he was struck by a falling piece of steel ductwork that was different from the one that he was working on. The duct gave way and pinned him to the floor. He sustained hip fractures and required surgery.
An employee was troubleshooting an HVAC unit and replacing the panel when their left hand contacted the moving fan blade, resulting in an amputation of their little finger above the second knuckle.

An employee was using a tugger to pull heavy electrical wire at a site when their gloved left hand was pulled through the tugger and caught in a pinch point on the equipment. The employee sustained amputations of their ring and little fingertips to the first knuckle.

An employee was standing on a platform to load material onto a truck. An operator lowered the load near the edge of the platform so the employee could remove the straps. The weight of the load caused the platform to tip and the employee fell to the ground. The employee sustained fractures and was hospitalized.

An employee was strapping down a mini excavator. While walking down the ramp they slipped and their right foot became caught under the blade of the mini excavator. The blade lowered and crushed their foot, fracturing it.
An employee was traveling from a job site to a work location when they experienced heat cramps and were hospitalized.

An employee was working from an elevated rough-terrain forklift platform and was going to change fall protection connection points when he slipped and fell approximately 25 feet. The employee sustained fractures to his pelvis and both arms.

An employee was using a scissor lift to work on a light pole approximately 20 feet above the ground when a gust of wind tipped the lift over. The employee fell to the ground with the lift and sustained three broken ribs, a collapsed lung, and a fractured pelvis. Outriggers were not used at the time.

An employee was walking across a cooler top tracing refrigeration piping when they fell through netting on the cooler. They fell off the cooler and through a drop ceiling to the concrete floor. The employee sustained a fractured hip.
An employee was climbing onto a crane when they fell off the ladder and sustained fractured vertebrae.

During dredging operations on a barge, an employee was manually feeding a 2-inch steel cable in an 8-foot by 10-foot spool and repositioning the cable into the spool groove. Their right hand became pinched beneath the cable, resulting in an amputation of the index finger.
An employee was assisting with hoisting up a hydraulic cylinder when the cylinder slipped and fell on their foot, fracturing a toe.
An employee was standing on a 10-foot A-frame ladder while welding when they fell to the ground. The employee sustained a neck injury.
An employee was cutting brick fascia using a 4.5 inch corded angle grinder equipped with a diamond blade. The grinder kicked back and lacerated the employee's left wrist, severing an artery.
An employee was changing out 2x4 lights when he was shocked and fell from the fourth rung of his ladder onto a chair below him. The employee sustained fractured rib(s) and collapsing lung(s).

An employee was in a man basket attached to a telehandler when their hand was crushed between the basket and the telehandler as it was descending. The employee sustained a partial amputation of their right ring finger.
An employee was standing on a 12-foot A-frame ladder to install a sprinkler head when he fell to the floor and sustained a head injury.
An employee was using a table saw to cut polystyrene foam when his hand was pulled into the blade, amputating his right index finger and part of his right thumb.

An employee was standing on a ladder and hooking up wires to an exit sign when he lost his balance and fell. He tried to catch himself and pulled a wire out of the light that shocked him. The employee also sustained a shoulder injury.
An employee became dehydrated while installing solar panels on a roof and was hospitalized.

A crew was installing a T-liner in the ground when the bladder blew out and air was released, causing the backflow preventer and the standpipe cap to be ejected from the ground, striking an employee's arm. The employee sustained a laceration and a fracture to his right ulna.

On August 5, 2024, an employee was fueling an excavator. He was walking on the excavator tracks to turn the fuel pump on. While walking back down the excavator track, he tripped and fell striking his head on the excavator bucket and causing his safety glasses to become lodged under his right eye. The employee was hospitalized for lacerations to the back of his right eyeball.
An employee was placing rebar during concrete construction activities when they began to experience cramping. The employee was hospitalized with a heat-related illness.

An employee was working from a scaffold approximately 15 feet high to nail sheet rock to an interior wall. The employee fell backward and the scaffold collapsed. The employee was hospitalized with a shattered right shin and ankle and required surgery.

An employee was operating a digger derrick with an auger and bucket attachment as old power poles were being removed. Bolts on the machine's boom broke off, causing it to tip over. The employee struck the ground and suffered a broken femur.
An employee was stacking metal trench boxes when a pin slipped and caught his right thumb, partially amputating it.
An employee was struck by a traffic control pickup truck while meeting with traffic control workers in an off-road area. The employee suffered a broken femur that required surgery.
An employee was working on a 120-volt secondary line from the bucket of a line truck when they contacted the line and sustained an irregular heart rhythm.

The injured employee and another employee were removing a manhole cover. An employee lifted the cover with a hook. The hook slipped off the cover and the cover fell onto the gloved hand of the injured employee, pinning his left middle fingertip against the frame of the manhole. The injured employee sustained a fingertip amputation without bone loss and was hospitalized and underwent reattachment surgery.
On August 7, 2024, an employee was unloading jersey barriers from a forklift when his right middle finger was caught between a piece of dunnage and the asphalt and was partially amputated.

On August 7, 2024, an employee was respooling cable onto a crane tip sheave when their hand was pulled into and pinched in the sheave along with the cable. The employee sustained partial amputations to two fingertips.

An employee was using a razor blade to cut stray fibers from a piece of fiber during construction activities. His hand slipped and a knuckle on his right index finger was severely lacerated. A tendon was cut, requiring stitches and surgery.

An employee was climbing a 6-foot wooden ladder when they fell to the ground and landed on a 10-inch duct knife that was attached to their belt. The knife stabbed them in the back and they sustained internal injuries and a fractured wrist.

An employee was installing overhead hangers for electrical conduits and equipment. He was on a manlift when a piece of the duct work he was leaning on gave way. He fell about 20 feet and sustained fractures to vertebrae and an elbow.
At about 11:50 a.m. on August 8, 2024, an employee was struck by a car that breached the work zone barricades. The employee suffered head trauma and a fracture to their orbital bone.
An employee was supervising the movement of an 80-foot piece of rail when the rail landed on his left foot and tore into the steel toe of his boot, causing lacerations to his toes.

An employee was walking beside an asphalt paving machine. The employee tripped and fell into the path of the machine, whose tracks ran over the employee's right leg. The employee suffered an amputation to the lower leg.

An employee was moving empty wooden wire spools with an all-terrain forklift. After placing one spool on another and backing the forklift up slightly, he noticed that the fork's tips had stuck to the spool and gapped at the bottom away from the mast. He stopped the forklift, left the operator's position, and dislodged the forks. The forks fell into place and pinched his right hand, amputating the thumb.
An employee was operating an aluminum punch machine. The punch machine caused an open fracture to the employee's right thumb.
An employee was struck by a vehicle in a road work zone and sustained a fractured leg.
An employee was climbing a ladder to wire a junction box when he fell off the seventh rung of the ladder to the ground. The employee sustained head trauma.

A 10-foot by 12-foot wooden sheer wall panel was being installed. The plywood sheeting on the panel was too long and had to be trimmed down in order to make the seams flush between two other panels. An employee had just turned to walk away from the panel to retrieve a saw when it fell toward him, crushing his left leg from shin to foot.

An employee was stepping down from the trash rake platform when they slipped and the corner of an I-beam next to the step punctured and lacerated the employee's right thigh area. The employee was hospitalized.
On August 9, 2024, an employee was shoveling dirt at a storm drainpipe construction site when they became severely dehydrated and were hospitalized with heat illness.

An employee was tying down weights to his trailer with chains and binders after working all day in a service truck when he became dizzy and experienced cramps. The employee was hospitalized with heat exhaustion/dehydration.
An employee was using rebar in a drill to pull a wire when the rebar cut his left ring finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was investigating a clogged drain outside when he experienced heat stress and dehydration and was hospitalized.

An employee was driving steel H-beams for structural support for the dock. They rigged up a beam and moved it over 5 feet, setting it down on a sheet pile and dunnage. When unhooked the rigging, the beam rolled onto the employee's left leg, fracturing it.

On August 12, 2024, an employee was traveling in a boom lift through a substation when it contacted an angle iron brace. The employee's body was caught between the brace and the boom lift controls and they sustained a fractured jaw.
An employee was installing sheathing on the roof of a one-story building when they fell approximately 12 feet to the ground below, resulting in broken ribs.

An employee was sitting on a stack of crane mats approximately 4 feet high when the mats fell over. As the employee attempted to get away from the falling mats, one of the mats struck their right ankle, fracturing and dislocating it. The employee was hospitalized.

On August 12, 2024, an employee was loading a traffic roller onto a flatbed trailer when the left front of the roller went over the edge of the trailer and overturned onto the ground. The employee was struck by the roller and caught between the roller's steering column and the gravel ground. The employee sustained lacerations and fractures to their pelvis, right ankle, knee, and tibia.

An employee was climbing a pull-down staircase to a residential attic when it became detached from the ceiling frame and fell to the floor. The employee fell with it, resulting in a dislocated and fractured left ankle and a fractured left shoulder.
An employee was conducting a foundation repair and pushing a pier into the ground. The pier struck an unmarked underground utility and the employee sustained an electrical shock.
An employee was descending a set of stairs when they fell down the stairs and fractured their hip.
On August 13, 2024, at approximately 3:00 p.m., an employee sustained fractures to their left middle and ring fingers while operating an unguarded mechanical press machine to cut metal sheets.

On August 13, 2024, an employee was conducting framing activities inside of a new multifamily residential structure. He climbed out of a second-story window to gain access to the adjacent multifamily unit's window and fell approximately 11 feet to the ground below. Both of his legs were broken and he was hospitalized.
An employee was working outside when they began experiencing cramping and nausea. The employee was hospitalized with a heat-related illness.

An employee was on the roof of a porch overhang when the porch anchors failed and the roof fell approximately 6-7 feet. The employee fell to the ground and the roof landed on him, resulting in a back injury and requiring surgery.

An employee was erecting portions of a metal building using a boom lift that was approximately 25 feet high. The boom came near a power line and electricity arced from the power line to the employee, who was hospitalized with electrical burns to the shoulder and buttocks.

The injured employee was on the fifth step of an 8-foot ladder using wire cutters to show two other employees which wire was still hot in the junction box. The wire cutter penetrated the wire sheathing and the employee was shocked. The injured employee began to fall backward off the ladder and the other two employees were able to cushion his fall. The employee sustained a broken pelvic bone on the right side.
An employee was picking up trash at a worksite and they went pale and had difficulty speaking due to heat. The employee was hospitalized due to dehydration.
An employee performing thermoplastic handwork at an intersection was struck by a vehicle in his work zone resulting in a broken leg that required surgery and head injuries that required staples.
An employee was kneeling and caulking a horizontal joint on the deck floor in a parking garage when they were struck by a vehicle, resulting in a fractured leg.

An employee was conducting routine air conditioner maintenance on a condenser. While checking the refrigerant pressures, the gauges got caught and his left hand contacted the fan blade. The employee sustained a fractured left index finger.

An employee was digging a hole for the placement of telecommunication lines. He contacted energized live parts within the transformer cabinet and sustained an electrical shock, primarily affecting his hands, and was hospitalized.
An employee was using a handheld grinder to cut a hydraulic hose when the grinder kicked back and lacerated his left thumb.
An employee was cleaning a job site and fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized for broken ribs and a collapsed lung.

A crew of 6 to 8 employees were relining a sewer pipe using a concrete liner system. The employees are required to pump hot water through the liner to cure the concrete. As the employees were disconnecting the hose from the system, residual pressure from an unknown source caused two employees to be sprayed with hot water (greater than 190 degrees Fahrenheit). Employee 1 sustained second-degree burns to his torso and employee 2 sustained second-degree burns to both feet. Both employees were hospitalized.
An employee collapsed due to heat exhaustion and was hospitalized.

On August 14, 2024, an employee was operating a gas-powered concrete cut-off saw to cut into an existing concrete manhole. The saw kicked back and struck the employee's face. The employee sustained a fractured jaw and facial lacerations requiring stitches.

An employee was driving the water truck and spraying water when a third-party dump truck driver flagged him down asking for help. The dump truck driver's tailgate was in a bind with the screen that covers the truck bed. When the employee got up on the truck to help, the tailgate released and slammed down on his foot. The tailgate crushed his big toe and the toe next to it. The big toe was medically amputated.

On August 14, 2024, an employee was aligning a 6-inch plastic pipe while on a 50-degree slope when their right foot slipped and they fell, resulting in a fractured right tibia that required hospitalization.
An employee was accessing a penthouse roof using a fixed ladder on a tenth-story roof and fell approximately 12-13 feet, landing on a lower roof. He sustained a back contusion and was hospitalized.

Two employees were cutting sheet metal when a stack of sheet metal fell from the equipment due to vibration. The sheet metal landed on the employees' hands. Employee 1 sustained a broken left hand and their index and middle fingers required surgery. Employee 2 sustained an amputation to their little finger and was not hospitalized.
An employee was descending a 12-foot step ladder when he lost his balance and fell onto his right hip on the ground below. The employee sustained a fractured right hip.

An employee was cutting siding on the second-floor stairs balcony area and started feeling dizzy due to heat illness. The employee fell onto the first floor (about 6 feet) and fractured their collar bone.
On August 15, 2024, an employee was bitten on the right index finger by a pygmy rattlesnake at a construction site. He was hospitalized.

An employee was on a ladder removing a piece of pipe. The pipe got hung up, causing the employee to lose their balance and fall from the ladder. The employee sustained a broken wrist requiring surgery.
An employee was cutting wood trim for a door frame on a table saw when the blade caught his right middle finger resulting in the amputation of 90% of his finger.
An employee on a roofing crew was hospitalized for dehydration due to heat exposure.
An employee was cleaning a spray paint gun when a urethane zinc-rich primer was injected into the top portion of his left middle finger.
An employee was climbing a ladder to perform a painting task. The employee slipped off the ladder and fell backward to the concrete ground. He struck the back of his head and sustained head trauma.

On August 18, 2024, at 7:30 PM, an employee loaded a milling machine onto a lowboy trailer. While raising the lowboy deck, the welds broke on the trailer and the trailer dropped to the ground, landing on the employee's right foot. The employee's foot was crushed and multiple bones were broken.

An employee was drilling holes with a hammer drill, vacuum bit, and vacuum. He was starting a new hole and grabbed the bit with his left hand between the vacuum attachment and the drill chuck. The drill continued to spin, catching his glove/little finger and wrapping it up, resulting in the amputation of the finger.

Three employees were on a boom lift to assess storm damage on a roof. When they got up about 10 feet, they encountered two vent pipes for a boiler. It started burning the lift operator and the two other employees ducked below the pipes. The lift operator was hospitalized for burns and smoke inhalation.

An employee was installing a fence. When cutting a section of wire for the fence from a spool, the section he cut retracted and struck the employee's left eye. The tension wire caused a puncture through the inside corner of his eye under his safety glasses. It penetrated the orbital socket, causing a fracture to his orbital bone and a brain bleed behind his eye. He developed swelling and bruising.
An employee was installing a relay for an exhaust fan. The employee suffered a 220-volt shock, which caused electrical burns.
An employee was manually feeding a tagline to a crane when the tagline wrapped around his left little finger while being lifted by the crane, resulting in the amputation of the finger.
An employee was descending the hydraulic scaffolding ladder and fell approximately 12 feet onto stacked concrete blocks on the ground. The employee sustained a fractured sacrum.
An employee was on a step ladder handling a piece of flashing. The employee slipped and fell to the concrete floor, sustaining a fractured arm and a scratch on his face.
An employee was transitioning from a roof deck to an extension ladder when the ladder shifted and kicked out. The employee fell and sustained a compound fracture to the right ankle.
An employee was walking with a wheelbarrow on a roof when they slipped and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a displaced malleolus fracture to their ankle, which required surgery to repair.
An employee was working as part of the asphalt crew on a new parking lot. At the end of the shift, the employee was hospitalized for severe cramps and dehydration.
A team was beginning to dig holes at a new construction site. The injured employee was struck by the auger on a skid steer and sustained a leg fracture.

An employee was cleaning in the mechanical room. He went to move a pump weighing 30 pounds from the concrete floor to a pallet so the floor could be swept. As he picked up the pump he felt pain in his back and so he put the unit down. He then fell and was unable to get up. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was inspecting a leak on a mini trackhoe when the bucket was moved, striking a co-worker in the chest. The injured employee was hospitalized with six broken ribs.
An employee was doing roofing work when they became ill and experienced body cramps, resulting in hospitalization for heat stress.

An employee was removing cellulose insulation from an attic space using an insulation removal vacuum. The employee's hand was caught in the machine resulting in amputation of their right index finger. The vacuum machine was running at the time.

An employee was lowering himself to ground level from a drill rig platform when his left middle fingertip was pinched between the jaw of a hydraulic wrench and a section of the drill rig as the wrench was opened, resulting in an amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was struck by a lawn service trailer and was hospitalized with a fractured lower leg and ankle.

During bridge column construction, an employee was working inside a 4-foot by 6-foot column at a depth of approximately 25 feet. The employee was standing on a rebar cage to vibrate concrete as it was being poured into the column via a crane, hopper, and tremie. The concrete tremie failed, causing concrete to fall from the concrete hopper onto the employee's leg, resulting in leg fractures.

Employees were replacing an overhead utility line switch with a new set of switchgear. The injured employee was tightening a bolt to complete the last step of the work when an arc flash occurred and the employee was shocked.

An employee was driving a mobile elevated work platform (MEWP) lift through an open double doorway. The lift was in the down position and about 6-7 feet off the ground. The employee was crouching down as his hardhat struck against the door jamb, causing him to fall backward against the railing of the lift or the yoyo. The employee sustained four fractures to their lumbar vertebrae.
An employee was carrying rebar to another area of the jobsite when they slipped on gravel and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured left ankle.

An employee was using a line level to keep tension in a wire line. The wire became stuck and needed to be uncoiled. While the employee was uncoiling the wire, the wire pushed his left hand against the level, crushing his left middle finger. The employee sustained an amputation to the left middle finger.

An employee was operating a punch saw beam line machine when the machine cycled and the employee was pinned between the transfer rack and the material and their pelvis was crushed. The employee sustained three pelvis fractures and an injury to their left femoral artery.
An employee was operating a scissor lift when it collided with a gantry crane, causing the lift to tip over. The employee fell to the ground and sustained an injured pelvis.
An employee was using a wet saw to cut tile when the saw pulled the material and their left hand into the blade, resulting in a partial amputation to their index finger.
An employee was straddling the peak of a roof while nailing down a ridge cap. The employee's nail gun shot a nail into his knee.
An employee was performing leading edge work when they fell 10-12 feet to the ground and sustained fractures to their L2 vertebra, left wrist, and both heels. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was pulling wire on a 10-foot ladder when he lost his balance and jumped 7-8 feet to the ground. The employee sustained back vertebrae fractures.
An employee was helping to remove a bucket from a skid-steer loader when the bucket came loose and struck the employee's left leg, resulting in a degloving. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was assisting in pouring a concrete residential slab. They stepped backward, slipped on some dirt and fell backward. The employee's hand went behind their head and their thumb was crushed between a rock on the ground and their hard hat. A portion of the employee's thumb tip was amputated.
An employee was welding a 10-inch pipe when it slipped off the stand and crushed their left ring finger.

On August 23, 2024, an employee was accessing ducts on top of a roof structure to take measurements. While transitioning from the top duct to the bottom duct, he fell approximately 5 feet, resulting in a head injury.

An employee was working at an angling machine while it was in automatic operation. He went to grab his work gloves when the machine sent the steel down the line and it struck the employee's abdominal area. The employee was hospitalized with a liver injury.
An employee was cleaning when a brick fell from a roof and struck his head, resulting in a fractured skull.
An employee was on roof when he began to feel ill. After he took a break, he began cleaning up and again started feeling nauseous. He was hospitalized with heat exhaustion.
An employee fell approximately 13 feet from a roof to the ground. He was hospitalized with several broken ribs, a partially collapsed lung, and a lacerated liver.

An employee was spray painting and fell approximately 12 feet from an extension ladder to the concrete landing below, resulting in a broken tibia and fibula in their left leg and a soft tissue injury in their right leg.

An employee was being shown the demolition work to be done on the truss of a joist. He stepped in and fell through the roof truss. The employee sustained a fractured skull, a brain bleed, and a broken left wrist.
An employee was using a circular saw to cut PVC pipe during sidewalk repairs. The saw amputated their left thumb.
An employee was working from a scaffold and applying fabric to a lecture hall divider. The employee fell about 10 feet and sustained a back contusion. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was installing solar panels on the roof of a barn. They were utilizing a ladder to get off the roof when the ladder slipped. The employee and the ladder fell approximately 15 feet to the ground level. The employee sustained fractures to their left humerus, right wrist, and a rib.

An employee was cutting plywood strips for edge forms using a circular saw. The employee was cutting with the plywood nailed down to the table and two hands on the saw. While cutting, the saw bound up momentarily. The employee lost his grip and brought his left hand to the table to catch himself. At this point, the saw reengaged and amputated the tip of his left index finger.
A screen enclosure on a roof was being demolished when an employee fell from the roof to the ground about 8 feet below, suffering a concussion and a brain bleed.
An employee was folding up a ladder. The ladder caught the employee's right index finger and amputated it.

An employee was moving a toolbox from one location to another. The employee put the toolbox on a hoist and his right index finger was pinched between the toolbox and hoist, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was working on top of the asphalt silo when he began to feel overheated. The employee was hospitalized for heat illness and acute renal failure.

An employee exited their pickup truck. They were opening the gate when the truck rolled forward onto their left leg, resulting in compartmentalized swelling and bruising. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a concrete vibrator during concrete pouring operations. Concrete material splattered onto the employee's clothing and soaked through, causing chemical burns to the employee's skin.
An employee was chaining concrete forms to a telehandler forklift for removal. The telehandler sunk in soft soil causing the boom to drop and crush the employee's hand between the boom and a form.

An employee was installing wing nuts and walers to secure a wall framework. As he was moving from one area on the wall form to another, he slipped and fell about 10-12 feet to the concrete floor, suffering a broken right leg and a dislocated right wrist. His fall protection was unhooked at the time.

A truck driver was loading a flatbed trailer in the loading dock. The load on the trailer consisted of several toolboxes and a forklift. While adjusting the width of the forklift forks, the driver kicked the forks, then lost their balance and fell approximately 3 feet from the trailer to the ground. The employee's leg was fractured below the knee.

Two employees were adding wire pull boxes to two empty conduits. Employee 1 loosened a coupling on a conduit and opened it to check if it was empty. Wires were visible, so the employee went to close the conduit again. Wires in the conduit became pinched and a wire's insulated jacket was damaged. Electricity in the wire (277 volts), grounded out through employee 1 and he was unable to let go of the conduit. Employee 2 pulled employee 1 away and was also shocked. Both employees were hospitalized for electrical shock.
An employee was installing rebar when they started feeling cramps in their legs. The employee sustained dehydration due to heat.

Employees were setting up a paver for a paving project starting the next day. They were installing the strike-off plate when the plate slid while it was being attached and struck the injured employee's right thumb, amputating the tip of it.
An employee was working outside in the heat and sustained dehydration.
An employee was installing lighting. The employee broke through a drop ceiling and fell 26 feet, suffering fractures to the ribs, pelvis, and left wrist as well as a head laceration.

An employee was on catwalk and caulking a bucket elevator where it meets the roof of the building. The employee had caulked one side and was repositioning himself to caulk the other side when he slipped and fell 25 feet to the ground. The employee sustained fractures to their left wrist and pelvis.
An employee was performing roofing installation activities and sustained heat exhaustion.

An employee was unloading plywood from a telehandler onto the second story of a new construction residential townhouse. They stepped onto the stacked plywood and fell 22 feet onto construction material and the ground below. The employee sustained a fractured skull and jaw. Fall protection was not in place at the time.

Employees were installing an HVAC unit. Part of the installation process was done inside a residence and the other part was outside. Employees finished working inside and were working outside when an employee felt ill. The employee sustained dehydration due to the heat.

An employee was in an attic to evaluate the material required to reinstall a plumbing vent in a garage. The employee fell through the ceiling and landed 8 feet below on the concrete floor of the garage. The employee sustained a compression fracture to their L1 vertebra.

On August 28, 2024, an employee was installing insulation on the fifth floor of the site. They fell through an opening for a trash chute that had not been installed. The employee landed on the second floor and sustained fractures to their arm and ribs.
An employee was using a brake press to bend a metal part when his left hand was caught in the point of operation. The employee's index finger was partially amputated.

An employee was cleaning broken-up concrete off a bridge deck. He stepped out on a wood deck that was supported by bridge hangers. The bridge hangers at this area of the deck failed and the deck fell. The employee fell 26 feet to the ground below the bridge. The employee sustained fractures to their C7, T5,and T6 vertebrae, and their right hip was dislocated.
On August 28, 2024, an employee utilized a sawhorse and a circular saw to cut a 2 x 4. The saw struck a knot in the board and kicked back, amputating the tip of the employee's thumb.
An employee was using a battery-powered saw to cut wood when their left index finger was amputated.

Three employees were removing a cover from an oil well storage tank. Some of the bolts were corroded, so the employees used an electric grinder to remove the bolts. Sparks from the grinding wheel ignited liquid/fumes inside the tank, causing the tank to explode. One employee received severe burns to over 70% of their body.

The injured employee was on the ground level while other employees were tarping a hole at the facility. A cinder block (5-8 pounds) fell approximately 10 feet from a building due to the high winds and damage from a hurricane. The employee was looking upward at the roof and the concrete block struck the employee's hard hat, knocking it off and hitting him in the face and left hand. The employee fell backward and struck the back of his head on the concrete floor.
