The employee sustained contusions to his lip, jaw, and left hand and a traumatic brain injury, and he required staples to the back of their head.

An employee was putting up fascia on a second-story roof when they stepped on unsecured fascia and fell 22 feet to the ground. The employee sustained a broken left arm and bruises to their face and chest.
An employee tripped over a curb at a work site. The employee suffered fractures to their lower back and shoulder.
An employee was drilling a ground terminal lug when the drill hit the mainline. An arc flash occurred and the employee sustained burns to their left arm and hand requiring hospitalization.

An employee was finishing concrete with a strike-off when his foot slipped between rebar and concrete filled up his rubber concrete boot. The employee suffered chemical burns on his right calf and foot.
An employee stepped onto a scaffold made of two ladders and a wooden board. The scaffolding collapsed and the employee fell head first to the ground 8 feet below, suffering a head injury.
An employee was hanging a conduit rack using a powder-actuated tool (PAT) when the tool injured their left eye.

An employee was replacing a slip sleeve under an electrical meter. He was dislodging old conduit when his demolition screwdriver got stuck in the cut. When he freed the screwdriver, it snapped out of his hands and its head struck his left eye, breaking through his safety glasses. He suffered optical nerve damage that caused him to lose all function in the eye. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was installing humidifiers to HVAC ductwork. The employee opened a breaker/switchgear panel and contacted live electrical components. The employee sustained a 480-volt electrical shock to their right arm, resulting in hospitalization.
An employee was giving a hand signal to an excavator operator. The excavator's bucket jumped horizontally and struck the employee's foot, causing multiple fractures.
An employee was helping move a metal pipe for drilling. As the pipe was moved, it struck the employee in the right thigh, injuring it.

Three employees were disposing of wood debris by lifting it over the parapet wall panel of a sidewalk shed, pushing it out beyond the panel, and dropping it to the ground level. The debris caused the parapet wall panel to separate from its structural supports. The debris then fell, causing one of the employees to fall along with it. The employee suffered injuries to the hips and legs.

An employee was working on stilts to install insulation when they tripped and fell to the floor. The employee suffered fractures to their right radius and septum, as well as a compound fracture of the left ulna.
An employee was removing plastic sheeting from an attic. The employee fell from the attic opening while descending the ladder to the ground and suffered a concussion with memory loss.
An employee was standing on a ladder, masking off a window for painting. The ladder slipped and the employee fell into the window, resulting in lacerations to his hand and leg.

An employee was working on the sidewalk and roadway applying paint strips on the ground with thermoplastic striping paint, which was heated during application. The employee had dug a small hole to bury excess paint, and his foot went into the hole. He was hospitalized with second-degree burns to his right foot and lower right leg.

An employee was on the fixed ladder of a wind turbine to clean it when one of the metal work platforms detached from the ladder and struck their left hand as it fell. The employee sustained a severe laceration.
An employee was crushing concrete with a bucket attachment when they were struck by a projectile while in the operator's cab. The employee was hospitalized.

On September 3, 2024, at 2:00 a.m., an employee was helping to move two metal beams with a forklift when the beams moved in an upward position and the strap slid, crushing the injured employee's left little finger between the beams. The employee sustained an amputation of one quarter inch of their finger.

An employee was cleaning a manhole cement cone that was suspended when the cone slipped off the cables and fell on their right hand. The employee sustained lacerations to their right middle and ring fingers and a partial amputation to the middle finger.

An employee was showing a skid steer operator the location of the hydraulic lock button when it was engaged and the controls were activated, resulting in the employee becoming caught in the curled pallet forks of the skid steer. The employee sustained fractures to his leg and hip.
An employee was using a demolition saw with a 14" diamond blade to demolish concrete. The blade kicked back and struck him in the shoulder/chest. The employee sustained shoulder lacerations.

An employee was operating a pocket cutter machine that creates a pocket on the underside of wooden material for future screw installation. The employee operated the machine by foot control and the machine's clamping device (designed to apply pressure on top of the wood to hold in place), contacted the employee's right index fingertip resulting in amputation. The machine was guarded at the time.
An employee was changing the brake pads on a truck that was on a jack when the truck slipped from the jack and fell on him. The employee sustained a crushed torso.

An employee was filling an excavator bucket with water. When the bucket activated to dump the water, the bucket crushed the employee's right leg. The employee sustained a fractured leg that required surgery.
An employee was descending a fixed roof-access ladder when they missed a step and fell 12 feet to the concrete floor below. The employee sustained a fractured femur.

An employee was screwing a metal stud into a track on the ground when they were struck by the basket of a descending aerial lift, knocking and pinning them to the ground. The employee sustained muscle/tendon damage to their knees and back.
An employee was throwing a trash box out of the window when they fell out of the window two stories to the ground below and fractured their ribs and tailbone.

An employee was installing piping in a trench that was 6-7 feet deep when the trench collapsed and soil pinned them up to their waist. The employee sustained a bruised bladder and fractures to their pelvis and sacrum.

An employee was standing on the edge of a 12' benched trench when the side collapsed and he fell into the trench. His legs were buried and he sustained a fractured pelvis and fractures to his left femur, tibia, and fibula.
An operator placed HDPE utility pipes on 4x4 logs. An employee used his foot to stop a pipe from rolling and a pipe rolled onto his leg, resulting in a fractured knee cap that required surgery.

On September 5, 2024, an employee became pale, shaky, and confused after a work day consisting of pouring concrete for a business driveway. The employee was hospitalized for dehydration and an acute kidney injury.
An employee was standing on a ladder. The rigging broke on a load of trusses that was being lifted. The trusses fell onto the employee, resulting in an injury to their back and ribs.
An employee was standing on a beam when he fell approximately 11 feet, fracturing his hip.

An employee was evaluating a packaged HVAC unit. During testing of a damper actuator, he accessing the electrical heating coil. He sustained an electrical shock and third-degree burns to their hands and left upper and lower extremities, as well as a head laceration.
An employee was standing on a truck-mounted tool box to roll back a tarp from the top of the trailer when they fell off the side of the truck to the pavement and sustained a fractured femur.
An employee was struck by a skid steer that was backing up, knocking them over. The track of the skid steer went over his lower half, resulting in a fractured pelvis.
An employee was installing awnings on a building when he fell off his multi-position ladder to the ground, resulting in hospitalization for a punctured lung and facial injuries.
An employee fell off a ladder onto a capped rebar, which perforated the employee's upper torso.

On September 7, 2024, an employee was helping to load a mill head attachment onto a tilt trailer. The mill head rolled out of the front bucket of the skid-steer and pinned the employee's right leg against the edge of the trailer ramp. The employee sustained a fracture and laceration to his fibula.
An employee fell while stacking boxes of windows. The employee landed on the ground about 30 feet below and suffered two broken legs.

A traffic control crew was picking up road barrier barrels and loading them onto a trailer. A box truck rear-ended a police car, struck the traffic control trailer, and struck two traffic control employees. One of the employees was hospitalized with a severe laceration to their liver and fractures to their right tibia and fibula, as well as their left arm.

An employee was working from a bucket truck, installing fiber on a cable line. The employee contacted an energized power line and suffered shock and burn injuries to the left shoulder, back, stomach, left side, and elbows.

An employee was repairing a gutter system on a residential construction. He slipped while descending the ladder from the roof and fell approximately 8 feet to the ground. The employee sustained a head contusion requiring stitches and broken ribs.

An employee was installing a beam on a balcony when he stepped on an unsupported 2x4 and fell four stories to the ground below, fracturing his back. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.

Two employees were holding the wire of the swing to adjust its position while the swing was also being used by employees of another company. That resulted in sudden pressure on the wire, which pulled the clamp down, pinning one employee's right hand and another employee's lower left side under the clamp. One employee was hospitalized.

An employee was unloading material to back fill the 36-inch sewer main when concrete debris caused the rear door on the dump trailer to get wedged open. The employee lifted the door to free the concrete debris. Once the debris was free it suddenly closed, causing the employee's right ring finger to get pinched between the door and the body of the truck. The employee sustained a laceration and fractured finger on the right hand.
An employee was installing floor joists and fell 9 feet from a ladder to the foundation, resulting in a broken hip.

A crew was installing 48" x 6" concrete storm drainpipe. The pipe was lowered into the trench and placed against the other pipe so that a track excavator front head arm can connect the two pipes. The injured employee was inside the pipe standing in front of the excavator head arm when the arm lifted and struck the employee on the side of their body causing a contusion with a rib fracture.
An employee was cutting a board using an electric disc saw. The saw slipped and lacerated their hand between the thumb and index finger. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was on a scissor lift installing sprinkler pipes. The employee was trying to get a better angle to install a pipe, left the lift basket, and fell approximately 20 feet to the ground. The employee was hospitalized for a broken left heel, right knee and right ankle.
An employee was turning off a valve on the distributor of a tanker. The hose blew off and hot oil splashed on the employee, resulting in burns to their face and left arm.
An employee was installing an air handler when they experienced heat exhaustion.
An estimator was taking pictures on a roof when they fell from the two-story building. The employee sustained fractures to their shoulder, right hip, left foot, and three ribs.

On September 11, 2024, an employee was unloading electric utility meters and closing the car door when her left middle finger became caught between the door and the car frame, resulting in an amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was placing plastic over wet concrete when they tripped and their left wrist was lacerated by metal trim.
An employee was cutting and removing old insulation from a re-roofing job when he disconnected from his anchor point and fell to the sub-flooring below. His pelvic bone was fractured.

On September 12, 2024, an employee was standing halfway up an 8-foot ladder while installing a 14-inch spiral duct through a wall. While being pulled from the wall, the duct gave way and knocked into the ladder, causing the employee to fall to the floor and be impacted by a hammer located in his toolbelt. The employee suffered bleeding in his left kidney, two broken ribs, and a laceration to his left temple.
An employee was unloading a section of a utility pole from the back of a truck when the section of pole fell on the employee's right ankle/lower leg, fracturing it.
An employee was nailing the flags to the ground for a new construction. A front loader struck the employee and fractured their right foot.

An employee was using a circular saw to cut wooden stakes. When he finished, the blade was still turning and as he laid the saw down, he sustained a laceration to his right thigh approximately ten inches above the knee.

An employee was planning a cable pull operation where the cables would be pulled one at time from a four conductor bundle. The employee was operating the capstan to pull the feeder cable when the drop-in anchor failed, causing the cable sheave to strike the employee in the left arm and torso. The employee sustained a laceration to their left bicep/forearm and fractured ribs on their left side.
A crew was demolishing existing concrete. A forklift lifted a piece of concrete and it slipped off the lift, hitting an employee in the leg and fracturing it.

An employee was walking under an outrigger as an 8-foot aluminum beam was being lifted when the beam fell and struck the employee in the head. The employee sustained blunt force trauma to the a head and a laceration. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was measuring a wire mesh sheet behind a mini excavator when the excavator reversed and ran over the employee's leg, resulting in a leg fracture that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was clearing a jam on a saw when the saw was turned on, resulting in an amputation of the tip of their thumb.
An employee was re-installing fencing and guards around a wellhead when a rattlesnake bit his right hand near the knuckle of his ring finger.

An employee was walking in the shop when they tripped over a pallet that was next to a brake shear. As the employee went to catch himself, a steel plate weighing approximately 75 pounds dislodged and fell onto his foot and fractured three toes.

A highway construction employee began to feel ill while laying down new lane dividing tabs on a newly paved highway. The employee was hospitalized for heat illness including low sodium levels leading to fatigue, numbness, nausea and confusion.

Two employees on a scissor lift were doing electrical work outside the building. The lift moved from a concrete surface to a gravel surface, lost balance, and tipped. The employees fell from the lift to the gravel. One employee was hospitalized due to a fractured skull, swelling of the brain, and loss of consciousness. The second employee sustained minor injuries and was not hospitalized.
An employee was climbing a baker scaffold to perform drywall work when they slipped and fell five feet onto a carpeted floor below. The employee sustained two broken ribs.
An employee was painting on a first-floor balcony when he fell 8 feet to the ground, resulting in a broken collar bone that required hospitalization.

An employee was working from the second floor while pulling siding off a wall. The employee fell over the safety rail in a window, struck an aerial lift, and then fell to the ground, resulting in shoulder and lower back injuries.

An employee was on a 24-foot extension ladder measuring metal paneling on a residential property with a measuring tape. The employee slipped and fell approximately 10-12 feet to the ground below. The employee landed on some vegetation and sustained C1-C3 fractures.

An employee was removing a line on a rooftop air conditioning unit. The employee applied heat to the line with a brazing tool to separate it. Residual oil ignited and sprayed out of the unit, causing second-degree burns to the employee's hands and abdomen.

An employee was utilizing an 8-foot fiberglass step ladder to run electrical wires through piping in a second-floor hallway and fell approximately 5 feet to the floor below. The employee sustained injuries to the face, wrist, and ribs, and was hospitalized.

On September 14, 2024, at 7:00 PM, employees were removing multi-purpose metal bars from an I-beam support of the new bridge deck. When the injured employee was lifting a bar, the bar slipped from his hands. He was catching the bar and his left ring and little fingers became caught between the knot of that bar and the I-beam support. He was hospitalized for surgery and medical amputation of his ring fingertip.
An employee fell approximately six feet from a portable ladder to the ground and fractured their left heel. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting a piece of wood with a saw when he cut off a portion of his thumb. He was hospitalized and it was reattached.

An employee was struck by a steel road plate (5' x 12') when he was behind the steel plate and the bank wall to get the geotextile. The employee was hospitalized for head and neck trauma, including bilateral temporal bone fractures and other head fractures.

An employee was on an extension ladder completing pest control measures on the gutter of a home. The employee fell 32 feet from the ladder to the ground and sustained a fractured wrist, a dislocated shoulder, and a chest injury. The employee was hospitalized.

On September 16, 2024, an employee was cutting metal tubing with a battery-operated bandsaw. The bandsaw jumped out from the tubing and contacted his left index finger, resulting in a laceration to the tendon.

An employee was installing a roof on a steel building when they tripped and fell 46 feet off the roof to the ground floor. The employee sustained broken legs and internal injuries. The employee was not tied off at the time.

After unhooking a load, an employee backed away and signaled the tower crane to cable up. The rigging got caught on a metal I-beam. When it broke free, the rigging hook swung back and struck the employee on the forehead. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was working outdoors on a highway construction project when he began feeling hot, nauseated, and had leg cramps due to excessive heat. The employee was hospitalized for heat illness.

Employees were assembling trench shoring boxes above the ground. A large steel pin that was being installed dropped on the employee's hand, crushing it between another piece of steel. Their little finger was amputated and the ring finger was also injured.

An employee was working on a roof. They attempted to grab a piece of plywood when they slipped on the wood and fell approximately 18 feet to the ground, resulting in a broken right forearm and fractured left hand.

An employee was climbing the ladder to access the roof when he lost his footing and fell approximately 12 feet to the ground. The employee sustained a concussion, fractured ribs, and a fractured wrist.

Two employees were detaching a boom from a high-track skid steer in order to place a gas line. The injured employee was positioned between the skid steer and the boom attachment while removing the hydraulic hoses. The other employee inadvertently caused the skid steer to track forward onto the injured employee's lower leg and foot, resulting in a fractured left tibia.

An employee was helping line up concrete panels while a team member used an impact wrench to fasten flange screws to keep the panels together. The employee's left thumb was caught in the formwork and flange screw, resulting in a thumb tip amputation.

A journeyman on ground level was removing conduit from energized gear. When he lifted the conduit, it came in contact with a live bus that caused an arc blast. The journeyman sustained burns while an apprentice on the basement level who was pushing the conduit up received an electrical shock. Both employees were hospitalized.

On September 18, 2024, at approximately at 3:30 PM, a plumber was installing new water lines by the attic in a new residential house. The employee was standing on a 6-foot A-frame ladder at a height of about 4 feet. He supported his arms on the wooden structure of the house, specifically on a 2-inch by 6-inch board. The board fell and hit the ladder, and the employee fell with the ladder onto the concrete floor, sustaining injuries to his back and arm. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was climbing down a hydro scaffolding tower to retrieve batteries when he fell approximately 10 feet onto the A-frame outrigger of the scaffold, resulting in three fractured vertebrae.

An employee was hanging drywall using a scissor lift with the drywall board being hoisted up to the lift rail guards while on the ledger. The drywall board began tilting and pivoted toward the employee, striking him in the forehead and the bridge of his nose, knocking him to the floor. The employee suffered a scrape/cut on the forehead and pain in his shoulders and lower back. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning the ground when he was struck on the head by an unsecured vertical scaffold pole, resulting in head injuries that required hospitalization.
A framer/drywaller was hammering on a piece of steel framing on the ground level when he felt something strike his left eye. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.
On September 19, 2024, at approximately 3:00 p.m., an employee was finishing concrete when he began experiencing cramping due to heat exhaustion. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was installing conduit in a factory from an A-frame ladder when they fell and struck their head on the floor, resulting in a skull fracture.

An employee was leaving to go on a lunch break. He was going down a ladder while carrying a case of water. He slipped and fell 15 feet down to the slab below and sustained a fractured right foot/ankle.

An employee was picking up a forklift charger with his left hand and dropped it onto his right hand, pinching his right index finger between the charger and the forklift frame. One quarter inch of the finger was amputated.

An employee was cleaning coal build-up inside pulverizers that were 10 feet 3 inches wide and contained three stationary rollers. After dislodging a piece of coal, the employee exited the pulverizers when the converging floor moved and their left leg was caught between one of the three rollers. The employee suffered injuries including a laceration to the lower left thigh and multiple fractures to the lower left leg. The motor to the converging floor was not in place at the time of the incident.

Two employees were loading a trailer after completing a job. The injured employee then folded up the ramps of their trailer. While folding up the second ramp, the metal handle broke off, causing the employee's hand to slip. His right forearm was cut on the broken handle, resulting in stitches.
A subcontracted employee was cutting a piece of wood with a circular saw when the saw contacted his right leg above the knee, resulting in a cut. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was on a roof carrying sheets of plywood to another part of the roof when he tripped and fell through a skylight to the concrete below. The employee sustained injuries to their head, face, wrist, and hands.
An employee was standing on the third step of an A-frame ladder while running pipe and low-voltage wire. He fell from the ladder to the concrete floor, resulting in an acetabular fracture.
An employee was walking at a worksite and they were struck in the head by a shipping container that shifted off the forks of a telehandler. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was holding a leaking hydraulic line on an aerial lift when hydraulic fluid was injected into their left ring finger. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.

An employee was greasing a pipe at the bottom of the hill to prepare it to be placed inside another PVC pipe. An excavator was working at the top of the hill about 10 feet away from a pile of 30-inch PVC pipes placed behind a berm. The vibration caused the pipes to dislodge from the berm and a pipe rolled down the 8-10-foot slope. The employee's right leg was caught between the fixed pipe he was working on and the pipe that rolled down the slope and fractured.
An employee was working on a roof while using fall protection. The employee slipped and fell to the ground, and he was hospitalized with a fractured leg.

The injured employee was making adjustments to a previously driven steel pile. He had his hand above the pile driving machine when the operator leaned forward and bumped the controller, causing the hammer to come down on the injured employee's right hand. The employee sustained a laceration to the middle finger and a fracture to the index finger.
An employee was repairing second-floor trusses when they fell through the floor, resulting in a head injury.

An employee was working outdoors with supplied oxygen due to the potential for hazardous gasses in the environment. The employee was light-headed and became ill; they were hospitalized for heat exhaustion, dehydration, and a muscle injury.
An employee was in a boom lift installing lightning protection. Electricity jumped from nearby transmission lines to the boom lift and shocked the employee. The employee sustained burns.
An employee was working on a decked roof approximately 25-30 feet high. The employee stepped on one of the deck pieces and fell through to the ground, resulting in a broken arm.

An employee (employee 1) working on a commercial roof project entered a dumpster on site to move and secure some debris. Another employee (employee 2) threw debris from the roof down into the dumpster, and the debris struck employee 1's hand. Employee 1 was hospitalized for multiple fractures to their hand.
An employee was cutting a piece of 2 x 6 lumber with a saw when the saw slipped and cut his leg and knee.

An employee attempted to open an engine compartment door on a drill rig to start the master cylinder before transporting the rig via a lowboy trailer. In order to access the compartment door he had to stand on the bottom track. As he pulled the latch, he lost his balance and stepped backward. His right hand fingers were caught in the handle, resulting in fractures of his index and ring fingers and a partial amputation of the middle fingertip.

An employee was operating a street sweeper following the paving crew in an active work zone. The street sweeper was struck from behind by an empty logging truck and the employee was thrown from the sweeper into the wood line. The employee was hospitalized for a skull fracture, two small brain bleeds, a laceration requiring 18 staples, an open fracture of his clavicle, a dislocated shoulder, and multiple scrapes and bruises.
An employee was installing a corrugated deck plate when they tripped on the deck plate and fell forward onto the plate, resulting in a fracture to their lower left leg.
An employee was struck by a wooden truss that fell from a material handler. The employee was hospitalized with a severe head injury and required surgery.
An employee was assembling and linking ductwork with insulation using a coil line. While attempting to clear a jam, the employee's leg was caught by the coil line, resulting in bruising.

Employees were at a roadside while re-organizing pieces of equipment on a trailer in preparation for highway travel. The boom of a telescopic crane was performing an outward telescoping motion, causing an employee's fingers to get caught between a sling and a shackle. The employee sustained degloving injuries to multiple fingers on their right hand. They also sustained amputation of the little finger and partial amputations to the middle and ring fingers.
An employee was descending a ladder and fell three feet to the concrete floor, resulting in a broken ankle.
An employee fell 12 feet from a roof to the ground and sustained a lumbar fracture.
An employee was ascending a ladder when their foot slipped, causing them to fall to the ground below and sustain a lower back injury. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was replacing metal decking on a roof when they fell 16 feet through a section of the roof to the floor. The employee sustained a head injury, a broken vertebra, and a broken foot.

On September 25, 2024, an employee climbed a ladder to replace filters at a grocery store. The ladder moved and the employee grabbed ahold of a light fixture and tried to stabilize the ladder. The employee lost their grip on the light fixture and fell approximately 40 feet to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to their left arm, pelvis, left femur, and right tibia.

An employee was loading HVAC components onto the back of a flatbed truck using a forklift. The employee got onto the flatbed to adjust/position the pallet to make room for a second pallet. The materials on top of the pallet shifted and moved toward the employee. The employee then jumped off the flatbed to the pavement four feet below, resulting in a fractured left tibia.

An employee was performing roofing work such as installing shingles. He fell from the second-story section of a town home and landed on the ground sustaining a compression fracture in his back. The employee was wearing fall protection at the time of the fall.

An employee was rolling a garbage container full of concrete through a hallway when their right hand was caught between the container and the floor. The employee's index, middle, and ring fingertips were partially amputated.

Two employees were setting angle iron pieces against a rubber gasket on a concrete noise wall. The iron angle became stuck while the injured employee was pushing on the gasket. The second employee was lowering the iron while the injured employee was pushing on the gasket when the iron dropped two inches onto the concrete knee wall, crushing the injured employee's middle finger between the angle iron and the wall. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee was pulling a cable from a conduit. The cable was also used as a guide to place a new cable. The cable broke and caused the employee to step back and fall. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to their tibia and fibula.

An employee was lowering a boom on a vertical mast light tower. While operating the winch with his left hand, his right index finger was crushed by a falling part of the light tower, resulting in amputation between the first joint and knuckle.

An employee was on a roof repairing a skylight when they fell through the skylight to the concrete floor. The employee sustained fractures to both legs, both elbows, a shoulder, a cheekbone, and their nose.

An employee was guiding a temporary roof onto a scaffolding structure when their thumb became caught between a panel of the temporary roof and a scaffold component. The employee sustained an open displaced fracture of the distal phalanx of their left thumb, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was climbing a 30-foot high scaffold system when the pin holding the guardrail broke. The employee fell with the scaffold to the ground. He sustained multiple broken bones to his legs, arms, and pelvis.

A pump truck operator was emptying concrete from the hose on a pump truck when air got into the line. This caused the hose to whip and strike the employee's right torso. The employee was hospitalized for 3-11 broken ribs, punctured lungs, and a brain bleed.

Employees were installing an intermediate driveshaft in the driveline of a dump truck. One employee went under the truck to visually observe the yoke and their left thumb was crushed/lacerated in a pinch point between the universal joint cap and the yoke.
An employee was on a 6-foot ladder while picking up outside lights in the ceiling piping. The employee was found on the ground with the ladder knocked over, and the employee's skull was fractured.

On September 30, 2024, at 5:00 PM, an employee was hospitalized for difficulty breathing after they were exposed to hydrochloric (HCl) acid after a vessel 60 yards away from where they were working released HCl gas.
An employee was descending an 8-foot ladder. When he was on the fourth rung, the ladder fell down and the employee fell on top of it, resulting in a broken arm.

An employee was cleaning up the jobsite, including an onsite mixing machine. The employee removed an access cover to the auger and the auger grabbed his gloved left hand, amputating the tips of his left index and ring fingers and his little finger at the third knuckle. The mixing machine was in operation at the time.
An employee was standing near a digger derrick when they were struck by a slackened lifting cable, resulting in a fractured vertebra, a laceration to the back of the head, and a concussion.
An employee was using a circular saw to cut a piece of batten. The saw jammed and kicked back, striking his left thumb and fully amputating it.

After making a repair to sprinkler piping, an employee was being lowered to the ground via a forklift. They fell approximately 15 feet, struck the mast of the forklift and a cotton bale, and then fell to the warehouse floor. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to their face, left wrist, and left femur.

Employees were working to unload a power line pole from a pole trailer and place it on the pole rack on the digger derrick truck. The injured employee hooked up pole tongs that were attached to the boom rope of the digger derrick to one of the poles on the trailer. As the digger derrick picked up the pole, it slipped out of the tongs and landed on the leg/ankle of the injured employee resulting in a broken left leg and ankle.
An employee was conducting demolition and restoration work due to a hurricane when he began feeling ill. The employee was hospitalized due to heat stress.

Three employees were moving a piece of sheet metal approximately 20 feet to the top of the roof. When they got to the top of the roof, the injured employee stepped on the sheet metal causing them to slide across the sheet metal approximately 25 feet to the edge of the roof and fall 16 feet to the ground, landing in a standing position. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was drilling a hole in the electrical panel at a residential home when the drill bit struck wires and an arc flash occurred. The employee sustained burns on his left hand.
An employee was testing voltage when an arc flash occurred. The employee sustained burns to their face.

An employee was on a catwalk to assist with the installation of electrical equipment when the grating shifted and he fell about 11 feet to the ground. The employee sustained fractures to his hip, pelvis, and ribs.
An employee was installing solar panels on a residential rooftop when they became ill and experienced stomach cramps. The employee was hospitalized with heat exhaustion.

The injured employee was part of a three-person crew that was dispatched to a commercial building to install weatherproofing material on the roof. The crew had just arrived, and the employee climbed a ladder to the roof of the building. While positioning equipment (pulling up a hose), the employee fell 27 feet to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured wrist and jaw.

An employee was accessing the motor of a rooftop HVAC unit when a gust of wind caused the HVAC access door to close on their left hand. The employee sustained an amputation of their ring finger through the phalanx.

An employee was using a torch to dismantle a boiler in the basement when the torch slipped out of his hand and swung in the opposite direction, catching his shirt on fire. The employee sustained a burn to his right arm and the right side of his stomach.

An employee was adjusting a rebar cage (20 feet) that was being moved using the forks of a loader. The rebar cage rolled over his glove and pulled his right ring fingertip between two pieces of rebar. The employee sustained a partial amputation to the finger.
An employee was cutting a band on a bundle of steel tubing when a piece of steel rolled off the stack and fell onto his left foot, fracturing metatarsal bones in his foot.
An employee was using a pressure washer to clean manholes to be resealed when their left hand got in the path of the pressure washer and was lacerated by the pressurized water.

An employee was operating a chainsaw when the blade kicked back and struck another employee. The injured employee was hospitalized with lacerations to the right side of their face, shoulder, and chest areas.

Two subcontractor employees were installing a coil door. The door slid forward as they were bolting it in and knocked the injured employee off a ladder. The employee fell to the ground and sustained a fractured left arm.

An employee was rigging a steel beam and noticed it was unlevel as it was raised. As it was lowered to be adjusted, it struck another beam and caused it to fall on the employee's left leg. The employee sustained an open fracture of the left distal tibia.
An employee was descending a 10-foot platform ladder when he mis-stepped on the fourth rung. His landed on his right heel, breaking it.
On October 7, 2024, an employee was using a ladder to perform residential painting when the ladder contacted an overhead power line and the employee was shocked. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was clearing tree debris off a sheet metal roof when they fell through a roof panel approximately 15-20 feet to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured wrist and lacerations, and they required surgery.

An employee was putting up rebar to build a utility tower when his left index finger was caught in the rebar as he was putting it in place. The employee was hospitalized with a crushed left index fingertip.

An employee was holding a piece of sheet metal while standing on the second rung from the bottom of a ladder. A gust of wind caused the employee to fall from the ladder to the ground, striking his head. The employee sustained a head injury, lost consciousness, and was hospitalized.

The injured employee was spotting for a forklift driver as they were placing a power pack onto a piece of equipment. The employee's left middle fingertip was crushed between the forklift mast and a brace for the equipment, resulting in an amputation to the finger.

An employee was on an 8-foot ladder drilling a hole into a concrete wall for an anchor. The employee fell and struck his head on a nearby table. The employee was hospitalized with a skull fracture, dislocated shoulder, and a laceration that required staples/stitches.

An employee was laying decking when he lost his balance and fell from the first level of steel to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured orbital bone, facial fractures, a brain bleed, and a dislocated shoulder.
An employee was drilling a screw into wood. A metal particle entered the employee's eye, injuring it.

On October 8, 2024, an employee was cutting foam insulation along the edge of a flat roof when he slipped and fell approximately 16-20 feet to the grassy ground. The employee sustained a broken wrist and ribs.

On October 8, 2024, an employee was performing roofing activities when he fell backward from above one story, struck a roll former extension, and then hit the asphalt pavement. The employee was hospitalized with multiple skull fractures.

An employee was assisting with the setup of a crane and pulling off the float. The crane moved forward. The front step of the crane caught the employee's right leg against a bundle of rebar that was on the ground, resulting in a fractured tibia.
An employee fell from the top of a water truck to the ground, resulting in fractures to his collarbone, ribs, and vertebrae.

Two employees were harnessed to a decommissioned tower when the tower fell. One employee sustained fractured bones and the other employee sustained fractured bones, bruises/contusions/abrasions, and they lost consciousness.

At 9:44 p.m. on October 9, 2024, an employee was helping rig and move a bundle containing about 30 pieces of 48-foot, 6-inch rebar. The employee was caught between the moving rebar bundle and a landed stationary rebar bundle, suffering a liver laceration and a non-displaced fracture of the tenth rib.

An employee was adding an anti-slip foaming agent to a paving transfer machine when the container of foaming agent fell into the machine's hopper. When the employee went to remove the container, his right arm was caught in the machine's rotating blades, resulting in amputation of the arm.

An employee was using a mini-loader with a bucket to lift a piece of equipment and change a blade on it. The mini-loader fell to the ground from about 3 inches. The blade amputated four of the employee's fingers.
An employee fell while setting up a drop wire, landing on the ground and suffering a broken leg.

An employee was installing asphalt roofing when the wooden beam they were tied to gave way. They fell 10 feet to the ground and landed on their bottom. The employee sustained fractures to their lower back.

An electrician was working from a 10-foot ladder, reaching up to place an I-beam and conduit. He fell backward from the ladder, landing 8 feet below on the concrete floor and suffering a closed displaced transverse fracture of the shaft of his left radius.

On October 10, 2024, an employee was using a nine-tire roller machine to roll out dirt with wet/powdered concrete. The machine started sliding on an incline. When the employee reversed, the back tires spun and the machine slid off a 1- to 1.5-foot dirt edge. The employee suffered injuries to the left wrist and hip and was hospitalized.
A flagger was run over by a vehicle that had driven past three barricades at a construction site. The flagger suffered a concussion and fractures to their foot and leg.

On October 11, 2024, at 12:24 p.m., an employee was refueling a gasoline generator on a work truck when it ignited. The employee suffered burns to their arms, hands, neck, and face and were hospitalized.

An employee was conducting an inspection of the roof area for potential plumbing issues. The employee fell through rubber roofing and down a duct chase, landing on the ground approximately 17 feet below. The employee sustained multiple fractures including a fractured pelvis and was hospitalized.
An employee grabbed an A-frame cart and it collapsed on him, pinning him to a duct lift. The employee was hospitalized with fractured ribs.

An employee was in an electrical bucket truck performing maintenance work. The employee's left hand contacted a 72,000-volt overhead power line. The employee sustained an amputation to the left arm as a result of the electrical shock and injuries to the abdomen.

An electrical crew was in the final stages of a hurricane restoration project. One of the employees was removing the protective coverup equipment when he noticed potential movement in a connection or energized cable. When he tightened the connection with a hand tool, a phase-to-ground arc flash burned his face. He was hospitalized.

On October 14, 2024, an employee was descending the stairs from a 35-foot cement hopper platform. The employee missed a step and fell about 6-10 feet to the ground, suffering fractures to the left arm/wrist, left femur, and pelvis on the right side. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was carrying a spool of cable. The spool fell onto the employee's foot and broke it.
An employee was stepping down from a paver when their left foot slipped on granular material. The employee fell and suffered a broken left hip resulting in hospitalization.

An underground crew was opening up a manhole for a visual inspection. Natural gas was leaking in the manhole. As they began to slide the cover off, a flash occurred when the leaking natural gas mixed with oxygen, creating a combustible environment. One employee was hospitalized.
An employee was replacing commercial lighting on a ceiling from a scissor lift about 8-9 feet from the floor. He was shocked and fell from the scissor lift to the floor, suffering a broken leg.
An employee was working at a dock. A lock-out board came loose and hit the employee, breaking the employee's lower leg.

An employee was working from a mobile scaffold while touching up a ceiling when one of the wheels fell into a hole in the floor, causing it to tip over. The employee fell from the scaffold to the floor below. The employee hit the back of his head on the floor, resulting in head injuries.

An employee was replacing the auger inside an open mixer. When the auger was set inside the outer shaft, it moved back into place, dropping down approximately 2 to 4 inches. The employee was still holding onto the auger, and his left little finger was crushed.

An employee was receiving red boards for shoring in a trench. As a board was being handed down, it slipped and pinched the employee's left ring finger between the board and the shoring, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was unloading foundation forms from a metal rack. The stack of forms became unstable and fell onto the employee's left leg, breaking the ankle.

On October 16, 2024, at approximately 10:00 a.m., a welder bent over to pick up a pair of gloves when a propane heater ignited the employee's clothing, causing third-degree burns to the back of the employee's right leg and knee.
An employee was removing a grinder blade when the trigger engaged and they suffered severe lacerations to their ring and middle fingers.

An employee was performing housekeeping tasks when they were struck on the right shoulder by a mini excavator bucket, causing the employee to fall forward and strike the asphalt in front of him. The employed sustained a frontal lobe brain bleed, fractures to their right shoulder, orbital bone, and nose, as well as a forehead laceration.

On October 16, 2024, at approximately 11:00 a.m., an employee was working in a 6-foot-deep trench and cleaning an electrical conduit line with a shovel. As the employee was removing material from above the pipe, the west side of the trench collapsed and struck the employee in the lower back and torso, pinning him in the ditch. The employee was hospitalized with 12 fractured ribs and 4 fractured vertebrae in his lower back.
While installing a roof system, an employee stepped through a fiberglass skylight panel and fell to the floor about 18-20 feet below. The employee sustained a fractured skull.
An employee was evacuating propane from a cylinder when an explosion occurred. The employee sustained second-degree burns to the face and neck.

On October 17, 2024, at approximately 10:15 AM, an employee was riding in the manlift attachment of a forklift when the attachment fell off the forklift, causing the employee to fall approximately 4 feet to the concrete ground. The employee was hospitalized with a broken right arm and an injury to a neck vertebra, and they received stitches on their forehead.

An employee was picking up cones from the rear basket of a cone truck when an impact attenuator truck collided with the cone truck and caused the basket to bend inward. The employee was crushed and sustained a fractured pelvis.

An employee was moving from a residential roof onto a scaffold. The employee fell through the scaffolding to a rock ledge about 10 feet below, suffering an injury to the back of the head that required staples. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was moving a cable reel trailer when it broke loose and struck them in the right shoulder, resulting in a fracture.

An employee was driving a boom lift when he encountered a 10-inch elevation change, and his face and left arm struck the guardrail system of the boom lift basket. He was hospitalized with a fractured left arm, a hairline jaw fracture on the left side, and a laceration under his chin.

An employee was hanging a cable lasher on fiber lines while in an elevated bucket truck. The crew moved to the next setup and the employee was ejected out of the bucket, falling to the ground approximately 15 feet below. The employee suffered a broken right foot and ankle, a bruised stomach, and a fractured jaw.
An employee was climbing a ladder when they fell to the ground and sustained a broken arm.
A boom lift fell, and its boom pinched an employee's left middle finger against a post. The employee suffered an amputation to the finger.

On October 18, 2024, an employee was on a flat commercial roof, preparing the roof for the application of sealer. He was using a chalk line to mark a six-foot boundary from the roof edge. He fell approximately 40 feet from the roof edge to the ground, sustaining head trauma, a punctured lung, and a fractured wrist.

An employee was cleaning a downspout at the ground level of the building when a car ran over the sidewalk and struck the employee, pinning them between the vehicle and the building. The employee sustained multiple pelvic fractures and an internal injury. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was plugging in an extension cord for a tool and sustained an electric shock. They then fell from a standing position. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was installing a 3-inch PVC pipe onto a T-post in the ground to set up overhead powerline flagging. A metal wire contacted the overhead powerline and an arc flash occurred, resulting in burns to both of the employee's hands and feet and the right side of their chest.
An employee was using a pipe cart to move conduit. The uprights on the cart shifted and struck him in the throat, fracturing his larynx. He was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee was 20-25 feet above the ground while in a box on a telehandler to secure a gutter installation to the side of a residential dwelling. The box shifted and fell while the employee was inside of it. The employee struck the ground and suffered a fractured left hip and left knee.

An employee was working on a roof when they stepped on a piece of plywood decking and fell 14 feet to the concrete ground. They were hospitalized with a fractured back. The employee was not wearing fall protection at the time.

On October 19, 2024, an employee on an ariel lift was unbolting angle iron from a bridge section being set with a crane. The bridge section moved and the employee's right hand was crushed between the steel and the concrete.

An employee was applying waterproofing at the second story of a building. He fell off the building's edge, landing on the ground and suffering an eye injury as well as bruising all over his body. He was hospitalized.

An employee was working at a disaster relief site. They walked behind a truck and their foot became caught between the outrigger of a loader and the ground as the outrigger was being set down. The employee's foot was broken.
An employee was hooking up a trailer hitch when the trailer jack came down and pinched their finger. The employee suffered a partial fingertip amputation.

An employee was removing the V-frame from the tray assembly of a crane during assembly/disassembly. The tray arms then fell over with the employee in the catwalk basket. The employee sustained broken ribs, lacerations, internal bleeding, and kidney and abdominal injuries.
On 10/20/2024, a subcontractor painter fell approximately 8 feet to the ground from a platform. They were hospitalized with a suspected concussion.

An employee was climbing an extension ladder to access a roof. The employee's foot caught in a ladder rung and the employee fell to the ground about 20-25 feet below. The employee suffered a dislocated hip and chipped vertebrae.

An employee was using an excavator (with hydraulic shears mounted on it) to move, shear, and cut old steel trusses. He set a truss on the ground in front of him and began adjusting the position of the excavator. The truss rolled into the cab of the excavator and struck his right leg below the knee. He suffered a broken tibia and fibula as well as a wound to the lower leg.

An employee was using two hammers to remove a metal stud track. The teeth of one hammer was wedged into the track. The second hammer was used to strike the head of the wedged hammer in order to separate the track and stud. A foreign object entered the employee's eye, causing injury.
A co-worker's nail gun fired into an employee's back, resulting in a punctured lung.
An employee was climbing a scaffolding ladder when they fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a broken right ankle and required surgery.

An employee was descending an A-frame ladder. He lost his balance and grabbed an exposed lightweight metal wall stud, which caused a severe laceration to his right middle finger as well as a tendon rupture. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

Two employees were tack welding over a hole in a diesel tank. Diesel in the tank exploded. One employee suffered burns to the face; the other suffered severe burns over 40 percent of the back, shoulder, and arms.
An employee fell off a roof while shingling it. The employee landed on the ground, suffered a broken arm, and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee fell 25 feet off a roof that was being sheathed. The employee suffered a fractured clavicle and femur, as well as head and hip injuries. Fall protection was not being worn at the time.

An employee was handed a water bottle and drank liquid from it thinking the liquid was water. It was later determined that the bottle was filled with acetone. The employee began bleeding from his mouth, became ill, and was hospitalized.
An employee was working on the roof of a one-story house. As he descended a ladder, he fell backward and struck his head on the concrete driveway. The employee sustained head trauma.

Two employees were unloading a steel column from a flatbed tractor trailer. The two-point rigging configuration slipped on the load as it was being hoisted off the trailer. The two rigging points slid on the column and came together, causing one end of the column to strike the injured employee's arm. The employee was knocked down, and he landed on his side on the flatbed trailer. The end of the column then landed on his hip. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured arm and pelvis and required surgery.

An employee was cutting a piece of plywood formwork using a battery powered circular saw. The employee went to reposition the piece of wood and his right index finger contacted the blade resulting in amputation of the finger.
An employee was inspecting a problem on a cable puller machine when his left thumb was entangled by mule tape. The employee was hospitalized and his left thumb was amputated.
An employee was drilling a hole in the ceiling at a job site using a power drill when the drill struck their face and eye area, resulting in a laceration. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was dismantling a scaffold deck when he fell approximately 12 to 14 feet from the upper level to the ground. The employee landed on his feet, which resulted in a fracture to his left leg.
An employee was installing steel piles. A pile snapped out of the connector and struck the employee's arm causing a compound fracture.

On October 23, 2024, at approximately 8:35 AM, an employee was dropping off a transfer switch for a generator install and took a photo for proof of delivery. He took a step back and fell approximately 10 feet through an open hole to the concrete basement floor of a new construction house. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to their vertebrae, ribs, and sternum.
An employee fell from a ladder and sustained a broken right foot.

An employee was installing a piece of prefabricated 4" pipe. While manually tilting the pipe, it shifted in the straps and pinched their fingers between flanges. The employee sustained an amputation of their right index fingertip with an open fracture from a crushing injury.

An employee was standing on a scaffold near the ladder when the scaffold fell. The employee fell approximately 13 feet to the ground, resulting in two broken ankles and a torn ligament in his right ankle.

An employee was helping to unload a delivery of 24-inch pipes from a trailer. The load underneath the pipes shifted, causing one of the 4 x 4 wood bracing boards to pop up and strike the left side of the employee's face. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was in transit to take a picture of a scaffold tag when he was struck by a wood plank that came from an upper level. The employee was hospitalized with a laceration and fractures to their cheek, top palette, and orbital bone.

An employee was grabbing a line for a load (3,000 lbs.) that was being lifted by a crane when their right hand was caught between the load and a slab on the floor. The employee sustained a laceration, a torn tendon, and a fractured right wrist.

A service technician was greasing a skid steer tread when the operator leaned forward to hear his instructions. The skid steer then ran over the service technician's foot, resulting in a fractured ankle.

An employee was walking past an air compressor. The hose on the compressor split in the middle, began swinging, and struck the employee in the right leg, knocking them to the ground. The employee sustained a broken left femur.
An employee was installing roof trusses. A truss shifted, causing the employee to fall approximately 15 feet to the ground. The employee's ribs, wrist, and pelvis were broken.
An employee was being lifted out of a trench using an excavator. The excavator's bucket closed, causing broken bones in his forearm.

To prepare to change the oil for a truck, an employee removed a piece of plywood that was covering the pit used for oil changes. The employee fell into the pit, which was approximately 5 feet deep, resulting in a broken femur.
An employee was on a ladder tightening a bolt when his ladder fell out from under him. He grabbed a C-channel support beam as he slid down and suffered a 6-inch laceration to his left forearm.
An employee was driving a utility task vehicle (UTV) when it struck a load of steel angle iron that was resting on forklift forks, resulting in facial fractures.

An employee was installing a pin to secure an auger attachment to an excavator. As the excavator positioned the Kelly bar, the employee's left hand was caught between the first and second stage of the Kelly bar friction plates (flanges) connected to the auger. The employee sustained fractures to their index finger, middle finger, and thumb.
An employee was aligning a pin on the side bars of a dump truck when their thumb was caught in the pinhole, resulting in the amputation of the thumb tip.

An employee was uninstalling an air conditioning unit. He was working on a ladder to remove ducting and replaced the ceiling tile when he fell backward off the ladder and landed on the floor. The employee sustained a knee fracture.

An employee was installing insulated metal panels when they fell approximately 12 feet from a 28-foot extension ladder. The employee landed on the concrete floor below sustaining head and other bodily trauma.

An employee was removing a jumper from the center phase of a de-energized transmission line. When the jumper was removed, the induction current on the line (induced by nearby energized transmission lines) entered the employee's left hand and exited through his left hip area. The employee was hospitalized with burn wounds to left hand and lower right abdomen, as well as a compression fracture to his T5, T6, and T7 vertebrae.

An employee was adjusting a Kelly bar pin on a drill truck. Their right index finger was caught in a pinch point between the inner and outer Kelly bars, resulting in a severe laceration to the finger. The employee sustained a fingertip amputation.

An employee was loading an aerial lift onto a trailer. The trailer jarred and the employee fell approximately 15 feet from the aerial lift basket to the ground, resulting in fractures to their ribs and neck, a brain bleed, and a punctured lung.

A crew was loading poles in the yard. An employee went to remove a pole that was stuck between two other poles. When he stepped up onto the poles, his right foot was caught in a pinch point. One of the poles rolled onto his right leg, just above his ankle, resulting in a broken right leg.

An employee was in the bucket of a bucket truck connecting ground wires. The employee came into contact with the top side of an energized cut-off, resulting in electrical shock and burns to their left shoulder and left hand.

An employee was picking up two bundles of rebar using a telescoping forklift. As the forklift reversed, it ran over a piece of concrete and became unbalanced. The forklift tipped over to the left side, and the rebar began to fall toward the middle of the cab, where the employee was sitting. When the employee jumped out of the forklift, his feet were caught on the handle bar and he was pulled under the machine. His legs were crushed by the driver's side handle bar.

An employee was testing a lighting circuit on the second floor when he was shocked by a live circuit and fell from an 8-foot ladder to the ground. He hit his back and head and was knocked unconscious. He was hospitalized.

An employee was using pressurized air to blow hot thermoplastic material from a pressurized line in a thermoplastic striper machine out into a pan. An open valve caused the molten plastic to come out into the pan with force and then strike the employee's right hand, arm, and face resulting in third-degree burns.
An employee was climbing down a ladder when he slipped and fell approximately 2 feet. He landed on his feet, which resulted in a foot injury.

An employee was performing quality assurance at an on-ramp when a mini-excavator with rubber tires rolled over his feet, resulting in fractures to both feet, a fractured right ankle, and a laceration on his right foot.

Employees were installing a urinal. The injured employee was screwing a bolt onto the urinal while the other employee held the urinal. The urinal slipped and crushed the injured employee's left middle finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was connecting a 4-way chain to an excavator when they became caught between the excavator and a concrete structure. The employee sustained broken ribs.

The injured employee was training another employee how to operate a skid steer. The injured employee climbed between the forklift carriage and the body of the skid steer to press the traction override button and release the controls for operation. The fork carriage lifted and tilted backward, pinning them between the carriage and the lift arm. The employee was hospitalized with a cracked pelvis.
An employee was operating a groove machine when his gloved hand became pinched between the bottom die and the inside of the pipe. The employee sustained injuries to his right middle and ring fingers.

An employee was installing a drag chain on an asphalt paver. The employee was feeding the chain when their glove got caught, dragging the employee's left hand into the chain. The employee's middle finger was amputated and their index fingertip was amputated to the cuticle. The asphalt paver was running at the time.
An employee was tying rebar on a structure in preparation for concrete pouring when he fell approximately 20 feet to the concrete pad below, resulting in a broken back and a concussion.
An employee was holding a demolition saw when they sustained a laceration to the back of their left knee.

A crane operator was transitioning a crane from a slope to a flat surface when the crane began tipping over. The operator jumped from the cab of the crane and landed on the bridge deck as the crane overturned on the bridge. The employee was hospitalized with an injury to the left arm.

Two employees were setting a cement manhole cover when it slipped and caught one employee's right hand. The employee sustained a right middle fingertip amputation that required medical amputation and loss of bone.

On 10/29/2024, an employee was assembling scaffolding when he mis-stepped and fell sideways from the scaffolding to a concrete surface 7-8 feet below. The employee sustained a traumatic brain injury (TBI).

An employee was operating an asphalt transport buggy when it hit a bump and and tipped onto its side. The employee's hip struck the roll-over protection bar, resulting in a fractured hip and hospitalization.

An employee had just finished framing an H-structure. They lowered one side of the horizontal structure down on cribbing to keep it raised off the floor. They removed the pull stand on that side to use it at a different location. The pull stand on the other side of the structure broke, allowing the H-structure to fall down 3 to 4 feet onto the employee s left foot. The employee sustained a fractured talus and required surgery.

An employee was drilling holes into a wall while on a ladder when they fell approximately 8-10 feet to the concrete floor. The employee landed on their head and was hospitalized with a fractured skull.

An employee was spotting for a telescopic forklift when the lift hit a bump and the boom shifted sideways, causing the load to fall from the forks. The employee was struck by a plastic sheet, resulting in a fractured pelvis and hip.

On a vessel, an employee was guiding an anchor cable onto it's spool. The cable tightened and sent the employee back, causing him to strike the A-frame of the vessel. He sustained a fractured left femur.
An employee was climbing a fixed ladder to get onto the roof of a building when they fell approximately 13 feet to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with fractured ribs and a collapsed lung.

A subcontractor employee was sanding the ceiling while on a mobile ladder. The employee was using the ladder to move along the work area as they worked. The ladder slid into a hole in the floor, causing the employee to fall to the floor. He broke both wrists and sustained head trauma.
An employee suffered abdominal pain while moving boxes, sustaining a hernia.

An employee was changing out a thermal expansion valve for the AC equipment in the hallway handler closet. The employee was using an oxygen acetylene torch during the startup and oil that was trapped in the copper line of the AC system ignited, causing a flash fire. The employee sustained first- and second-degree burns on their left hand, arm, knees, and stomach.

An employee was part of a crew tasked with removing and replacing inlet grates. A grate was being lifted it into the bucket of a backhoe when the grate slipped out of one crew member's hands and fell onto the injured employee's lower right leg, resulting in fractures to their ankle.

Three employees were constructing a deck (digging holes to install permanent roof shoring) when the roof over the porch collapsed on them. The roof (9 feet by 25 feet) had been supported by temporary 2x4 shoring. One employee was hospitalized with a hairline fracture of one vertebra, a facture to the lower back, and two broken ribs. The other two employees were injured but not hospitalized. The second employee sustained cuts to their head and shoulder. The third employee sustained cuts and bruises to their head, back, arms, and legs.
An employee was loading a directional drill unit onto a trailer when their finger was caught between the directional drill unit and the trailer. The employee's finger was partially amputated.
An employee had been testing voltage inside a box. They were putting the cover on when an arc flash occurred. The employee sustained severe burns on their forearms.

An employee was unloading a mini-excavator from a trailer. The mini-excavator tipped over and fell off the trailer with the employee inside. His right foot was pinned under the machine and sustained an injury.

An employee was walking through a fire door when the door closed on his right hand, pinching his fingers between the door and the jamb. The employee sustained a tissue amputation to the little fingertip.

The injured employee was replacing hoist cables in an elevator pit when a hand tool from another employee working on the elevator car top fell down the elevator shaft and struck him in the head, knocking his hard hat off. Then, a second tool hit him on the top right front of his skull resulting in a fracture.
An employee was on a 12-foot ladder, adjusting pipe hangers. He fell from the ladder to the concrete floor and suffered a broken left wrist.

An employee was tightening a winch cable wire rope on the front of a truck when his right index finger was caught between the winch rollers and a rope swage collar. The employee sustained a fingertip amputation, approximately to the first knuckle.

An employee was hanging a board to clamp it to another board when they lost their balance and fell 8 feet from a ladder to a floor board on the ground. The employee sustained fractures to their wrist, two ribs, and four spinal fractures.
Two employees were installing corrugated sheet metal panels when when one employee dropped a panel that lacerated the other employee's bicep.
An employee was cutting 2x4 studs with a battery-powered circular saw when his left index finger was lacerated and required surgery resulting in an amputation.
An employee was inspecting equipment stored on top of a storage container when they fell from the storage container to the ground. The employee sustained a head and back injury.

An employee stumbled backward while picking up pieces of concrete. His back struck a skid steer bucket and he suffered a laceration to the forehead, as well as a broken rib and an injury to the spleen that required surgery.
An employee was moving a cart on a roof when they fell through a skylight, injuring their back. Fall protection was not in place at the time.
An employee was moving candles after a paint truck finished striping the road. A car entered the work zone and struck the employee. The employee sustained a fractured leg and a dislocated shoulder.
An employee was placing concrete when a concrete boom collapsed and struck the employee. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured skull and a brain bleed.
An employee was getting out of his truck when it began rolling and they were caught between the truck door and the frame of a stationary front-end loader. The employee sustained a crushed pelvis.
Two employees were welding on a 3" steam line when the system activated and hot water was expelled from the pipes. Both employees sustained burns.
An employee was operating a rebar bending machine when his glove was caught in the machine and his right index fingertip was crushed and amputated.

An employee was performing steel structure construction when their scissor lift tipped over and they fell 22 feet to the ground. The scissor lift struck racking during the fall and the employee sustained a fractured pelvis and back.

An employee was erecting formwork for a concrete wall from an aerial lift. The lift had mechanical issues and was parked. The employee climbed up from a 7-foot platform to a height of 16 feet and then anchored. The anchor failed and the employee fell 16 feet, resulting in a fractured hip, scrapes, and bruises. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was moving a shipping container to a terminal tractor when the eye that is connected to the wire rope cable failed, releasing the chain while it was under tension. The chain snapped back toward the shipping container and went to the side of the container. The chain struck the employee under his hard hat on the side of his face. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was troubleshooting an electrical meter on a house. The employee didn't notice anything abnormal from the ground, so they went up in a bucket and noticed the wire connecting to the lightening arrestor was not connected. They made a curl on the existing copper and went to reconnect when an electrical transformer caused a fire. The employee sustained second- and third-degree burns to the face, upper body, and arms.
An employee was operating a soil screener and went to remove a piece of wood. A rock fell onto their hand and crushed a finger. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was installing shingles on a roof when they fell to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured hip and was hospitalized.
An employee was walking in an open field when they slipped on a muddy area and fell. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to their wrist, shoulder, and elbow and they required surgery.

An employee was painting a cross-member from a suspended scaffold. When he leaned back to spray part of the structure, he fell from the scaffolding. The employee landed on the concrete ground and suffered injuries to the left shoulder and left knee.

An employee assisted with lifting a sand/salt spreader out of a truck onto a steel stand for work to be done on the sander chain. The employee went to unhook the chain from the excavator bucket. They climbed a fiberglass/steel ladder and then got onto the grate of the sand/salt spreader. The employee fell 8 feet from the grate to the gravel driveway. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to their vertebrae, ribs, and pelvis.

An employee was putting out road barrels for traffic control and standing on the lift gate of a traffic truck with a driver in the driver's seat. The truck was struck from behind by a tractor trailer and the employee was thrown to the ground. The driver of the truck sustained injuries and was not hospitalized. The employee was hospitalized with a laceration to the head and a concussion, as well as a fractured femur that required surgery.

An employee was using a drain snake (auger) to clear a drain when the drain snake became snagged. The employee was manually maneuvering the snake when it wrapped around his hand. The employee was hospitalized with fractures, a lacerated hand, and a bruised arm.

An employee was putting water into a hopper with his hand on a handrail of the hopper when the handrail pushed up against the hopper. The employee sustained a fracture at the base of their ring finger.

An employee was conducting a test groove during a die change with the high grooving machine. The employee's hand came in contact with the point of operation, resulting in an amputation of their middle and index fingers.
An employee was exiting a skid steer when they twisted and broke their ankle.
An employee was using a table saw to cut a piece of trim wood when his left hand contacted the blade. The employee sustained a laceration to their middle finger.
An employee was cutting live electrical wires with a hacksaw and sustained an electrical shock.
An employee was putting a tarp on the back of a truck. They were inside the dump box of the truck when they slipped and fell, fracturing their right ankle. The employee was hospitalized.

On November 6, 2024, an employee was inspecting a construction site when they tripped over a concrete wall and fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a broken wrist and required surgery.
An employee was working on the roof of a two-story building when they fell to the ground. The employee sustained fractures and internal injuries.
An employee was using a table saw when the sawblade amputated the employee's left ring and little fingers.
An employee was standing on the track of a trackhoe when his left safety boot heel got stuck on the track and he fell backward to the ground. The employee sustained a closed left tibia fracture.

Two employees were removing the top of a dehumidification unit using reciprocating saws. One employee was cutting on top of the unit while the other cut below the top. The top gave way, and the employee on top fell about 8 feet, landing chest-first on the base of the unit. The employee suffered a broken wrist, broken ribs on the right side, and a broken sternum.
An employee fell into an 8-foot hole on a job site after moving a pallet. He suffered a broken heel.

On November 7, 2024, an employee slipped off the rear platform of a truck while moving temporary road signs. The employee was struck by the trailer that the truck was pulling and they sustained fractures to their left tibia and fibula.
An employee was on the roof of an apartment building when they fell approximately 40 feet to the ground. The employee sustained multiple broken bones and was hospitalized.

Two employees were unbolting a section of the hopper at a screening plant when it came unseated. The hopper wing struck the injured employee as they were bent over picking up a washer. The employee sustained fractures to their pelvis and lower back vertebrae.

On November 8, 2025, two employees were setting up walk boards and ladders in preparation for roofing work. One of the ladders snapped and both employees fell 27 feet to the ground, resulting in hospitalizations due to multiple injuries. One employee sustained a compression fracture to their lower back and bruised ribs, and the second employee sustained a broken nose, internal bleeding, and a shattered pelvis.

Employees had been working on a roof laying new shingles. At the end of the day, the injured employee unhooked from his anchor point and was making his way toward the ladder to egress from the roof. He slipped on the ice and water shield underlayment and fell 15 feet, striking an aerial lift bucket before hitting the ground. The employee sustained fractures to three ribs, his nose, cheek bone, and below the eye.

An employee was on a work platform approximately 20 feet high installing batt insulation. As he was climbing down using the step on the platform, it tipped forward causing the employee to fall backward and land on his wrist. The employee was hospitalized for an open fracture of the left wrist.

An employee was replacing a ceiling grate when he dropped a tool. As he went to retrieve the tool, he fell from an 8-foot step ladder and landed on the ground. The employee sustained a fractured left wrist.

An employee was riding a power trowel to move it out of the way when the power trowel got caught in safety netting. The employee and the power trowel fell 18 feet off the second deck and the employee sustained a ligament injury to the right foot, a laceration/bruise on their liver, and a foot injury. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was guiding a pump that was being lifted by an excavator when the pump swung and pinched the employee's left hand between the pump and the excavator, resulting in crush injuries to the hand and fingers.

On November 11, 2024, at 1:00 p.m., an employee was exiting a residential roof onto a ladder when the ladder slid out from under him. He fell down the ladder for approximately 10 feet, landing on the side of the ladder. The employee suffered approximately four broken ribs and bleeding to the spleen.

Employee 1 was working with two other employees to remove a pipe support. Employee 1 was holding one side of the pipe, employee 2 was holding the other, and employee 3 was cutting the support. Employee 1 was standing on the fourth step of a 6-foot A-frame ladder. When employee 3 cut the pipe support, employee 1 lost his balance and fell to the ground. Employee 1 was hospitalized with his left leg fractured below the knee.
