An employee was guiding a 25-foot-tall formwork that was being removed from a concrete wall with a crane. One of the turnbuckle braces (weighing approximately 300 pounds) disconnected and struck the employee, resulting in a laceration to the back of his head, fractured vertebrae, a fractured left hip, and a fractured left tibia.

An employee was attaching rigging to a crane mat for pickup. He signaled the operator to lift the mat when the hook slid on a bar and pinched the employee's left middle finger between the hook and mat, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was using a hammer to break away old existing sewer pipe from underneath a building. A section of dirt/rock fell from the side of the underground tunnel wall onto the employee's legs. The employee sustained two broken legs.
An employee was inspecting a hose when he tripped over the hose and his head and right shoulder struck the ground, resulting in a brain injury that required hospitalization.
An employee was taking an ATV to a crew so they could load it. A deer struck the ATV and the employee fell to the ground, resulting in a broken collarbone and multiple lacerations.

An employee was chipping a concrete wall to replace a railing on a roadway. He went to get into a better position by climbing into the bucket of a mini excavator. The thumb of the excavator closed on the employee, resulting in a fracture from his forehead to the top of his nose, a fractured right wrist and ankle, and a dislocated left ankle.

An employee was helping to attach an automated flagger assistance device platform to the rear hitch of a truck. He placed his left index finger inside the hitch mount area to locate the pinhole for alignment. As a co-worker repositioned the platform, the components shifted and caught the employee's finger between the platform and the hitch assembly, resulting in a laceration with a partial fingertip amputation.

An employee was holding a welding rod to clean a pipe on a pump rig so the teeth on the hydraulic chain tongs could have a better grip. His right glove was pulled into the chain tongs, resulting in an amputation of the index fingertip.

An employee was pulling a 400-foot run of rope using a wire-pulling machine. After 300 feet of the rope was pulled, it became bound around the capstan. The employee was showing a foreman the issue when the employee's left little finger got pinched between the rope and capstan, resulting in amputation of the finger.

An employee was standing on the bed of a crane truck working to pin the jib of the crane to the main boom so it could be stowed away. He fell off the bed of the truck approximately 5 feet to the ground, landing on both of his arms. The employee suffered a broken right forearm and a dislocated left elbow.

An employee was using a 10-inch table saw to cut jambs for interior doors. After finishing a cut, the saw blade contacted the top of his right hand and index finger, resulting in lacerations that required hospitalization.

An employee was on an elevated surface while cutting joints in a bridge deck. The blade on a walk-behind saw was pinched by rebar, causing the employee to fall over the edge to a false decking. The employee fell on a concrete saw, resulting in a lacerated right bicep.

An employee and crew were using a line truck to set a pole. The employee was standing at the rear of the vehicle operating the external gear controls. When he engaged the high-RPM function using the control switch, the truck began moving backward. The employee was pinned between the rear of the truck and a job trailer, resulting in multiple fractures in pelvic area/midsection and internal contusions.

An employee was pinning studs inside a building while a contractor was operating a backhoe in another portion of the building. The backhoe came through a curtain wall and contacted an air-handling unit that was on skids, causing it to come off and roll on top of the employee's right leg. The employee suffered a broken right femur, a broken right ankle, and lacerations to the right knee.
An employee's right forearm was injured by a grinder, requiring surgery.

An employee was on a work platform elevated by a telehandler, and was working on the side of a new post-and-frame building. They were grabbing a piece of building material when the work platform detached from the telehandler, causing them to fall 8 to 9 feet down to the surface level. The employee sustained a fractured vertebra and a fractured left hip.
An employee had placed a circular water meter on the tailgate of a pickup truck. The water meter fell from the tailgate onto the employee's foot, resulting in a fracture to their right big toe.
An employee was assembling parking lifts when a lock on the parking lift cut the tip of his thumb. The employee's thumb tip was surgically amputated.
An employee was positioned on a lift, performing maintenance on a second story window, when they fell approximately 18 feet. The employee sustained a bone fracture and blunt force trauma.

An employee was placing metal trim on a building. The employee was working to move a new piece of sheet metal into position and secure it to the building. The sheet metal made contact with a power line, shocking the employee and resulting in electric burns to their arms and back.

An employee was on a 12-foot step ladder while installing insulation on the interior of a residential home. He was working on the 11th step when the ladder shifted, causing him to fall. The employee landed on the ladder, resulting in fractured ribs.

An employee was cutting a piece of siding trim on a table saw when his hand slipped. The saw blade caught the edge of his glove just beneath the guard, pulling his right hand in and resulting in a severe laceration to the index finger. The cut extended from the bottom to the top of the finger and went through the bone, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was removing a large piece of glass facing into a dumpster when the glass broke, resulting in a cut on their left arm.

An employee was clearing the way for construction vehicles coming in and out of a work area. As a truck was backing up, a tire blowout caused the mudflap to tear. One of the broken pieces struck the employee, resulting in an abdominal injury that required surgery.

An employee was working from a ladder to remove a test gauge from an air-charged water line. When he unthreaded a pipe to remove the gauge, the release of air pressure unexpectedly pushed the pipe into him, knocking him from the ladder. The employee landed on the concrete floor below, resulting in a broken hip.

A employee was on a scissor lift, power washing the back of a commercial building. He came into contact with a powerline and was electrocuted. He sustained first-, second-, and third-degree burns to the head, arms, abdomen, and legs.

An employee was descending a scaffold. A decking plate was displaced when the employee's weight was placed on it, causing the employee to fall to the ground about 13 feet below. The employee sustained fractures to their shoulder, back, and a rib, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was working on a roof and placing metal panels. He stepped on a skylight and fell approximately 16 feet to the ground. The employee sustained an internal head injury and a fractured left leg.

An employee was on stilts, hanging insulation in a unit. At the same time, drywall stockers were staging drywall on 2x4 beams, which protruded out from under the drywall stack. The employee tripped over one of the beams and fell to the ground, resulting in a broken left arm.
An employee was working from a ladder, installing a sieve, when they slipped off the fifth rung of the ladder. The employee fell and their head struck the concrete about 5 feet below.
While bending over to disconnect and remove a core rig trailer from a pickup truck hitch, an employee suffered a slipped disc in his lower back that pushed against a nerve.

The injured employee was handing a tool to another employee on a staircase when he lost his balance fell backward to the floor. The employee sustained a concussion, a laceration and contusion to the back of his head, and fractures to his shoulder blade and ribs.

Employees were using a skid-steer loader to relocate a concrete barrier wall on a turnpike as part of a lane-closure setup. While aligning the loader s forks with the barrier s lift point, the barrier rolled forward off the forks. An employee who was in front of the barrier assisting with the alignment, stepped back and tripped. The barrier fell onto his legs, resulting in multiple fractures.
An employee was removing plywood when he fell to the ground and struck his nose on a nail gun. The employee was hospitalized.

The injured employee was pulling nylon string into an underground pipe to get a measurement for ordering wire. The pull for the string was 400 feet, so he used a power drill to spool the wire. The nylon string got bunched up around the nose of the drill. As he pushed the string out of the way, the drill activated and his thumb got caught in the string. The thumb was lacerated and fractured and required surgery.

An employee was fueling a dewatering pump to ensure it would run for the remainder of the day. A malfunction in the fuel can's handle caused gasoline to spill onto the engine. The fuel ignited, resulting in a fire. The employee sustained burns to their stomach and both hands.

While preparing to set concrete deck panels, employees identified a jammed cable on a 75-ton crane. The injured employee went to free the cable manually. When the cable released, the crane block dropped and pinned the employee s left hand. The employee sustained an amputation to their little fingertip and crushing injuries to their index, middle, and ring fingers. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.

An employee was working from a bridge platform, building bottom edge beams. He stopped work to leave for lunch, then fell from the platform to the riverbed about 30-40 feet below. He sustained fractures to his left hand/wrist and lower back, as well as internal bleeding. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was walking on the ground next to stacked beams. A 12-foot steel beam fell off the stack and fractured the employee's right ankle.

Employees were working to dismantle forklift ram protection columns. The columns were mounted with chemical anchors and there was adhesive in the bolt holes, so another forklift was used to perform the lift. The injured employee was working to move a column with his hand when the adhesive came loose and the columns moved. The employee's left hand was crushed between the columns. His thumb was fractured and the skin was damaged and bleeding, requiring amputation.

An employee was working to fabricate a valve handle. The employee was using a grinder and the sparks created by the grinder ignited the employee's undershirt. The employee sustained burns to his right bicep and underarm that required hospitalization.
An employee was working on a table saw when their thumb came into contact with the blade. The thumb was partially amputated.

An employee was removing the cover from the bucket of a bucket truck when strong winds caught the cover and blew it toward/into his body, causing him to fall from the side of the truck. He landed on the ground and lost consciousness. The employee sustained fractures to his spine and ribs.

An employee was working in a column, installing a dovetail, when it got stuck. When he pulled it out, the dovetail touched a power line. He sustained an electric shock that travel from his hands to his feet. He was hospitalized with burns.
